Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given
territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise
Value (GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities

Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is
correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills

Graduate with 0-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness
and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal
drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
AboutCompany: Swiggy is an Indian online food ordering and delivery company. Founded in 2014, Swiggy is headquartered in Bangalore and operates in more than 580 Indian cities, as of July 2023.[4] Besides food delivery, the platform also provides quick commerce services under the name Swiggy Instamart, and same-day package deliveries with Swiggy Genie.

Primary skill - Invoice Processing - P3

Your expected interactions are within your own team and direct supervisor.
You will be provided detailed to moderate level of instruction on daily work tasks and detailed instruction on new assignments.
The decisions that you make would impact your own work.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
This Area Manager role is responsible for commercial growth and customer engagement across Delhi & Rajasthan. The position follows a remote work style with frequent field-based customer interaction and approximately 50% travel across assigned accounts, hospitals, and healthcare institutions within the territory.

The Area Manager is responsible for driving sales performance, expanding market presence, and supporting clinical adoption of Cardiac Surgery products across the assigned territory. This role works closely with cardiac surgeons, perfusion teams, hospital stakeholders, and procurement functions to deliver product education, procedural support, and account development strategies that contribute to business growth and customer success.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

Drive territory sales growth by executing account plans and identifying opportunities to expand adoption of Cardiac Surgery therapies across assigned hospitals and healthcare institutions.
Build and maintain clinical and commercial relationships with cardiac surgeons, perfusionists, operating room staff, vascular specialists, and procurement stakeholders.
Provide product education, technical support, and clinical expertise to support safe and effective use of Cardiac Surgery technologies.
Deliver procedural support during surgical cases, including troubleshooting and follow-up activities to ensure customer satisfaction and therapy adoption.
Conduct product training and in-service programmes for new and existing customers on assigned therapy portfolios.
Partner with key implant center's to develop strategies that increase product utilisation and support progression toward technical self-sufficiency.
Gather and communicate market intelligence, customer feedback, competitive activity, and product performance insights to internal stakeholders.
Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, inventory-related activities, and territory data within approved business systems.



Preferred candidate profile

Required Knowledge and Experience:

High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience
OR Associates Degree AND 6+ years experience
OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in Cardiac Surgery, Cardiovascular, Structural Heart, Perfusion, Extracorporeal Life Support, or related medical device therapies.
Degree or certification in Perfusion Technology.
Master's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or Master of Business Administration.
Experience supporting live surgical procedures and working directly with cardiac surgeons and operating room teams.
Knowledge of hospital purchasing processes, account development strategies, and healthcare market dynamics within South India.

Description:
Position: PLM Support Engineer
Experience: 3 to 8 Years
Location: Bangalore / Pune / Chennai / Hyderabad (or as applicable)
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled PLM Support Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience in supporting and maintaining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing L2/L3 production support for PLM platforms such as PLM Support ,Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam, ensuring stable operations, timely incident resolution, and continuous process improvement. The role involves troubleshooting workflows, CAD integrations, BOM management, release processes, and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support.
Key Responsibilities
Production Support & Incident Management
Provide L2/L3 production support for PLM applications including Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam across production and non-production environments.
Act as the primary point of contact for business users for PLM operational, application, and workflow-related issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and change requests within agreed SLA timelines.
Perform impact analysis and prioritize tickets based on business criticality.
PLM Functional Support
Support Engineering Change Management (ECM/ECR/ECO) processes and workflows.
Manage and troubleshoot complex BOM (Bill of Material) structures and product data issues.
Support product release processes, document lifecycle management, and workflow execution activities.
Assist users with process adherence, workflow execution, and system functionality.
CAD & Integration Support
Provide support for CAD integrations with Siemens NX, CATIA, and related engineering applications.
Troubleshoot CAD data loading, synchronization issues, and integration failures.
Investigate dataset validation failures, translator issues, and CAD file management problems.
Workflow & System Administration Support
Troubleshoot workflow integration issues, dispatcher failures, workflow processing delays, and PDF generation errors.
Support vault server management, job server monitoring, and scheduled background jobs.
Monitor workflow execution and system performance to ensure application availability and stability.
Analyze system bottlenecks impacting user performance and workflow processing.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring production incidents.
Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce ticket volumes and improve system reliability.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements within PLM support operations.
Maintain knowledge articles, support documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Generate and publish support metrics, incident reports, ticket trend analysis, and SLA compliance reports.
Provide regular status updates to management and key stakeholders.
Coordinate with development, infrastructure, database, and global support teams for issue resolution and deployments.
Participate in release validation, patch deployment, and post-deployment support activities.
Required Technical Skills
PLM Technologies
Strong experience in at least one or more PLM applications:
Teamcenter
Aras Innovator
SmarTeam
Functional Knowledge
Engineering Change Management (ECR/ECO/ECN)
Product Structure Management
BOM Management
Workflow Management
Release Management
Document Management
CAD Integration
Siemens NX
CATIA
CAD Data Management
Technical Skills
SQL Queries and Database Fundamentals
PLM Data Model Understanding
Workflow Configuration and Troubleshooting
Dispatcher Monitoring
PDF Generation Processes
Job Server and Vault Management
Application Log Analysis
Support Tools
ServiceNow / Jira / Remedy
Incident & Change Management Tools
Monitoring and Reporting Tools
Desired Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
3 to 8 years of experience in PLM application support.
Experience in global production support environments.
Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices.
ITIL certification is preferred.
Required Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work with global and cross-functional teams.
Customer-focused approach with strong ownership mindset.
Ability to work in rotational shifts and provide production support when required.
Strong documentation and reporting skills.
Preferred Skills
Teamcenter BMIDE knowledge.
Teamcenter Active Workspace exposure.
Aras administration/support experience.
Understanding of manufacturing and engineering business processes.
Exposure to deployment and release management activities.
Experience in performance tuning and application monitoring.

Meet property owners and customers to facilitate property sales, rentals, and leases.

Maintain customer interactions and sales updates in CRM.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets while ensuring excellent customer experience.

Minimum 1 year of field sales experience.
Real estate experience preferred for commercial property hiring.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Good English and regional language communication; manageable Hindi is acceptable in Bangalore.

brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation

Strong experience with Magento 2 development and debugging
Strong experience with high-performance technologies such as Nginx, Varnish, Redis, ElasticSearch
JavaScript and AJAX experience for Front-end
Extensive HTML5, LESS and CSS knowledge
Understanding of modern UI/UX trends

Experience with AWS components such as VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, WAF Cloud Formation
Linux or Ubuntu server operations working and know-hows
Experience in working with MySQL databases like MariaDB and Percona
Basic understanding of networking and ports
Experience with Google Tag Manager, SEO, Google Analytics, PPC, Facebook Pixels. A/B Testing
Strong attention to details about design styles to improve look and feel
Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks
Ability to work in a professional capacity and team environment is must
Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
Magento 2 Certification is required
Cloud Computing Certification (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus

Role / Job Title- Manager - Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Consultant
Experience - 8 - 14 years

Key Skills -Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll, US Payroll, Payroll Configuration, Elements, Calculation Cards, Balances, Fast Formulas, Payroll Flows, Retro Processing and Costing
Location - Bangalore/Hyderabad/ Pune /Gurugram

Role & responsibilities

8 - 14 years of experience in Oracle HCM applications, with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll.
Must have worked on at least two end-to-end Oracle Fusion Payroll implementations, with strong Oracle US Payroll experience; Canada Payroll experience is a plus.
In-depth hands-on configuration across Legislative Data Groups, payroll definitions and calendars, Payroll Statutory Units / Tax Reporting Units, elements, input values, element eligibility, calculation cards, balances, payment methods and payroll costing.
Strong knowledge of QuickPay, payroll flows, retroactive processing, proration, balance adjustments, costing and payment processing.
Hands-on expertise in Payroll Fast Formulas and troubleshooting complex payroll calculation and configuration issues.
Strong understanding of US payroll processing, including federal, state and local taxation, quarter-end / year-end activities and legislative updates.
Experience with HDL / payroll data conversion, payroll extracts and reporting, with the ability to collaborate with technical teams on integrations and extensions.
Ability to perform fit-gap analysis, translate business requirements into scalable configuration, and lead unit testing, UAT / regression testing, quarterly release readiness and production issue resolution.
Strong client-facing communication and delivery leadership, including risk / escalation management, team guidance and working knowledge of Core HR and related HCM touchpoints.
As a Manager, you will serve as the functional lead and client-facing subject matter expert for Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll, combining deep payroll configuration expertise with delivery leadership across implementation, enhancement and production support engagements.
Lead the Oracle HCM Payroll functional workstream across solution design, configuration, testing, cutover, hypercare and ongoing support.
Lead client requirement and design discussions, translate payroll policies into Oracle configuration, and provide clear recommendations on solution options and impacts.
Own complex payroll functional issues from analysis through resolution, driving root-cause analysis and sustainable fixes.
Review payroll configurations, functional designs and deliverables for quality, accuracy, controls and adherence to agreed standards.
Manage incidents, service requests, changes and problem records in line with SLAs / KPIs, including prioritization, risks, escalations and stakeholder communication.
Coordinate with Core HR, Benefits, Compensation, Time and Labor, Integrations, Reporting and Finance teams, and lead quarterly release impact assessment and regression testing.
Mentor functional consultants, provide configuration oversight, build team capability and drive continuous improvement while maintaining strong client relationships.

Role- Pharma & Life Sciences (R&D Operations / Clinical Strategy / Life Sciences Consulting)
Role Overview
PwC is seeking highly motivated professionals with experience in Pharma & Life Sciences, Clinical Research, R&D Operations, Clinical Trial Strategy, or Healthcare Consulting to join our growing Sector Operations - Health team.
The selected candidate will support global consulting engagements focused on pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and life sciences organizations. The role involves conducting strategic analyses, supporting transformation initiatives, generating data-driven insights, and enabling operational excellence across the R&D and commercial value chain.

Key Responsibilities
Conduct primary and secondary research, market assessments, and competitive benchmarking.
Analyze complex business problems and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
Support client engagements involving R&D operations, clinical trial strategy, and life sciences transformation.
Develop executive-level presentations, reports, and client deliverables.
Perform quantitative and qualitative analyses using healthcare and life sciences data.
Support portfolio management, resource planning, and business process improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with global teams and stakeholders across multiple workstreams.
Leverage emerging technologies, analytics, and GenAI solutions to improve business outcomes.
Participate in thought leadership, practice development, and knowledge management activities.

Preferred Capability Areas
R&D Operations & Strategic Planning
Understanding of pharmaceutical and life sciences R&D operations.
Knowledge of portfolio, resource, and financial management processes.
Exposure to clinical trial management systems (CTMS, EDC).
Understanding of R&D governance, reporting frameworks, and operational planning.
Familiarity with clinical data standards, system integrations, and data migration processes.

Clinical Trial Strategy
Experience supporting clinical trial design, study optimization, or clinical operations.
Knowledge of protocol development, site selection, patient recruitment, and decentralized trials.
Understanding of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines and regulatory requirements.
Familiarity with clinical trial databases such as ClinicalTrials.gov and Trialtrove.

Pharmaceutical & Life Sciences Strategy
Knowledge of the pharmaceutical and life sciences ecosystem.
Experience with product launch strategy, market access, lifecycle management, and commercialization initiatives.
Understanding of pharmaceutical pricing concepts such as WAC, ASP, AMP, and Gross-to-Net.
Exposure to healthcare datasets including claims, EHR, and prescription data.
Experience supporting analytics or AI-driven business transformation initiatives.

Required Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to synthesize large volumes of qualitative and quantitative information.
Experience creating executive-ready presentations and reports.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Structured thinking and hypothesis-driven problem solving.
Ability to work effectively in a global delivery model and manage multiple priorities.

SAP Analytics Cloud & Datasphere Consultant
Location: Bangalore or Chennai
Duration: Contingent Worker (6 Months)
AstraZenecas Global Business Services (GBS) Process & Analytics Services capability is at the forefront of transforming our business processes through innovation in automation, analytics, and artificial intelligence. As part of the Process Insights team, we are scaling our SAP analytics expertise to deliver best-in-class solutions. We are seeking a talented SAP Analytics Cloud & Datasphere Consultant to drive analytical initiatives and empower data-driven decision-making across AstraZeneca.
Main duties and responsibilities
The role will be responsible for the following activities:
Own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle of analytics solutions, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Design, build, and maintain scalable data models in SAP Datasphere to support reporting and analytics requirements.
Develop analytical datasets, views, and business-ready data models following governance and best practices.
Integrate and harmonize data from SAP and non-SAP sources within Datasphere.
Create and enhance SAC dashboards, stories, and KPI reports using Datasphere as the primary data source.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical designs and scalable analytics solutions.
Perform unit testing, support SIT/UAT activities, and ensure successful deployment to production.
Troubleshoot and optimize data models, queries, and SAC reports for performance, usability, and data quality.
Ensure adherence to data governance, security, and development standards.
Provide ongoing support and continuous improvement for delivered analytics products.
Prepare technical documentation and contribute to Agile delivery ceremonies.

Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics or a comparable degree.
Overall, 8-12 years of experience and at least 2-3 years experience working on SAP SAC / Datasphere solutions as a Consultant, Analyst, Developer or relevant role.

Experience developing SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) stories, dashboards, and visualizations.
Good understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modelling, and ETL/ELT concepts.
Experience integrating data from SAP S/4HANA, BW, and non-SAP systems.
Strong SQL and analytical problem-solving skills.
Business process knowledge in Finance (P&L, Cost Centers, Budgeting, Forecasting, Procurement, Spend Analytics) and/or Operations/Supply Chain (Inventory, Logistics, Manufacturing, Order Management, Service Operations).
Ability to engage with business users and convert business requirements into technical data models and reports.
Excellent communication skills and ability to work in an Agile environment.
Energetic, organised and self-motivated.
Fluent in business English.

Lead ADP WorkForce Software implementation and optimization workstreams from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, cutover and stabilization.
Own solution design for time and attendance, workforce scheduling, leave/accruals, approval workflows and workforce-to-payroll integration within the contracted scope.
Facilitate senior client design workshops and translate complex workforce policies, collective bargaining rules and pay practices into scalable configuration standards.

Scheduling Go-Live Review Board and presenting configuration, audits and cutover plan to ADP WorkForce Software Enablement Services
Advise client leadership on workforce management operating models, controls, compliance considerations and opportunities for automation and standardization.
Lead, coach and review the work of Senior Associates and Associates; develop reusable accelerators and strengthen the WFS configuration capability.
Support proposals, estimates, statements of work, solution demonstrations and practice development activities as required.
Partner with HR, payroll, finance, operations and technology stakeholders to map workforce management processes, policies, controls and integration dependencies.
Assess workforce management and payroll impacts of time capture, attendance exceptions, scheduling, leave, overtime and premium pay rules.

Deep knowledge of complex time and attendance rules, workforce scheduling, accruals, labor policies and downstream payroll impacts.
Experience overseeing integrations, configuration governance, test strategy, cutover and production stabilization.
Proven ability to manage client executives, cross-functional delivery teams, project risks, quality and commercial expectations.

Strong consulting, stakeholder management, team leadership, commercial and problem-solving skills.

Job SummaryA senior, customer-facing SRE who owns the reliability of a client's production systems end to end. Embedded as the main technical point of contact, you will design reliable infrastructure, lead incidents, apply AI-assisted operations, and mentor the team.Key Responsibilities
Own the reliability of production systems for one or more enterprise customers on AWS.
Define and manage SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, and ensure monitoring provides meaningful insight.
Lead the response to serious (P0/P1) incidents and run blameless post-mortems that lead to fixes.
Lead within the on-call rotation.
Operate and optimise Kubernetes clusters and AWS services as workloads grow.
Introduce AI SRE tooling and AIOps where it speeds up triage and resolution, with appropriate guardrails.
Advise customers on improving their reliability practices, and mentor associate engineers.
Share field learnings with product and engineering teams.
Required Qualifications
Substantial SRE experience with real ownership of production reliability on AWS.
Experience running Kubernetes and AWS services at scale.
A track record of defining and managing SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets.
Strong observability practice.
Proven incident leadership and post-mortem facilitation.
Strong automation skills (Python, Go, or Bash).
Hands-on understanding of AI-assisted operations, including introducing AI SRE tooling with sensible guardrails.
AWS certification at Associate level as a minimum.
Preferred Qualifications
Owning CI/CD pipelines and release automation.
Writing and maintaining Terraform modules.
GitOps workflows and Helm.
Designing telemetry collection across services.
Incident-management tooling such as PagerDuty.
Hands-on experience integrating AIOps or AI SRE tooling into production operations.
Familiarity with observability or evaluation of AI systems (e.g., Langfuse).
Experience delivering AI-based work or AI/ML-driven initiatives in production.
AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional and/or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional.
Technical Skills & Tools
Cloud (AWS): EC2, EKS, ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, ELB/ALB, Route 53
Containers & orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm
Observability & monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Loki, Tempo/Jaeger (tracing), ELK/Elastic
Reliability practices: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, incident command, capacity planning, failure-mode analysis
Incident & on-call: PagerDuty, Opsgenie, blameless post-mortems
Automation & scripting: Python, Go, Bash, Git
AI-assisted operations: AI SRE tooling, AIOps, anomaly detection, automated RCA
DevOps (good to have): CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), Terraform modules, GitOps (ArgoCD), Helm

At EY, we re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
TTT - Senior FIORI/UI5 Developer
EY s GDS Tax Technology team s mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY s core Tax practice, you ll develop a deep tax technical knowledge and outstanding database, data analytics and programming skills.
Ever-increasing regulations require tax departments to gather, organize and analyse more data than ever before. Often the data necessary to satisfy these ever-increasing and complex regulations must be collected from a variety of systems and departments throughout an organization. Effectively and efficiently handling the variety and volume of data is often extremely challenging and time consuming for a company.
EYs GDS Tax Technology team members work side-by-side with the firms partners, clients and tax technical subject matter experts to develop and incorporate technology solutions that enhance value-add, improve efficiencies and enable our clients with disruptive and market leading tools supporting Tax.
GDS Tax Technology works closely with clients and professionals in the following areas: Federal Business Tax Services, Partnership Compliance, Corporate Compliance, Indirect Tax Services, Human Capital, and Internal Tax Services. GDS Tax Technology provides solution architecture, application development, testing and maintenance support to the global TAX service line both on a pro-active basis and in response to specific requests.
EY is currently seeking an Senior FIORI/UI5 Developer to join our Tax Technology practice in Bangalore, India.
The opportunity
We re looking for a Tax Senior with expertise in Senior FIORI/UI5 Developer to join the TTT team in Tax SL. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a pioneer firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable FIORI/UI5 code.
Ensure the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.
Work closely with the SAP team to implement and deploy SAP FIORI applications.
Collaborate with back-end developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic.
Utilize Git for version control and collaboration with team members.
Write clean, maintainable, and documented code with solid test coverage.
Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends.
Qualifications:
5-8 years of experience in FIORI/UI5 development.
Proficient in SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAPM).
Strong understanding of Git and version control best practices.
Expertise in CSS and JavaScript for creating visually appealing and responsive designs.
Familiarity with Node.js is a plus.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
Education:
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success, as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Must-Have Skills
Proficiency in SAP ABAP Development on HANA.

Strong understanding of SAP HANA database concepts, CDS views, Open SQL, and performance tuning techniques.

Skilled in writing efficient, maintainable code while adhering to SAP development best practices.

Position based at the Bangalore office.

Description:
Job Summary
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.
Role purpose: The Workplace Change Manager will establish and lead an APAC Workplace Change Management Center of Excellence (CoE) to standardize and enhance change enablement across APAC site moves. The objective of this role is to create a consistent experience, reduce duplicated effort, and clarify change ownership across projects. This role will lead a CoE that provides structure, methodology, templates, quality control, and oversight, while project and delivery teams execute implementation. The CoE will operate through two parallel workstreams:
Build a controlled library of standardized change collateral within the first 90 days.
Deliver change support mapped to each site s location, timeline, resource requirements, and language needs.
At JLL, we are committed to helping our people achieve their ambitions by enabling them to explore new opportunities, build expertise, create long-term careers, and succeed through inclusion. We value what makes each of us unique and help our people find a place where they can belong.
The Workplace Change Manager is accountable for the CoE methodology, governance, and execution support across six change management stage gates and tier-based engagement. The role will establish the APAC change framework, including T1-T4 tiering, intake, stage gate governance, and quality control processes. It will also drive the creation and maintenance of a controlled collateral library and leadership cascade materials, while supporting project teams with scalable, high-quality change delivery across multiple locations and languages. This role requires a structured and process-minded leader who can standardize effectively without slowing delivery, and who can coach and enable local teams while maintaining strong quality oversight.
Key responsibilities
Establish the APAC change framework, including T1-T4 tiering and the six-gate methodology, with clear intake, tiering, gate approvals, and quality control.
Build and maintain the collateral library and leadership cascade pack by rebuilding existing APAC assets into a controlled library containing templates, worked examples, completion instructions, readiness checklists, and a lessons learned bank with quarterly updates.
Deliver change support aligned to the project pipeline, including engagement planning, content production, cascade and readiness activities, runbook execution, hypercare, handover, and local translation and quality assurance.
Provide daily communications enablement by standardizing event collateral, newsletter templates, workplace signage, and monthly reporting templates, while also providing oversight and quality control for employee-facing communications and campaigns.
Lead stakeholder alignment and readiness cadence with WPx, PMO, and DC to help ensure leadership alignment and employee readiness are addressed consistently.
Manage specialist or external SME engagement by exception where complexity requires additional support, such as high leadership visibility, phased moves, or compressed timelines, under central governance.
Required qualifications
Proven experience leading APAC regional change delivery and communications across workplace moves and multi-stakeholder programs.
Strong experience operating in a model where a central CoE provides structure and projects execute delivery.
Demonstrated capability in building reusable toolkits, templates, and structured approaches, and driving adoption across distributed teams.
Strong communications capability, including employee-facing messaging, campaign support, senior stakeholder engagement, approval management, and quality control.
Strong program management discipline, including intake management, tiering, gate-based governance, readiness checkpoints, and hypercare handover.
Ability to work across multiple locations, timelines, and language requirements with a high level of consistency and control.
Preferred qualifications
Experience establishing or scaling a Center of Excellence in change management, communications, or transformation delivery.
Experience supporting workplace transformation, relocation, or site move programs within a complex regional environment.
Familiarity with structured governance models and quality assurance practices in change delivery.
Ability to balance process discipline with practical execution in fast-moving environments.
Experience coaching local or delivery teams while maintaining centralized standards and oversight.
Location: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Noida, Pune
Scheduled Weekly Hours: 48

Description:
Technology Strategy and Transformation Senior Manager Technology Modernization

Join our team in Technology Strategy Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients define and accelerate technology modernization journeys that unlock growth, simplify complexity and create future-ready technology landscapes

Practice: Technology Strategy Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Technology Modernization Strategy, Application Modernization
Level: Senior Manager

Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad

Years of Exp: 15+ years

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Do you believe technology modernization is key to unlocking growthAre you a problem solver who enjoys helping clients simplify complex technology landscapes and make the right modernization choicesDo you enjoy being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture

If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy Transformation and work with global clients to shape enterprise-wide technology modernization strategies, target-state architecture, application modernization approaches, executable roadmaps and value cases. You will partner with C-suite stakeholders to convert modernization ambition into practical decisions, business-aligned priorities and measurable outcomes across industries.

The Practice A Brief Sketch

Technology Strategy Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clientsmost strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative transformation initiatives, aimed at redefining business models and delivery approaches using agile methodologies.

We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, Enterprise Architecture and Technology consulting, where you will get an opportunity to support and work with our key global clients, defining and driving end-to-end technology modernization initiatives and strategic value, business growth and cost optimization. As part of this high-performing team, these are some of the initiatives you will support:

Modernization Strategy Value Agenda: Help clients define the strategic intent for modernization, aligning with core business objectives of growth, agility, resilience, cost and simplification to a clear modernization ambition and measurable value outcomes Technology Estate Application Portfolio Assessment: Assess complex technology landscapes across applications, platforms, integrations, data, AI, engineering and legacy applications, including non-mainframe legacy estates, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization opportunities and portfolio-level priorities Target Architecture Modernization Pathways: Shape target-state modern architecture, reference technology stacks and modernization pathways across enterprise platforms, applications and legacy estates, helping clients make informed choices across regarding remediation Modernization Roadmap, Business Case Decision Governance: Translate modernization ambition and strategy into sequenced roadmaps, investment cases, decision frameworks and governance mechanisms that help clients prioritize initiatives, manage trade-offs and realize measurable business value

Role Overview

We are looking for a Technology Modernization Strategy Architecture leader with deep expertise in enterprise technology modernization, application modernization and modernization-led architecture strategy across all layers of IT landscape including architecture, application, data, AI, cloud, engineering and IT operations.

The role requires a senior consulting practitioner who can engage confidently with CxO and business leadership, shape the modernization value agenda, assess complex technology and application estates, drive target architecture and modernization pathway discussions, and translate business ambition into executable transformation roadmaps and value cases.

The successful candidate will be expected to evaluate complex technology estates, define modern target state, structure initiatives needed to achieve the target state, identify modernization pathways and guide clients through practical, sequenced transformation choices.

The role requires strong executive presence, structured problem solving, deep modernization expertise across IT landscape and the ability to guide senior clients through practical trade-offs across business value, technology debt, cost, risk, resilience, scalability and long-term architecture fit.

Key Responsibilities


Technology Modernization Strategy and Roadmap


Lead enterprise-wide technology modernization strategy engagements across complex technology landscapes

Define modernization ambition, strategic intent and business-aligned technology modernization priorities

Assess current-state technology estates across applications, platforms, architecture, integration, data, infrastructure and vendor ecosystems

Identify modernization opportunities, technical debt, architecture constraints, platform gaps, business risks and value pools

Shape target-state architecture and reference technology stack aligned to business priorities and enterprise architecture direction

Define modernization guiding principles, decision prioritization frameworks to support consistent technology choices

Advice on vendor, platform and ecosystem strategy, including fitment of cloud platforms, enterprise platforms, integration platforms and modernization partners

Build multi-year modernization roadmaps sequenced by business value, technical dependencies, cost, risk, complexity and readiness

Develop modernization value cases linking technology investments to measurable outcomes such as agility, resilience, scalability, cost efficiency, reduced technology debt and speed-to-market


Application Modernization Strategy, Architecture Planning


Lead application estate assessments covering business criticality, technical health, architecture fit, complexity, dependencies, cost, resilience, scalability and modernization potential

Assess aging and legacy application estates, including non-mainframe legacy applications, to identify technical debt, business risk, modernization constraints and transition priorities

Define application modernization pathways for target applications

Conduct application decomposition and domain analysis to identify modernization boundaries, dependency clusters, migration waves and sequencing options

Shape target application architecture and transition architecture across applications, platforms, integration and data dependencies

Define phased modernization approaches, coexistence models, migration plans and dependency management approaches that protect business continuity

Advice on modernization patterns such as modular architecture, API-led integration, microservices, event-driven architecture, cloud-native enablement, strangler pattern and platform-based modernization

Support data liberation and migration considerations required to reduce dependency on aging systems and enable future-ready application architecture

Develop app modernization roadmaps and value cases aligned to enterprise modernization strategy, architecture direction and business priorities


Executive advisory and Growth

Job

Summary :As a Digital Marketing Platform Consultant, you will be responsible for designing, building, and implementing strategies to enhance business performance using Customer Data Platforms and other digital marketing tools. Your typical day will involve working with clients to solve customer-facing challenges in sales, service, and marketing, and developing solutions to meet those requirements.

Roles & Responsibilities


Conduct assessment of client's current data management and Customer Data Platform (CDP) capabilities. Provide recommendations on optimizing the current stack and develop use cases to improve utilization .


Gather business requirements and strategize and build client's digital marketing data management program that delivers high-performance profiles for segmentation, personalization & activation across digital channels.

Evaluate and recommend new ways of data management through CDP and how it connects into the broader marketing technology landscape (campaign management and insight generation).

Understand and convey the impact of regulations like CCPA, GDPR and client's own internal or industry regulation on data gathering and management. Guide towards privacy by design, consent management for customer profile activation across digital marketing channels.


Understand and design integrations (including API-based/file-based integrations) between tools/platforms of different vendors/ MarTech /AdTech components/data sources.


Stay abreast of MarTech landscape & engage ecosystem players/vendors to ensure best-in-class digital audience management capabilities for clients. Propose and conduct pilots as needed.


 Qualification 

Professional & Technical Skills


Must Have

Skills:
Proficiency in Customer Data Platform, Adobe Experience Platform, Digital Audience Management.


Strong understanding of marketing processes, data management, data strategy, data integration, marketing & advertising technologies, and their integrations with other technologies.



Experience in developing and maintaining digital marketing data management programs.


Experience in debugging and troubleshooting digital marketing platforms.


Experience in working with marketing technology solutions such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Tealium.



Additional Information


The ideal candidate will possess a strong educational background in business administration or a related field, along with a proven track record of delivering impactful solutions using digital marketing platforms.


This position is based at our Mumbai, Bangalore , Gurgaon, Hyderabad, or Pune office.

Job Title: Data Analyst
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Pune
Department: Customer & Retail Analytics
Employment Type: Full-time
About FedEx: FedEx provides customers and businesses worldwide with a broad portfolio of transportation, e-commerce, and business services and also serves our customers through our retail presence. We foster an environment of growth and learning, where innovative ideas are encouraged, and diverse teams are valued for their contributions. As part of our commitment to excellence, were seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join our analytics team.
Job Summary: As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in gathering, processing, and analyzing data to drive informed decision-making and actionable insights for FedEx. Your quantitative expertise and business acumen will help develop analytical solutions to improve operations, customer experience, and business outcomes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to develop meaningful data analysis, insights summarizations/ visualizations and communicate findings that guide strategy and operational decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets using Python and SQL to support business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, formulate analytic solutions, and provide actionable insights.
Develop and maintain data models and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.
Create meaningful data visualizations to communicate findings, trends, and actionable insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Conduct exploratory data analysis and identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for business improvement.
Support data quality initiatives, ensuring accuracy and consistency across data sources.
Utilize statistical and quantitative techniques to support problem-solving and business optimization efforts.
Mandatory Skills:
Python: Proficiency in data manipulation, data analysis libraries (Pandas, NumPy), and data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
SQL: Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and complex queries.
Business Acumen: Ability to understand business context and objectives, aligning analytics with organizational goals.
Quantitative Aptitude: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
Data Visualization: Basic skills in data visualization to effectively communicate insights.
Statistical Analysis: Foundational understanding of statistical methods (e.g., regression, hypothesis testing).
Communication Skills: Ability to distill complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Good-to-Have Skills:
Power BI: Experience with Power BI for data visualization and report development.
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts for deeper pattern analysis.
Advanced Excel: Skills in advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, and data cleaning for quick analyses.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably within the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and a collaborative mindset.
Join Our Team: If you are passionate about Data analytics to drive business impact and enhance the customer experience, we invite you to join our team at FedEx. Apply now to be part of a dynamic, innovative environment where your skills and expertise will make a difference.
Application Process: To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications. Qualified candidates will be contacted for further evaluation.

Manage and mentor a team of functional consultants and business analysts.

Team Leadership & Collaboration:

Provide guidance on troubleshooting, performance tuning, and solution optimization.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into system functionality.

System Maintenance & Support:
Ensure the continued smooth operation of the SAP CO module by providing technical support and troubleshooting.
Oversee regular system upgrades, patches, and performance tuning for SAP HANA.
Monitor and ensure data integrity and consistency across financial and controlling modules.

Continuous Improvement:
Identify opportunities to enhance SAP CO processes and tools for greater efficiency and accuracy.
Stay updated on the latest SAP innovations, particularly SAP S/4 HANA and best practices in CO and finance modules.

Experience:

Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Education:
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certifications (e.g., SAP certifications, PMP) are a plus.

Experience with other SAP modules (e.g., SAP MM, SD, and FI).
Knowledge of financial reporting and compliance requirements.
Ability to work effectively with business users and senior leadership.
Experience with SAP Fiori, SAP Analytics Cloud, or other reporting tools is a plus.

Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients realize exceptional value from AI in software delivery, a boardroom priority for organizations globally and be at the forefront of shaping how enterprises adopt AI-native software engineering
Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Enterprise AI Value Strategy
Level: Consultant
Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad
Years of Exp: 5+ years
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe software engineering is entering a new AI-native era? Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and engineering leaders rethink how software is imagined, designed, built, tested, secured and delivered using AI? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and work with global clients to shape the next frontier of enterprise software delivery using AI. Working with C-suite stakeholders, you will help enterprises adopt AI-native software delivery at scale and turn transformation ambition into measurable outcomes. You will help enterprises define AI-powered software delivery transformation strategies and translate them into executable approaches, define target state SDLC, create platform and tooling strategy and architecture, engineering productivity measures, delivery operating model change and measurable value realization.
The Practice - A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through engineering transformation initiatives, aimed at making software delivery powered by AI to bring productivity and quality uplift, resulting in larger enterprise value delivery.
You are:
A workstream owner. You take a defined part of an engagement end-to-end - the agent hierarchy for a process, or use-case and data-product definition for a domain - and are its day-to-day client contact.


Qualification
The work
Basic Requirements
Basic Requirements
* Assist in discovery workshops to identify business opportunities and translate them into AI use cases, business cases, and solution requirements.
* Design end-to-end agent-driven business process flows and define agent hierarchies, help define AI solution blueprints, and high-level reference architectures.
* Develop functional specifications and collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to deliver implementation-ready solution designs.
* Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise data, data management, and analytics to shape AI solution design and business outcomes.
* Evaluate AI platforms, tools, and industry best practices to support solution recommendations and client engagements.
Good to Have
* Experience defining data products, enterprise data models, and AI-ready data foundations.
* Exposure to knowledge graphs, knowledge layers, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Experience developing AI capability roadmaps, AI platform assessments, and value realization plans.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, stakeholder communication, and presentation skills with experience working in cross-functional teams
Tech fluency
Hands-on depth in at least one platform (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake), or foundation models (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI)., plus conversant across the categories. Can weigh trade-offs (fit, cost, risk) within an engagement.
Industry Lens:
Working knowledge of one priority industry's processes and value drivers; applies it to use-case and roadmap work..
Role Summary
Min. 5 yrs overall, incl. AI & data projects
High-value consulting or relevant industry/functional experience
Engages senior stakeholders
Structured problem-solving; program management
Strong communication

Qualifications & Certifications
Bachelor's degree (relevant discipline); MBA preferred
What's in it for you?
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions - underpinned by the world's largest delivery network - Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. About Accenture Strategy & Consulting:
Accenture Strategy shapes our clients' future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers and communities. This is our unique differentiator. To bring this global perspective to our clients, Accenture Strategy's services include those provided by our Capability Network - a distributed management consulting organization that provides management consulting and strategy expertise across the client lifecycle. Position Title: Credit Research
Experience Level: 3+ Years
Department: Investment Research
Location: Gurgaon / Bangalore / Pune
Position reports to: Associate Director
Job Summary
We are seeking intelligent, independent, and self-motivated individuals to be part of our Fundamental Credit Research team - one of the fastest growing vertical of the company.
The candidate should have a subject matter expertise in covering the Banking and Insurance sector; an experience in covering sovereign and supranational issuers would be an added advantage. The analyst would be responsible for providing issuer rating/recommendation on the issuers under her/his portfolio. This would be achieved through detailed fundamental review, by initiating and maintaining coverage on issuers through detailed models and preparing the investment summary report. The candidate should demonstrate ability to think on feet, adapt to situation and provide actionable investment commentary and opinion on the issuers.
The candidate should have excellent verbal and written communication skill as there will be a daily interaction with the on-shore investment managers.
The individual will be part of the Fixed Income team based out of Bangalore. The team covers a wide variety of fixed income instrument issuers spanning across global, sectors and asset classes.

Initiating coverage on issuers by building detailed credit specific models and initiation reports
Preparing opinionated research piece on key events, tracking quarterly earnings on companies under coverage
Liaise with investor relations to seek responses and understand key issues
Responsible for client interaction and managing client expectations
Timely updation of sector dashboards
Core Skills / Competencies
Subject matter expertise in Banking and Insurance
Good verbal and written communication skills
Ability to provide actionable commentary and opinion on key events, issuers, rating recommendations
Understanding of the capital structure of bank and instrument tiering
Education: MBA (Finance), CFA and FRM is an added advantage
Job requires extremely high level of attention to detail, meticulousness and accountability
Abide by TAT and improve customer satisfaction over the period

Enterprise AI Value Strategy- Senior Manager
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to help our most strategic clients realize exceptional value from AI in software delivery, a boardroom priority for organizations globally and be at the forefront of shaping how enterprises adopt AI-native software engineering
Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Enterprise AI Value Strategy
Level: Senior Manager

Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad

Years of Exp: 14+ years

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you believe software engineering is entering a new AI-native era Are you a problem solver who enjoys helping CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and engineering leaders rethink how software is imagined, designed, built, tested, secured and delivered using AI Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and work with global clients to shape the next frontier of enterprise software delivery using AI. Working with C-suite stakeholders, you will help enterprises adopt AI-native software delivery at scale and turn transformation ambition into measurable outcomes. You will help enterprises define AI-powered software delivery transformation strategies and translate them into executable approaches, define target state SDLC, create platform and tooling strategy and architecture, engineering productivity measures, delivery operating model change and measurable value realization.
The Practice - A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clients- most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through engineering transformation initiatives, aimed at making software delivery powered by AI to bring productivity and quality uplift, resulting in larger enterprise value delivery.
You are:
A portfolio owner and enterprise advisor for reinvention. You set the process-reinvention agenda across accounts, shape enterprise agentic architecture and operating-model change, build the practice, and own the book of business.


Qualification
The work
Basic Requirements
Shape enterprise AI strategy and advise C-suite stakeholders on AI-led business, technology, and functional transformation.
Lead executive discovery sessions to identify enterprise AI opportunities and define AI transformation roadmaps, investment priorities, and value realization strategies.
Define enterprise AI and data architecture, including AI platform strategy, agentic architectures, enterprise data strategy, data products, semantic layer, and target-state AI capabilities. (with technical depth and agentic system build experience in 1 platform or functional area - GCP, AWS, Snowflake, DataBricks, Azure, Anthropic)
Develop executive business cases, AI maturity assessments, value frameworks, and AI & data roadmaps to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.
Lead multidisciplinary consulting teams across strategy, architecture, data, engineering, and change management while owning executive relationships and client outcomes.
Drive practice growth through GTM development, solution innovation, proposal leadership, and AI opportunity origination.
Good to Have
Experience designing enterprise operating models, organization redesign, and workforce transformation strategies for AI-native enterprises.
Experience defining AI governance, Responsible AI, AI risk, and compliance frameworks.
Experience shaping large AI transformation deals, strategic partnerships, and technology ecosystem alliances.
Strong executive communication, thought leadership, and consulting skills with experience influencing CxO decision-making and leading enterprise-scale AI transformation initiatives.
Tech fluency
Deep in at least one platform (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake), or foundation models (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI) and able to shape
Industry Lens:
Deep expertise across one or more priority industries (Consumer Goods, Retail, Life Sciences, Banking); sets the reinvention agenda for their core processes and is seen externally as a voice in it.
Role Summary
Min. 14 yrs overall, incl. AI & data projects (solutioning, designing, or delivering)
High-value consulting; large-scale delivery with minimal oversight
C-suite advisory experience on operating-model and process change
Working knowledge of AI governance and regulation
Structured problem-solving; program management; strong communication
Qualifications & Certifications
Bachelor's degree (relevant discipline); MBA preferred
What's in it for you
An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Working directly with the leadership team; having a high level of work independence, autonomy, and
empowerment to lead company-wide changes


Flexible working hours
Being part of a start-up from an early stage, lead your area of expertise and be a part of this exciting growth
journey of changing the real estate world


Excellent platform for learning how to build teams, achieve goals and handle high-growth situations. Ideal
for people with entrepreneurial ambitions.
Uncapped variables based on performance

Performance Bonus
Corporate Health Insurance
Travel Allowance
Monthly R&R awards
Early promotions for the outstanding performers

Job description: SAP BW4/HANA L3 Support and Enhancement.
A BW/4HANA L3 Support Engineer requires advanced technical support for SAP BW/4HANA systems, resolving complex issues escalated from lower support levels. This role requires deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA architecture, data modelling and troubleshooting techniques. Key responsibilities include analysing and resolving critical incidents, performing root cause analysis, and collaborating with development teams for long-term solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Troubleshooting and Resolution: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues related to SAP BW/4HANA, often involving performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, or system errors.
Root Cause Analysis: Conduct thorough root cause analysis to identify the underlying causes of issues and implement preventative measures.
Collaboration: Work closely with L1 and L2 support teams, development teams, and other IT teams to resolve issues and improve system stability.
System Monitoring: Monitor the health and performance of SAP BW/4HANA systems, proactively identifying and addressing potential problems.
Knowledge Management: Document solutions, troubleshooting procedures, and best practices to build a knowledge base for future reference.
Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior support engineers.
Incident Management: Manage critical incidents (P1 and P2 tickets) and ensure timely resolution.
System Enhancement: Contribute to the development and implementation of solutions to improve system performance and stability.
Required Skills & Experience:
Deep knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA: Including data modelling, data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Advanced troubleshooting skills: Ability to analyse complex issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
Strong communication and collaboration skills: Ability to effectively communicate with various stakeholders, including business users and technical teams.
Experience with SAP BW/4HANA administration: Including system configuration, performance tuning, and security.
Experience with ABAP development: For data extraction and transformation.
Knowledge of HANA platforms: (e.g., Native HANA modelling, AMDP) is often preferred.
Experience with incident management and ticketing systems: 3-5 years of experience is required.

COMPUTER TEACHER JOB DESCRIPTION
Position

Computer Teacher
Responsibilities
Provide quality computer training to students in the assigned school and conduct classes
online when required.
Plan and deliver engaging, age-appropriate computer lessons using clear explanations,
demonstrations, activities, and practical sessions.
Conduct regular computer laboratory/practice sessions and guide students through
hands-on exercises.
Prepare lesson plans, teaching materials, presentations, worksheets, assignments, and
practice exercises.
Conduct students assessments in a timely manner, including class tests, practical
assessments, assignments, and project work.
Evaluate student performance, provide constructive feedback, and support students who
require additional guidance.
Maintain student assessment data, attendance, records, and documentation of the
programs work in the school.
Use student-centered teaching methods and encourage participation, questioning,
problem-solving, creativity, and practical learning.
Maintain classroom discipline and ensure responsible use of computers, internet
resources, and laboratory equipment.
Conduct classes as per applicable government guidelines and the school’s academic
requirements.
The instructor has to conduct classes at ZPHS.
Support school-level administration of the project and complete project-related work
assigned by the reporting officer.
Coordinate with school staff and the reporting officer regarding schedules, student
progress, assessments, and program activities.
Deliver sessions in English and the official language of the state, as required.
Technical Skills
Strong knowledge of computer fundamentals, operating systems, file management, and
basic troubleshooting.
Proficiency in MS Office applications such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Knowledge of internet usage, email, online safety, digital citizenship, and basic cyber-
safety practices.

Knowledge of coding/programming concepts and ability to teach age-appropriate coding
through languages or platforms such as HTML, CSS, Python, Scratch, or similar tools.
Ability to conduct practical computer laboratory sessions and guide students through
coding and application-based exercises.

Ability to use digital teaching tools, online classrooms, presentations, multimedia
resources, and educational software.
Basic understanding of computer hardware, peripherals, networking concepts, and
common software installation/troubleshooting.
Ability to prepare digital learning materials, assessments, and student-performance data.
Teaching & Classroom Skills
Create structured lesson plans aligned with the prescribed curriculum and
government/school guidelines.
Explain technical concepts in simple, student-friendly language and adapt teaching to
different learning levels.

Use demonstrations, practical exercises, group activities, projects, quizzes, and real-
world examples to make lessons interactive.

Monitor student understanding during lessons and provide timely remedial support.
Manage classroom and computer-lab behavior while promoting a safe, respectful, and
inclusive learning environment.
Track learning outcomes and use assessment results to improve teaching and student
support.
Encourage students to develop logical thinking, problem-solving, creativity, digital
confidence, and responsible technology use.
Qualifications
B. Tech (any branch), MCA, or M.Sc. (Computer Science).
Any graduation with coding training certification.
Candidates with M. Tech / B. Ed. are given preference.
Experience
1+ years of experience in IT training, with familiarity in assessments, evaluation, and
practice sessions.

Location

Nagaland (Wokha)

Description:
Trainee, Program Implementation
Location: Nagaland, Haryana
About Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical
Antarang Foundation runs 2 programs: 1) Career Aware with students of municipal schools and low-income private schools studying in 9th and 10th standard across Mumbai, Pune, Udaipur and Goa. 2) Career Ready with students of low-income private junior colleges studying in 11th and 12th standard across our five geographies. The role of Program Operations and Logistics Sub-vertical is to provide end to end support to the facilitators and partner schools/colleges to be able to deliver the program with the required quality. From orienting the schools/colleges at the start of the year, distributing the books/materials to them, allocation of facilitators, to ensure data comes back on a timely basis and gets scanned and uploaded on to our systems, we do it all.
Position Overview
If you have a knack for management, multi-tasking, problem solving coupled with the traits like consistency, spontaneity and dependability, this is the place you may want to be in.
This position is an opportunity for you to impact the career journeys of more than 60,000 young adults and you will need to do everything to make their experience with us, a smooth and memorable one. You will specifically have a very important role in working with our High-tech OMR scanner to ensure student information gets uploaded on our systems timely and accurately. This is a Full-time position and requires an dependable and committed candidate who has an eye for detail.
Responsibilities
Data Management and Upload (PRIMARY): Ensuring filled OMR sheets come back on a timely basis from facilitators
Checking if the sheets are filled as expected, else getting it rectified with facilitators
Scanning approx 2000 sheets per hour on our high tech scanner and and doing minor troubleshooting if required
Operations and Administration: Sorting and Packaging of student books and getting it couriered to schools
Operations and Administration: Managing the storage of books and scanned OMRs and optimum utilization of office space.
Operations and Administration: Packaging of gifts/momentos if required and couriering it to all the Headmasters
Operations and Administration: Maintaining the inventory of medium wise books and other program Related materials
Vendor Management: Coordinating with the vendors (Courier, Books printing and Scanner) to get the tasks done
Vendor Management: Maintaining the bills/invoices and submitting it to the Finance department
Communication: Coordinating with Headmasters to share the progress and solve for the issues Escalate it on a timely basis to ensure speedy resolution of the same
Communication: Keeping the internal teams looped in to seek their support and inputs
Communication: Writing emails to the stakeholders in reference to the task in hand
Student Support and Tracking: Making student support calls to collect information and tracking their journeys post of our programs
Student Support and Tracking: Maintaining, updating the database with the same and preparing reports
Student Support and Tracking: Interpreting data from dashboards and reporting trends to the team.
Profile Requisites
Minimum 1-year commitment required with 8.5 hrs per day
Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks
Clear verbal and written communication, knowledge of local language
Tech Savvy (comfortable using Microsoft Office; confident of learning to operate scanners, dashboards)
Ability to do a certain task multiple times with focus without getting bored
Readiness to give hand and feet support even at odd hours (if and when required).
