Description:
Job Description - Agency Manager

Position: Agency Recruitment Development Manager

Channel: Integrated Agency
Location: Patna

Role Overview:
To recruit, train, and develop a team of Insurance Advisors / Agents and generate business through them. The role involves both recruitment and field sales management to achieve monthly business targets.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Agent Recruitment
- Source and recruit new Insurance Advisors from the local market
- Conduct 2-3 recruitment interviews daily
- Assist candidates with IRDA examination, Licensing, and Code generation
- Recruit a minimum of 4-5 quality Advisors per month

2. Agent Activation & Development
- Ensure new Advisors issue their first policy within 30 days of joining
- Train Advisors on products, sales pitch, and objection handling
- Conduct joint calls and accompany Advisors for customer meetings
- Re-activate inactive Advisors

3. Business Generation
- Achieve monthly targets for Premium and Number of Policies (NOP) through the team
- Track daily Advisor activity - Calls, Meetings, and Follow-ups
- Participate in branch campaigns, contests, and drives

4. Agent Engagement & Retention
- Conduct weekly Advisor meetings, training, and motivation sessions
- Recognize and nominate top performers for R&R and contests
- Resolve Advisor queries related to commission, payouts, and processes

5. Compliance
- Ensure all business is done as per IRDA guidelines
- Verify Advisor KYC and documentation

Requirements:
- Strong interest in sales and people management
- No job gaps in last 2years
- Two-wheeler preferred for field work
- Local market knowledge will be an added advantage

Vehicle Finance Loan is a growing business for Ujjivan SFB. The Team Leader - Vehicle Finance Loan is an important position that will drive this business in the respective clusters through RO-BC [feet-on-street]
Build efficient team of Relationship officers/Business Correspondents in the clusters assigned

Non-Financial Size

Description:
Hiring: Field Officer / Centre Manager Microfinance
Position: Field Officer / Centre Manager
Industry: Microfinance / Financial Services
Location: Bihar
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 0–3 years (Freshers can also apply for Field Officer roles)
Job Description
We are looking for Field Officers / Centre Managers to join our microfinance operations in Bihar. The candidate will be responsible for managing customers/groups, conducting field visits, ensuring timely loan repayments, and supporting business growth while maintaining high service and compliance standards.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct regular field visits and customer meetings.
Identify and onboard new customers and form JLG/SHG groups.
Explain loan products, repayment schedules and company policies to customers.
Conduct customer verification and ensure proper KYC/documentation.
Manage centre meetings and maintain customer relationships.
Ensure timely collection of loan instalments.
Follow up on overdue accounts and maintain portfolio quality.
Monitor customer repayment behaviour and identify potential risks.
Resolve customer queries and complaints professionally.
Maintain accurate records and submit daily/weekly reports.
Achieve assigned business and collection targets.
Follow company policies, ethical collection practices and applicable regulatory guidelines.
Candidate Profile
Minimum 12th pass / Graduate preferred.
Experience in microfinance, banking, NBFC, sales or field collection will be an advantage.
Freshers with good communication skills may apply for Field Officer positions.
Good communication and customer-handling skills.
Basic knowledge of smartphones and mobile applications.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned area.
Knowledge of Hindi and local language/dialect preferred.
Candidates should be target-oriented, responsible and comfortable working in rural/semi-urban areas.

1. Sit at the PMJAY help desk and welcome patients and attendants, explaining the scheme, its benefits, and the cashless treatment process in simple Hindi and the local language.

11. Take part in health awareness and enrolment drives, and refer patients to other government schemes where relevant.
12. Handle patient grievances politely and escalate them to the hospital management or the State Health Agency (SHA), Bihar helpline when needed.

Job Description: Parent Relationship Manager Inside Sales

Position: Parent Relationship Manager Inside Sales
School: ORCHIDS The International School
Location: Thane - Mumbai , Adgaon and Terna - Aurangabad

Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Admissions / Inside Sales

About the Role:

ORCHIDS The International School is looking for a highly motivated, target-oriented, and parent-focused Parent Relationship Manager Inside Sales to drive admissions and build strong relationships with prospective and existing parents.
The role will be responsible for managing admission enquiries, counselling prospective parents, conducting systematic follow-ups, converting qualified leads into admissions, and ensuring a smooth parent journey from the initial enquiry through enrolment.
The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and convincing skills, a strong customer-service mindset, and the ability to understand parent requirements and recommend the school's offerings appropriately.
Key Responsibilities
Lead Management & Inside Sales
Handle inbound and outbound calls with prospective parents regarding school admissions.
Respond promptly to leads generated through calls, website enquiries, digital campaigns, walk-ins, referrals, and other channels.
Understand the family's requirements, child's age/grade, preferred curriculum, location, and other admission-related needs.
Explain the school's curriculum, academic approach, facilities, co-curricular activities, fee structure, admission process, and key differentiators accurately.
Qualify leads based on defined admission criteria and maintain systematic follow-up.
Convert prospective parent enquiries into school visits, counselling sessions, applications, and confirmed admissions.
Follow up with prospective parents through calls, WhatsApp, email, and other approved communication channels.
Maintain consistent engagement with leads throughout the admission funnel.
Handle objections related to fees, curriculum, location, transport, academics, facilities, and competition in a professional and solution-oriented manner.
Achieve defined monthly and annual admission and conversion targets.
Parent Counselling & Relationship Management
Build trust and establish strong relationships with prospective parents.
Understand parent expectations and provide personalized counselling based on their child's needs.
Address parent questions and concerns professionally and provide accurate information.
Guide parents through the complete admission journey, from enquiry to registration and documentation.
Maintain regular communication with high-potential and pending leads.
Follow up with parents after school visits and counselling sessions to understand their decision-making stage.
Ensure a positive and professional parent experience throughout the admissions process.
School Visits & Admissions Conversion
Coordinate and schedule school visits/campus tours for prospective parents.
Work closely with the front office, academic coordinators, and school leadership to ensure a smooth campus-visit experience.
Follow up with parents after visits and identify opportunities for conversion.
Assist parents with application forms, required documentation, assessments, and other admission formalities.
Track each lead from initial enquiry through final enrolment.
Identify potential drop-offs in the admission funnel and proactively reconnect with parents.
CRM & Data Management
Maintain accurate and up-to-date lead information in the CRM/admission management system.
Record all calls, interactions, follow-ups, parent requirements, visit details, and lead status.
Ensure timely follow-up on all open and pending leads.
Maintain accurate sales funnel and pipeline data.
Prepare daily/weekly/monthly reports on:
New enquiries
Qualified leads
Calls and follow-ups
School visits
Applications
Conversions
Admissions
Lost/deferred leads
Conversion ratios
Analyse lead data to identify opportunities for improving conversion rates.
Sales & Target Achievement
Meet or exceed assigned lead conversion, admission, revenue, and follow-up targets.
Maintain a healthy admissions pipeline and prioritize high-intent leads.
Develop effective follow-up strategies for undecided and deferred parents.
Re-engage old, inactive, and lost leads where appropriate.
Track competitors and understand parent preferences and market trends in the local area.
Share market feedback and parent insights with the Admissions and School Leadership teams.
Contribute ideas for improving the admissions funnel and parent conversion journey.
AboutCompany: Orchids The International School is one of India's leading chains of CBSE and ICSE schools, with 90+ schools across the country. Orchids found their first home in Hyderabad. Job Title: Team Leader - HNI Dealing - Branch Broking

Company Name: Bajaj Broking

Job Description
As a Team Leader - Branch Broking, you will be responsible for driving individual business performance as well as leading the branch dealing team to achieve overall business objectives. The role involves managing your own HNI client portfolio, generating revenue through client acquisition and trading activities, and simultaneously guiding the team to achieve their respective targets.

You will be accountable for individual revenue generation, team productivity, client acquisition, retention, and overall business growth while ensuring superior client servicing, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate, and manage the team to achieve overall business and revenue targets.
Drive team-level revenue generation, client acquisition, activation, and retention.
Monitor individual team members' performance and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
Support team members in acquiring new clients, increasing client engagement, and improving revenue productivity.
Oversee trading activities across equity, derivatives, Nifty, and stock options.
Ensure timely sharing of stock, sector, and market updates with clients.
Handle key HNI relationships and resolve escalated client queries.
Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and develop team capabilities.
Coordinate with research and internal teams to provide relevant investment insights and strategies.
Ensure accurate trade execution, documentation, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance requirements.
Track individual and team performance through regular business reviews and reporting.
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, operational efficiency, and overall client experience.
Coordinate with Branch and Regional leadership to achieve business objectives.
Achieve assigned individual revenue targets through HNI client acquisition, relationship management, and trading activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA will be an added advantage.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in dealing, sales, or business development within the financial services industry, preferably with exposure to HNI clients.
Prior experience in team handling or a supervisory role will be preferred.
Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity, derivatives, and investment products.
Strong leadership, communication, relationship management, and people-management skills.
NISM Series VIII Certification is mandatory.

Job Description & Candidate Preparation Guide
Career Development Ocer (CDO)
1. About Jaro Education
Jaro Education is India's most trusted online higher education company and a pioneer in the executive
and online education industry. Founded in 2009 by Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe, the company has been self-
funded and protable since inception. Jaro Education has been honored with the EdTech Leadership
Award and recognized as a National Best Employer by the World HRD Congress.
Jaro Education bridges the gap between top-tier global academic institutions and ambitious
professionals. The organization nurtures entrepreneurs and working executives across entry-level to C-
Suite roles through strategic aliations with globally renowned universities and business schools,
including:
IIMs: IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Indore, IIM Kozhikode, IIM Mumbai, IIM Nagpur, IIM Tiruchirappalli,
IIM Visakhapatnam
IITs and IIT-linked institutions: IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Jammu, IIT Palakkad, IIT Roorkee,
E&ICT Academy IIT Kanpur, E&ICT Academy IIT Guwahati, IITM Pravartak IIT Madras
Technology Innovation Hub
Other premier Indian institutions: IISc, XLRI, IMT Ghaziabad, Loyola Institute of Business
Administration (LIBA), IFEEL Institute for Future Education, Entrepreneurship and Leadership,
MIT Institute of Design / MIT IDSS, Niranjan Hiranandani School of Real Estate & HSNC University
Indian Universities and Higher Education Partners: Adani Institute of Digital Technology
Management, Amity University, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Bharati Vidyapeeth / BVDU,
Chandigarh University, Dayananda Sagar University (Bengaluru), Dr. D. Y. Patil Vidyapeeth
Centre for Online Learning (DPU-COL, Pune), Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute, JAIN
Online, MAHE Manipal Academy of Higher Education, Manipal University, Manipal University
Jaipur, Parul University, Sikkim Manipal University, Symbiosis International (Deemed University) /
SSODL
Global Academic and Executive Education Partners: Deakin University (Australia) & KPMG
in India, Harvard Business Impact, Imperial College Business School Executive Education, Rotman
School of Management (University of Toronto) & IITM Pravartak, Wharton Interactive
Company Vision: To be globally recognized for providing a seamless learning platform for professionals
around the world.
Page 1 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Company Mission: To make high-quality, outcome-oriented executive education accessible to every
student and professional at all stages of their career.
2. Role Overview & Snapshot
The Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist plays a critical role in driving
business growth by engaging with working executives, assessing their career goals, and counseling them
on higher education options. This is an end-to-end sales and counseling role that combines lead
generation, relationship building, and consultative program matching.
Designation
Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist
Admissions & Executive Education Sales
Department
Target Audience
Working Days
Working Professionals, Corporate Executives & Freshers
Monday to Saturday (Sunday Weekly-O)
10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (Note: Shift may stretch basis business
requirements)
Working Hours
Dress Code
Mon Fri: Business Formals | Saturday: Smart Casuals
Primary CRM Tool
LeadSquared
3. Key Responsibilities & Performance Expectations
High-Volume Lead Outreach & Prospecting
¢ Connect daily with a minimum of 80 working professionals sourced from the LeadSquared CRM
database to build a healthy sales pipeline.
¢ Initiate conversations using cold-calling and warm lead nurture strategies, establishing rapid rapport
with high-potential prospects.
Consultative Counseling & Needs Analysis
¢ Analyze candidate professional backgrounds, current skills, domain expertise, and future career
aspirations.
¢ Identify skill gaps and recommend optimal executive programs, degree courses, diplomas, or
certications from Jaros university partners.
¢ Conduct structured telephonic, virtual, or in-person counseling sessions detailing curriculum
highlights, faculty credentials, learning methodologies, and career outcomes.
Page 2 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
End-to-End Sales Execution & Enrolment
¢ Guide prospects through the complete sales funnelfrom cold calling to lead nurturing, objection
handling, fee negotiation, and nal enrolment closures.
¢ Maintain consistent, personalized follow-up schedules with high-intent leads to maximize conversion
rates.
¢ Meet or exceed assigned daily activity deliverables, weekly conversion targets, and monthly revenue
metrics.
Operations & Data Management
¢ Maintain accurate, real-time records of lead statuses, meeting notes, follow-up dates, and payment
stages in LeadSquared.
¢ Coordinate closely with internal Admissions, Student Support, and Operations teams to ensure a
seamless onboarding experience for enrolled learners.
¢ Stay up-to-date with evolving EdTech trends, institutional accreditation updates, and competitor
oerings.
4. Candidate Prole & Prerequisites
¢ Education & Experience: Bachelors degree in any discipline. Freshers with exceptional
communication skills or candidates with prior sales/EdTech outreach experience are preferred.
¢ Communication Skills: Fluency in English with strong verbal, written, and persuasive articulation
capabilities.
¢ Sales Mindset: High competitive drive, negotiation skills, objection-handling capability, and comfort
working in target-driven environments.
¢ Interpersonal Skills: Empathy, active listening, and the ability to build immediate rapport with mid-to-
senior working professionals.
¢ Technical Savvy: Basic familiarity with Microsoft Oce (Excel, Word) and CRM applications like
LeadSquared.
5. Career Growth Pathway
¢ Structured Career Path: Opportunities to transition from CDO to Senior CDO, Team Leader,
Assistant Manager, and Business Manager based on performance and target achievements.
Page 3 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Interview Preparation Kit
Please review the following instructions and preparation guidelines before attending your interview with
Jaro Education.
A. General Interview Hygiene & Rules
1. Professional Appearance: Dress in business formals (MonFri style) to demonstrate
professionalism.
2. Technical Setup: Ensure a stable high-speed internet connection, functional camera/microphone,
and a silent, distraction-free environment for virtual meetings.
3. Communication Delivery: Keep answers crisp, structured, and focused. Avoid lengthy anecdotes
or o-topic details.
4. Energy & Condence: Demonstrate high energy, enthusiasm, and articulate speech throughout
the conversation.
5. Past Employer Etiquette: Maintain a strictly positive, objective, and factual approach when
discussing previous employers. Do not speak negatively about former companies or colleagues.
B. Fundamental Concepts to Master
1. What is EdTech?
Denition: EdTech (Educational Technology) refers to the integration of technology, software, and
hardware tools into educational processes to enhance learning accessibility, engagement, and
eectiveness.
Industry Context: Explain why online higher executive education is essential todayallowing
working professionals to upskill without pausing their full-time careers.
2. What is Consultative Selling?
Denition: A sales approach focused on prioritizing the buyer's needs, challenges, and goals rather
than aggressively pushing a product.
Application at Jaro Education: As a CDO, you do not simply "sell a course." You rst identify a
professionals career bottlenecks, understand their skill gaps, and then recommend the specic
executive program that aligns with their career growth.
Page 4 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
C. Sample Interview Questions & Preparation Strategies
Important Note: Interview questions may change from person to person depending on individual
candidate proles and interviewer evaluation. The questions below are representative FAQ example
types to aid your preparation.
¢ "Walk me through your resume and key achievements."
Tip: Focus on your outreach metrics, target achievements, past sales/counseling experience, and
everyday responsibilities.
¢ "Why do you want to build a career in the EdTech industry?"
Tip: Highlight the rapid growth of the online education sector, your passion for career counseling, and
the impact of upskilling working professionals.
¢ "How do you handle a candidate who says the program fee is too high?"
Tip: Demonstrate consultative sellingreframe the fee as a long-term career investment, highlight the
prestige of partner institutes (e.g., IIMs, IITs, Wharton Interactive, Harvard Business Impact), and
discuss nancial exibility (EMIs, loan support).
¢ "What is your reason for leaving your current/previous role?"
Tip: Provide an honest, professional, and growth-oriented answer (e.g., seeking better exposure,
career progression, or entry into the EdTech industry).
¢ "How do you explain gaps in your career (if applicable)?"
Tip: Be transparent, condent, and concise. Explain how you utilized the gap period productively
(certications, skill-building, personal responsibilities).
D. Quick Checklist Before Joining the Interview
Researched Jaro Educations company background, leadership (Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe), vision, and
mission.

Memorized key partner institutions across categories (e.g., IIMs, IITs, IISc, XLRI, Wharton Interactive,
Harvard Business Impact).

Prepared to explain past key performance indicators (KPIs), call targets, and sales achievements.

Reviewed the core denition of Consultative Selling and EdTech.

Dressed in crisp business formal attire.

All the best for your interview!

Job Summary
As a Consultant you will help the team deliver and contribute to the profitable growth by ensuring client engagements are executed in an efficient manner.
Responsibilities
Your client responsibilities: Conduct the engagement in a professional manner and in accordance with client expectations and as defined by the terms and conditions of the contract.
Preparation and filing of individual tax return, e-TDS return, drafting of submissions before tax authorities, representation before the tax authorities.
Advising on outbound/inbound structuring in connection with movement of employees, working knowledge of immigration and provident fund in connection with expatriates, etc.
Your people responsibilities: Exhibit positive attitude and demonstrate willingness to learn.
Work constructively with team to evaluate and improve personal and team performance.
Contribute and leverage knowledge from individuals, databases and other sources.
Provide timely and high-quality services and work products that exceed client expectations.
Operational Excellence / Day to day responsibilities: Participate in executing work within a group by assisting by delivering work effectively, and teaming with tax professionals to provide comprehensive tax solutions.
Ensure that the areas of work assigned are executed in accordance with the work programme and the firms methodologies and guidance, and professional standards.
Use electronic working papers, efficiently including various software applications and sources of knowledge in an appropriate manner to conduct research.
Acquire and demonstrate competence in technical knowledge, and compliance process by keeping up to date on trends, developments and technical authorities and apply them to moderately complex situations.
Analyze and convert data into a tax product (advisory/compliance) and ensure accuracy and timeliness of the product.
Where applicable thoroughly check documents and make available for tax inspections in an appropriate manner.
Demonstrate professionalism through a positive and cooperative attitude and by maintaining the confidential and proprietary nature of client relationships and related work products.
Contribute to the overall success of the team by developing a thorough understanding of our methodologies and tools to enhance service delivery; keeping team members informed of work status; actively seeking assignments when unassigned; proactively seeking opportunities to provide tax services; challenging traditional procedures used in the past; and attempting to find new approach.
Skills and attributes for success
Good Communication skills (Written & Oral)
Proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
Strong Analytical/Numerical ability
Enthusiastic and Self Starter
Team Player
Ability to grasp details
Good time management skills
Good interpersonal skills
To qualify for the role you must have
A certified CA
0-1 year of relevant experience
Ideally you'll also have
Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative
Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.

Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity: Associate Consultant-AMI-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Process & Controls - Ahmedabad
AMI :
The Advanced Manufacturing, Mobility & Infrastructure (AMI) Industry Market contains the following industries: Aerospace and Defence, Chemicals, Infrastructure, Industrial Products, Automotive, and Transportation that includes Mobility-as-a-Service. We help our clients to address the rapidly changing needs of our business world on not only how goods and services are bought and sold, but also on how they are designed and created. AMI builds and shares resources across sectors facing common challenges and aims to drive more effective cross-sector collaboration while enabling greater resource-pooling and developing more cohesive market responses. AMI also presents an opportunity to connect regional sector communities with a more robust, global priority sector infrastructure.
CNS - Risk - Process & Controls :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
Your key responsibilities
Assist in the execution of internal audit, risk advisory and controls assessment engagements under the guidance of senior team members. Develop an understanding of business processes, operational activities and organizational objectives to identify key risks and controls. Support process walkthroughs, documentation reviews and testing activities to evaluate control effectiveness. Analyze financial, operational and transactional data to identify trends, exceptions and potential areas of concern. Prepare working papers, process flows, risk and control matrices (RCMs), and other engagement documentation in line with EY methodology. Support the review of policies, procedures and business practices against internal requirements and leading practices. Demonstrate strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, along with a commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
Skills and attributes To qualify for the role you must have Qualification
Bachelor of Commerce
Master of Commerce
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science
Bachelor of Technology in Mechanical Engineering
Master of Technology in Civil Engineering
Experience
Relevant Technical Experience (0 to 2 years)
Governance, Risk and Compliance (0 to 2 years)
Internal Audit (0 to 2 years)
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Job Summary
The opportunity: Consultant-AMI-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Process & Controls - Ahmedabad
Overview
The Advanced Manufacturing, Mobility & Infrastructure (AMI) Industry Market contains the following industries: Aerospace and Defence, Chemicals, Infrastructure, Industrial Products, Automotive, and Transportation that includes Mobility-as-a-Service. AMI builds and shares resources across sectors facing common challenges and aims to drive more effective cross-sector collaboration while enabling greater resource-pooling and developing more cohesive market responses. AMI also presents an opportunity to connect regional sector communities with a more robust, global priority sector infrastructure.
CNS - Risk - Process & Controls :
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
Your key responsibilities Technical Excellence
Execute internal audit, risk advisory and controls assessment engagements across various business functions and industries. Develop an understanding of client business models, key processes, operational workflows and associated risks to support effective engagement delivery. Perform process walkthroughs, risk assessments, control testing and substantive procedures in accordance with EY methodology. Analyse financial, operational and transactional data to identify trends, anomalies, control gaps and improvement opportunities. Prepare high-quality working papers, process documentation, risk and control matrices (RCMs), and client deliverables. Support the review of policies, procedures and governance frameworks to assess compliance with internal and external requirements. Collaborate effectively with engagement teams and client stakeholders.
Qualifications
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science
Bachelor of Technology in Mechanical Engineering
Master of Technology in Civil Engineering
Bachelor of Commerce
Master of Commerce
Chartered Accountant
Experience
Relevant Technical Experience (0 to 2 years)
Governance, Risk and Compliance (0 to 2 years)
Internal Audit (0 to 2 years)
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
Associate Consultant - Risk - Internal Audit
Job Summary
The objective of our advisory risk services is to provide clients with a candid and reliable overview of their risk landscape. Our solutions can be used by our clients to build confidence and trust with their customers, the overall market and when required by regulation or contract.
You will be responsible for executing client related engagements in the areas of governance, risk compliance (GRC), internal audits, process reviews, standard operating procedures, enterprise risk management, revenue assurance.
Responsibilities
Execution on client engagement - Ensure quality delivery as per client requirements.
Review of working papers and client folders. Suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
Understand business industry issues / trends. Identify areas requiring improvement in the clients business processes to enable preparation of recommendations.
Handling data analytics - Access, ACL etc.
Ensure compliance with engagement plans and internal quality risk management procedures.
Awareness of internal auditing standards issued by IIA and ICAI.
Demonstrate an application solution-based approach to problem solving technique.
Manage the engagement budgets and support superiors in developing marketing collaterals, business proposals and new solution / methodology development.
Develop strong working relationships with client (process owner/functional heads).
Attention to detail and mentor young interns and analysts within the practice.
Contribute to knowledge management sessions within the practice.
Brief the engagement team on the client's IA environment and industry IA trends.
Maintain relationships with client management to manage expectations of service, including work products, timing, and deliverables.
Demonstrate a thorough understanding of compliance, financial, and operational risks along with performing internal control testing, develop internal audit plans, and provide internal audit services on an outsourcing basis.
Assess internal controls and SOX framework in order to mitigate risk and apply it to client situations.
Bring and utilize extensive knowledge of the client's business/industry to identify technological developments and evaluate impacts on the client's business.
Skills and Competencies
Data analytics
Internal audit
GRC
SOX
Process improvement
Stakeholder relationship management
Knowledge management
Methodology development
Budget management

Overview
A Growth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.

Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot  issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job Summary
The opportunity: Consultant-FS-TAX-TAX - GCR - Global Compliance Reporting - Ahmedabad
Responsibilities
Strong working knowledge of Indian income tax provisions and their application to corporate and cross-border transactions. Proficient in international tax principles, including transfer pricing, withholding tax, and permanent establishment considerations. Hands-on understanding of Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements (DTAA) and their practical application to treaty benefits and tax residency. Good understanding of IFSCA regulations and their tax and compliance implications for entities operating in International Financial Services Centres. Applies general consulting frameworks to structure tax analysis, identify risks, and recommend compliant solutions for global clients.
Qualifications
Chartered Accountant
Experience
Chartered Accountant (0 to1 year)
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Key Responsibilities
1. Quality Strategy & Leadership
Develop and implement manufacturing quality assurance strategies and improvement plans.
Establish manufacturing process quality standards, specifications, and controls.
Utilize data-driven decision-making to enhance quality performance.
Provide quality performance reporting to management and stakeholders.
Mentor and support quality professionals where applicable.
Deliver quality awareness training and coaching to manufacturing personnel.
2. Customer Quality Focus
Support fulfillment of customer-specific quality requirements.
Analyze customer complaints, feedback, and quality concerns.
Participate in cross-functional initiatives aimed at improving customer satisfaction.
Translate customer expectations into manufacturing process improvements.
3. Quality Management System (QMS)
Develop and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and process controls.
Conduct process audits and compliance assessments.
Ensure adherence to quality standards, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Train manufacturing teams on quality management practices and risk mitigation methods.
4. Manufacturing Quality Assurance
Conduct Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA).
Identify manufacturing and assembly process risks.
Develop and implement risk mitigation plans.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to eliminate potential quality failures.
Monitor effectiveness of risk controls and preventive actions.
Maintain and update risk assessments throughout the product lifecycle.
Manage change control activities related to:
Product features
Manufacturing processes
Materials
Suppliers
Design modifications
5. Quality Control
Implement quality control plans and inspection requirements.
Conduct process audits, inspections, and verification activities.
Analyze test results, measurements, and statistical quality data.
Identify trends and improvement opportunities through data analysis.
Recommend and implement corrective actions to improve quality performance.
6. Process Performance Management
Monitor key process performance indicators.
Analyze manufacturing performance data and trends.
Support implementation of Statistical Process Control (SPC) techniques.
Maintain process performance documentation.
Drive corrective and preventive actions to improve process capability and efficiency.
Train operators and manufacturing teams on performance monitoring methods.
7. Non-Conformance Management
Investigate process and product non-conformities.
Lead root cause analyses using structured problem-solving methodologies such as:
8D
5 Why Analysis
Fishbone Diagram
Statistical Analysis Tools
Implement and verify effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
8. Continuous Improvement
Lead and support continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations.
Identify opportunities to improve:
Process capability
Product quality
Productivity
Cost efficiency
Operational performance
Participate in Lean and Six Sigma projects.
Facilitate waste reduction and process optimization activities.
Prioritize and execute improvement projects based on business impact.
Authority & Accountability
The position is accountable for:
Quality risk identification and mitigation.
PFMEA development and maintenance.
Manufacturing quality assurance activities.
Process audit execution.
Quality performance monitoring.
Continuous improvement project execution.
Supporting customer quality requirements and compliance.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Respond and attend to guest repair requests. Communicate with guests/customers to resolve maintenance issues. Perform preventive maintenance on tools and kitchen and mechanical room equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines. Carry equipment (e.g., tools, radio). Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves for equipment and all utility shut-offs for buildings. Maintain maintenance inventory and requisition parts and supplies as needed. Communicate each day s activities and problems that occur to the other shifts using approved communication programs and standards. Display basic knowledge or ability to acquire knowledge in the following categories: air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry and finish skills, kitchen equipment, vehicles, energy conservation, and/or general building. Perform all surface preparation, painting, minor drywall and wood trim repair, light bulb and A/C filter replacement and the complete and thorough cleanup of the painting or repair area. Test, troubleshoot and perform basic repair on all types of equipment, plumbing (e.g., plunge toilets and unclog drains), electrical components including lamps, cosmetic items, extension cords, vacuum cleaners, internet devices, replace electrical switches and outlets, and other guestroom items. Program TVs and perform general housekeeping and engineering-related inventory duties. Use the Lockout/Tagout system before performing any maintenance work. Perform repairs on interior and exterior landscaping as well as external landscaping sprinklers. Display basic computer skills including inputting air handler schedules and making temperature changes.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications; and properly store flammable materials. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Adhere to quality expectations and standards. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and heavier lifting or movement tasks with assistance. Move up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Enter and locate work-related information using computers. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Some experience in general maintenance, exterior and interior surface preparation and painting.
Experience in hotel engineering or maintenance a plus.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
License or Certification: Driver s License

The role requires strong commercial acumen, deep expertise in technology sourcing, and the ability to structure and negotiate complex, multi-year agreements that deliver measurable business value. Operating as a senior individual contributor, this role partners with Director and VP-level stakeholders across North America, Europe, and APAC to shape demand, influence sourcing strategies, and drive optimal commercial outcomes. The role is accountable for sourcing excellence, procurement governance, contract compliance, and continuous improvement across the source-to-pay lifecycle. The successful candidate must bring hands-on expertise in SaaS agreements, supplier redlines, and complex IT services negotiations, working closely with Legal and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve successful contracting outcomes. Page 1 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Sourcing & Project Delivery Lead end-to-end sourcing projects of up to USD 15 million across SaaS, enterprise software, cloud, telecom, managed services, and IT services. Develop sourcing strategies covering supplier segmentation, RFx design, commercial structures, TCO and cost models, negotiation plans, communications, and award recommendations. Conduct market analysis, benchmarking, and cost modelling to identify value levers, savings, and cost-avoidance opportunities. Own complex sourcing initiatives aligned with business priorities, procurement KPIs, and committed outcomes. 2. Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management Lead complex negotiations for SaaS subscriptions, software licensing, cloud services, managed services, telecom, and IT professional services. Review supplier contractual redlines and collaborate with Legal, Information Security, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders to resolve issues and drive agreements to closure. Structure agreements to optimize pricing, service levels, contractual protections, risk allocation, and long-term value. Manage contract lifecycle activities including drafting, negotiation, validation, execution, renewals, amendments, Statements of Work, and Change Requests. Clearly articulate negotiation strategy, tactics deployed, stakeholder alignment, and measurable commercial outcomes. 3. Procurement Compliance & Governance Own and enforce compliance with sourcing policies, approval thresholds, controls, and governance frameworks. Ensure correct usage of procurement tools, approved workflows, and standardized processes, including SAP Ariba and ServiceNow. Act as an escalation point for contract compliance and ensure contracts accurately reflect approved commercial and legal positions. Perform compliance checks across SOW, CR, Purchase Request, and Sourcing Request processes and maintain audit-ready documentation. Partner with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Security, IT, and Audit teams to protect governance integrity and mitigate risk. Page 2 Kraft Heinz India GCC | Global Procurement Solutions 4. Supplier & Contract Management Lead supplier evaluation, selection, onboarding, and performance management based on category strategy and defined criteria. Drive supplier consolidation, innovation, performance improvement, cost efficiency, and long-term value creation. Manage supplier risks using structured governance, KPIs, scorecards, and quarterly business reviews. Build strategic partnerships with global suppliers across North America, Europe, and other relevant geographies. 5. Value Creation & Continuous Improvement Identify and implement improvements across sourcing and procurement operations. Drive demand optimization, supplier rationalization, AI-enabled sourcing, RFx optimization, and intake workflow automation. Develop reusable sourcing frameworks, templates, playbooks, and best practices. Support procurement transformation and maturity-building initiatives within the GCC. 6. Stakeholder Management Advise and influence global stakeholders and category leads to shape sourcing strategies and optimize outcomes. Collaborate with Category Managers, Finance, Legal, IT Directors and VPs, Information Security, and business teams across geographies. Align sourcing activity with broader category, regional, and enterprise objectives. Operate effectively across time zones, particularly with North American and European stakeholders. 7. Mentorship & Team Support Act as a senior mentor and knowledge leader within the Buying Desk. Guide junior team members on complex sourcing events, negotiations, contracting challenges, and problem-solving. Drive knowledge sharing, capability development, and procurement upskilling initiatives. Description:
Role & responsibilities

To ensure that all loose grocery staples (rice, wheat, pulses, spices, sugar, flour, etc.) are
processed and packed in the factory to meet FSSAI and regulatory standards and company
quality standards before reaching customers.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Raw Material Quality Checks
• Inspect incoming loose staples for quality parameters (moisture, infestation, purity,
grain size, colour, odour, foreign matter).
• Verify supplier quality certificates and conduct sampling/testing.
2. In-Process Quality Control
• Monitor packing lines to ensure correct weight, sealing, labelling, batch coding, and
hygiene.
• Ensure FEFO/FIFO practices in usage of raw materials and packaging materials.
• Conduct line clearance checks before production runs.
3. Finished Goods Quality
• Inspect packed products for compliance with defined standards (net weight,
labelling, shelf life, seal integrity).
• Retain samples for shelf-life studies.
4. Food Safety & Compliance
• Ensure the factory follows FSSAI, HACCP, GMP, and hygiene norms.
• Monitor pest control, sanitation, and staff hygiene.
• Support internal/external quality audits.
5. Documentation & Reporting
• Maintain inspection logs, QC reports, and non-conformance records.
• Raise corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) with production & purchase teams.

Job Summary
As a product specialist, RM Retail Institutions and Government Banking Business will be responsible for acquisition of new to bank retail institutional customers through self-sourcing as well as through mapped branches, relationship management and deepening of portfolio of retail institutional customers of the mapped branches of the Branch Banking of the assigned regions / territory / clusters.

Size of the Role

Non-Financial Size
Owns the total Retail Institutions and Government Banking Business incremental budget of the assigned regions / territory / clusters / branches.
Responsible for achieving fee targets of cross-sell products like CMS, POS, QR, TPP and other solutions.
Interact and collaborate with digital alliances partners of the bank

Ensure high CASA ratio by sale of CASA accounts to retail institutional customers and maintaining quality of acquisition.


Key Duties and Responsibilities of the Role

Business/ Financials
Create and develop strategy / plan for Retail Institutions and Government Banking Business sales and value build up and ensure its implementation in the assigned territory.

Description:
Job Description Factory / Plant Manager:
Job Overview
We are looking for an experienced Factory / Plant Manager to lead the overall operations of our manufacturing plant. The role will be responsible for ensuring efficient production, quality, safety, regulatory compliance, cost control, and effective people management.
The incumbent will work closely with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, Supply Chain, HR and other functions to ensure smooth and efficient plant operations while maintaining statutory and company standards.

Key Roles & Responsibilities
1. Plant & Production Management
Lead end-to-end plant operations and ensure achievement of production targets.
Plan and monitor production schedules, capacity utilization and operational efficiency.
Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machinery, materials and other resources.
Monitor production losses, downtime, wastage and overall plant productivity.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce operational costs.
2. Quality, Food Safety & Compliance
Ensure adherence to applicable quality, food safety, statutory and regulatory requirements.
Ensure compliance with company SOPs, quality systems, safety standards and audit requirements.
Coordinate with Quality teams to maintain product quality and hygiene standards.
Ensure timely closure of observations arising from internal, external and regulatory audits.
Maintain necessary plant documentation, records and compliance requirements.
3. Maintenance & Engineering Coordination
Coordinate with Engineering/Maintenance teams to ensure maximum machine availability.
Monitor preventive and breakdown maintenance activities.
Identify recurring equipment issues and drive corrective and preventive actions.
Ensure proper planning of maintenance activities without impacting production.
4. People Management
Lead, develop and manage plant employees across functions and shifts.
Ensure adequate manpower availability and effective manpower deployment.
Set clear performance expectations and monitor team performance.
Develop a culture of discipline, accountability, safety and continuous improvement.
Identify training and capability-building requirements for plant employees.
Handle employee-related operational issues in coordination with HR.
5. Stakeholder Management
Act as the key point of coordination between the plant and corporate functions.
Work closely with Quality, HR, Procurement, Supply Chain, Sales and other stakeholders.
Coordinate with external agencies, vendors, contractors and relevant authorities as required.
Ensure effective communication and timely resolution of operational issues.
6. Safety & Hygiene
Ensure strict adherence to plant safety, hygiene and housekeeping standards.
Drive awareness and compliance with safety procedures across the plant.
Identify potential safety risks and ensure appropriate corrective actions.
Promote a strong safety culture among employees and contractors.
7. Cost & Resource Management
Monitor plant operating costs and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
Ensure efficient utilization of raw materials, packaging materials, utilities and manpower.

Job description of this profile as follows:
Credit Manager will be responsible for evaluating, underwriting, and managing the credit risk associated with vehicle loans (including new/used CV loans, two-wheelers, 3-Wheelers, Electric vehicles). This role focuses on assessing creditworthiness, ensuring zero fraud, streamlining loan turn-around-time (TAT), maintaining a healthy portfolio quality, and achieving a sustainable balance between business growth and risk mitigation.

Core Responsibilities:
1. Credit Underwriting & Risk Assessment:
Evaluate loan applications for wheels products based on internal credit policies, financial statements, bank statements, Bureau records (e.g., CIBIL), and field verification reports.
Identify potential red flags, financial stress, or fraudulent documentation early in the underwriting lifecycle.
Assess the buyer's repayment capacity, cash flows (especially for self-employed individuals and commercial operators), and the valuation/LTV (Loan-to-Value) ratio of the vehicle being financed.

2. Portfolio Quality & Monitoring:
Track early mortality accounts and manage the non-performing asset (NPA) percentages within the assigned geography or product category.
Monitor monthly bounce rates, overdue accounts, and collection trends to proactively alter credit guidelines if specific segments show high risk.
Conduct periodic portfolio reviews and sample audits of disbursed cases to ensure absolute policy compliance.

3. TAT Management:
Ensuring quick Turn-Around-Time (TAT) from application login to final credit sanction without compromising risk standards.

Key Candidate Requirements:
Candidates should have 4-5 years' experience in credit underwriting of Wheels product.
Relevant experience in credit underwriting within an NBFC or bank.
Good understanding of bureau reports, income assessment, banking analysis, credit policies, and lending processes.
Ability to independently evaluate credit proposals and recommend appropriate credit decisions within delegated authority.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and sound credit judgment.

Job Title: Intern
Department: Operations
About Business line/Function: The Operations team includes different business units such as Securities Services, Wealth Management, Global Banking Operations, Markets Operations (back office & middle office) and Client engagement & Financial Securities.
These business units provides services to global clients across Asia, Europe & US region offering a wide range of services, which include custody operations, fund accounting, middle-office operations, static data management, trade clearing and settlement operations, securities lending, corporate action, Tax Operations, AML / KYC and other transversal services.
Position Purpose: The purpose of the roles is to provide service to Clients and their Portfolios related activities pertaining to different markets across the globe. 
The incumbent will be managing the daily operations/workflow within the business group and helps the Leads in achieving the process deliverables. 
Responsibilities
Processing of transactions within the agreed timelines
Ensure all the transactions are completed and approved in the system within the TAT /SLA
Ensure all the transactions are processed with at most care without errors/mistakes.
Prioritize the work and conduct investigation with due diligence on all the discrepancies.
Taking corrective measures/action in consultation with the Leads
Escalate unresolved open items to the Leads
Maintain Communication Channels with internal peer groups.
Participate in Cross Training and ensure the Knowledge transfer between the team and processes is happening on periodic basis.
Participate in Brainstorming Sessions and share the best practices and ideas with the peer groups and team members.
Consistently evaluate and update documented procedures to ensure they are complete, accurate and current
The position interfaces with other Process Associates, Mid Office Staff, Relationship Managers and Clients
The position interfaces with International Team Members of BNP Group and its Clients or Vendors or Sub-Custodians
Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure adherence to compliance and risk management policies and procedures. Identify and report any potential risks or compliance issues.
Quality Assurance: Conduct regular self-checks to ensure that all processes and transactions meet the required standards and guidelines.
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
The candidate should be able to read, write and speak in French language
Strong analytical skills, detail orientation, service commitment, solid organizational and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in shifts as required.
Specific Qualifications:
Graduation in any discipline
DELF B1 and above certification in French language
Location: Mumbai/ Chennai/ Bangalore
About BNP Paribas Group:
BNP Paribas is the European Unions leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Groups commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
About BNP Paribas India Solutions:
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

Data Engineer
Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Gurgaon, Chennai
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Building the machine learning production System(or MLOps) is the biggest challenge most large companies currently have in making the transition to becoming an AI-driven organization. This position is an opportunity for an experienced, server-side developer to build expertise in this exciting new frontier. You will be part of a team deploying state-of-the-art AI solutions for Fractal clients.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
As MLOps Engineer, you will work collaboratively with Data Scientists and Data engineers to deploy and operate advanced analytics machine learning models. You ll help automate and streamline Model development and Model operations. You ll build and maintain tools for deployment, monitoring, and operations. You ll also troubleshoot and resolve issues in development, testing, and production environments.
Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation Develop scalable ML pipelines
Develop MLOps components in Machine learning development life cycle using Model Repository (either of): MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry
Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML E2E PaaS/SaaS
Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components
Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud(AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem Be an integral part of client business development and delivery engagements across multiple domains.
QUALIFICATIONS: REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
3-12 years experience building production-quality software
Strong experience in System Integration, Application Development or DataWarehouse projects across technologies used in the enterprise space
Basic Knowledge of MLOps, machine learning and docker
Object-oriented languages (e.g. Python, PySpark, Java, C#, C++ )
Experience developing CI/CD components for production ready ML pipeline.
Database programming using any flavors of SQL
Knowledge of Git for Source code management
Ability to collaborate effectively with highly technical resources in a fast-paced environment
Ability to solve complex challenges/problems and rapidly deliver innovative solutions
Team handling, problem solving, project management and communication skills & creative thinking
Foundational Knowledge of Cloud Computing either one AWS, Azure or GCP
Hunger and passion for learning new skills
Recommended (not mandatory): completion of Fractal Data Science Professional Certificate" with this - https: / / www.coursera.org / professional-certificates / fractal-data-science
EDUCATION:
B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or related technical degree OR Equivalent.

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the worlds technology.

What We Offer

Location:
Bangalore,IND, Chennai,IND
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. Were committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, youll dive deep into ground-breaking technologieslike machine learning and AIto craft novel software solutions that solve our customers high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.
About Applied
Applied Materials is the leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels and on an industrial scale enables customers to transform possibilities into reality. At Applied Materials, our innovations make possible the technology shaping the future.


As a developer your primary responsibility will be to participate in the creation of new products and enhancements to existing products from concept to launch as part of a cross functional team. In this role you will utilize your experience to provide Software solutions which involves System understanding of the Product. You will also be required to work with various interfaces to ensure the completeness of the solution.

Key Responsibilities
Execute the design, analysis, or evaluation of assigned projects using sound engineering principles and adhering to business standards, practices, procedures, and product / program requirements
Design & code a variety of complex software features with adequate documentation
Write automation for new/existing features.
Customer Support & troubleshoot/fix a variety of difficult software problems. Proactively communicate on development status & delays in agreed upon timelines
Interface with global teams for requirements analysis and schedule.
Interface with external customers regarding software issues.
Be willing to travel to onsite locations for Short Term Assignments like Feature Integrations & Version Installations.

Qualification and Requirements
Bachelor's Degree / masters degree in engineering with Computer Science/Electronics/Electrical background and 10 years of experience
Minimum of 6 years experience in software development with exposure to maintenance, continuous integration & releases
Minimum of 4 years experience in core product software development
Strong Object Oriented Design & Programming Experience
Professional experience of Core Java Technologies (Design Pattern/Multi-threading/Data Structures/Algorithm)
Minimum 4 years proven work experience as a ReactJS Developer.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript, CSS , ES6+ and React/Redux.
Familiarity with RESTful APIs and modern front-end build pipelines and tools.
Ability to write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
Experience with testing frameworks such as Playwright.
Experience with version control systems, such as Git.
Good To Have
Knowledge of UI/UX principles and best practices.
Exposure to Agile methodologies and tool chain (like JIRA).
Has knowledge of best practices and how own area integrates with others.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Algorithm Development Manager to lead a high-impact team developing advanced computer vision, machine learning, and image processing solutions for next-generation semiconductor equipment systems. A successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with strong technical leadership to deliver innovative algorithm solutions that directly impact customer success and business growth.
Key Responsibilities

Leadership
Lead the development of advanced inspection and metrology algorithms for semiconductor wafer and advanced packaging applications.
Evaluate and incorporate emerging technologies in computer vision, image processing, machine learning, deep learning, and high-performance computing.
Define algorithm architecture, technical strategy, and development roadmaps aligned with product objectives.
Guide performance optimization for high-throughput production systems, including CPU, GPU, and parallel computing implementations.
Establish robust methodologies for algorithm quality, benchmarking, validation, characterization, and performance monitoring.
Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing algorithm engineering team.
Drive hiring, onboarding, succession planning, and career development while fostering a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning.
Product Development
Collaborate with product management and applications engineering to translate requirements into differentiated product capabilities.
Drive feature definition, prioritization, and execution plan across multiple product releases.
Lead the investigation and resolution of critical customer escalations and field issues.
Partner with software, HPC, and systems engineering teams across India and United States to deliver scalable and high-performance solutions.
Drive end-to-end ownership of algorithm development, from concept and prototyping through integration, optimization, qualification, and product release.
Collaborate with global teams to leverage common infrastructure, shared technology platforms, and best practices.
Minimum Qualifications
MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related technical discipline.
10+ years of experience algorithm development on large-scale hardware-centric system.
3+ years of technical leadership experience.
Strong programming skills in C++ and Python.
Experience with algorithm development for large-scale hardware-centric systems.
Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional projects.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in semiconductor inspection, metrology, or related semiconductor equipment industries.
Hands-on expertise in computer vision, ML/DL algorithms, and imaging systems
Experience with GPU programming and high-performance computing.
Strong technical communication skills.

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the worlds technology.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. Were committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, youll dive deep into ground-breaking technologieslike machine learning and AIto craft novel software solutions that solve our customers high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.
Role Responsibilities:
Analyze requirements, design, develop, and maintain complex software solutions.
Own feature development from design through implementation, testing, and deployment.
Define software specifications, architecture, and test strategies for new features.
Troubleshoot complex software issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement robust fixes.
Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions to ensure high-quality software delivery.
Collaborate with product management, cross-functional teams, and customers to understand requirements and manage dependencies.
Drive engineering best practices, technical excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Minimum Qualifications & Requirements:
B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field.
6+ years of experience in software product development.
Strong expertise in Core Java and modern Java features such as Streams, Functional Programming, Concurrency, and Virtual Threads.
5+ years of hands-on experience with Spring Boot and the Spring ecosystem.
4+ years of experience in software design, including HLD, LLD, OOAD, Design Patterns, SOLID, GRASP, Clean Code principles, and code reviews.
4+ years of experience designing and developing Microservices or SOA-based systems.
Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging systems (like RabbitMQ), and asynchronous distributed systems.
Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and performance optimization.
Experience using AI-powered engineering tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Rovo or similar tools to improve SDLC productivity.
Working knowledge of Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Willingness to travel to customer sites in the US, Taiwan and Korea as required.
Preferred Qualifications:
Semiconductor or Metrology/Inspection domain experience.
Experience in UI/front-end technologies (React, Angular, etc.).
Experience with workflow orchestration frameworks such as Temporal, Apache Airflow, or similar platforms.
