As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, youll dive deep into ground-breaking technologieslike machine learning and AIto craft novel software solutions that solve our customers high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.
About Applied
Applied Materials is the leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. Our expertise in modifying materials at atomic levels and on an industrial scale enables customers to transform possibilities into reality. At Applied Materials, our innovations make possible the technology shaping the future.
Responsibilities:

As a seasoned Software Architect, you will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable, reliable and maintainable software solutions for our organization.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to understand requirements and translate them into architectural/software designs that meet business needs.
You will be coding and developing quick prototypes to establish your design with real code and data.
You will be a subject Matter expert to unblock software engineers.
Conduct technical reviews and provide guidance to software engineers during the development process.
Identify and mitigate technical risks and issues throughout the software development lifecycle.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate technologies and frameworks to meet project requirements.
Lead the design and implementation of complex software components and systems.
Mentor and coach Tech Leads & s/w engineers.

Qualifications & Requirements:

12-18 yrs of experience with BTech / MTech in Computer Science.
Proven experience as a Software Architect or similar role with experience of 10+ yrs in product development.
Minimum experience of 10+ years in core Java & advanced features. E.g., streams, functional programming, virtual threads.
Minimum experience of 5+ years in Spring Boot & associated Spring features.
Minimum experience of 4+ years of driving/contributing towards HLD & LLD, contribution towards code reviews & coding practices (like clean code & SOLID principles)
Minimum experience of 4+ years in building and driving microservices based architecture or large-scale systems.
Strong algorithms & data-structures.
Experience in workflow frameworks. Examples - Temporal, Apache Airflow etc.
Experience in reactive programming.

Good to have:

Good knowledge of Semiconductor domain.
Design, prototype, implement and test software and computer vision machine learning algorithms in Python.
Experience with scikit-image, Tensor Flow, PyTorch.

Description:
The opportunity:
Hitachi Energy is a world leader that is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We are advancing the world's energy system to be more sustainable, flexible, and secure, and we collaborate with customers and partners to enable a sustainable energy future - for today's generations and those to come.
The Hitachi Energy Indian Operations Center (INOPC) is a competence center with around 3000+ skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, project Management, functional system testing, installation supervision, documentation and commissioning. However, over the last decade, it has evolved to become the largest Operations hub. The India Operations Centre team at Chennai, Bangalore and Gurugram supports Hitachi Energy's units in more than 40 countries across a wide portfolio of all the four business units in Hitachi Energy to date, the team has executed engineering and commissioning for projects in more than 80 countries.
How you'll make an impact:
You will be a part of the GIS Steel Structural Engineering team, you will be supporting as project lead engineer to develop project specific engineering documents and drawings for submission to customer and the documents required for manufacturing of Steel Support Structures for GIS equipment (transmission and sub-transmission systems).
You will be an individual contributor who would deliver the tasks as per the given inputs and when required need to work in coordination with other colleagues and should exhibit good collaborative skills to complete the task.
You may also interact with other departments like Primary Engineering, Secondary engineering, Project Management and Production units.
Project Planning and coordination with various internal & external stakeholders for a smooth project execution.
Preparation of Design calculation (in Staad. Pro, Idea-static & Hilti profits) of Steel Support Structures for Gas Insulated Switchgears above 66kV. (Contribution to Tekla modelling will be mandatorily required in certain projects).
Ensure all necessary inputs are available from stakeholders.
Prepare project specific Civil plan for customer providing GIS loading for design of customer building floor, ceiling cranes etc., Influence of environmental conditions on GIS structure designs etc.
Self-review & peer review of documents.
Delivery of designs on time with Quality and coordinating with the other team members and project lead engineer.
Directly responsible for maintaining and updating the documentation for respective projects as per quality process.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business
Your background:
Years of experience: 8 - 10 years with B.E/M.E. in Civil & Structural Engineering.
Hand on experience in Structural engineering using STAAD. Pro, Idea-static, Ansys & Hilti Profits software's.
Hand on experience in Tekla, Navisworks and other modelling software's.
Familiarity with codes and applicable standards necessary for Structural Modelling & Detailing (American, European, Canadian etc.) is Mandatory.
Team player with good communication and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge tools like AUTOCAD, MS Office etc.
Knowledge of Galvanization & painting procedures.
Knowledge of HSE standards like OSHA, DIN etc.. is mandatory.
Knowledge of international standards such as IEC/ IEEE / ANSI is preferable.
Knowledge of HV substation / HV products preferable.
Working knowledge of Tekla structures is an added advantage.

Description:
Power conversion - R&D Project Manager
Business Information:
Hitachi Energy India Development Centre (IDC) is a research and development facility with around 500 R&D engineers, specialists, and experts, who focus on creating and sustaining digital solutions, new products and technology. This includes product integration, testing, cybersecurity, and certification. The India Development Centre is situated in Chennai and Bangalore. IDC collaborates with the R&D and Research centres of Hitachi Energy, which are spread across more than 15 locations throughout 12 countries. In the past 20 years, IDC has secured more than 200 international papers and 150+ patents.
Job Description Summary
As our R&D Project Manager you will become one of the key persons in organizing the delivery of power quality solutions to the rest of our organization. In this role you will work directly with cross-functional team members to ensure that our solutions are delivered and executed in alignment with the overall delivery project priorities
How You'll Make an Impact
You will hold the overall responsibilities for the management of assigned R&D project within the power conversion business.
Act as key contact for the project. Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Managing and follow up suppliers.
Define all project plan deliverables, including scope, financial plans, and schedule.
Ensure that the project follows execution best practices and Hitachi Energy policies. Effectively monitor and control project progress and efficient resource utilization.
Monitor and control project financials according to budget and forecast of R&D work within the Power conversion domain.
Manage administrative tasks related to project management.
Stakeholder relations: Acts as key contact for the customer and an escalation point for project issues. Builds and maintains strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders and effectively communicates with all stakeholders.
Health, safety, and environment (HSE): Ensures the project follows and complies with company health, safety, and environmental policies.
Live Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity by taking responsibility for your actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your background
Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, Power Electronics, Control Systems, or a related engineering discipline.
Proven experience in project management for R&D in software/control system development, preferably within power conversion, grid integration, or high-power converter control software domains.
Possessing a Project Management Professional (PMP)® certification, along with relevant project management experience, is considered an additional advantage.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, SAP and Microsoft Project.
Highly proactive, organised, and structured working style, with a strong focus on quality, traceability, and delivery commitments.
Strong ability to lead cross-functional and globally distributed teams, coordinating across control engineering, software, hardware, testing and cybersecurity teams.
Excellent risk, issue, and change management capability.
Excellent ability to resolve issues, lead teams and work constructively with external and internal relations.
Confident leadership presence with the ability to guide teams through complex technical challenges and field escalations
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Job Description

MES Developer
Location: Pune, Bangalore
Experience: 2-6 Years
Join us to build and support next-generation Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions that drive operational excellence across automotive and discrete manufacturing environments.
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced MES Developer with 2+ years of hands-on experience in Manufacturing Execution Systems. The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in MES development, customization, and support, along with experience in automotive or discrete manufacturing industries. The role also requires exposure to AMS support, SLA management, and production support activities.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, customize, and configure MES solutions based on business requirements.
Provide functional and technical support for MES applications.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex MES issues to minimize production downtime.
Develop and maintain web-based reports and dashboards.
Ideal Candidate Profile
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in MES development and support.
Hands-on experience working in automotive or discrete manufacturing environments.
Strong technical skills in:
.NET, SQL,PL/SQL,MES
Experience with MES customization, configuration, and web reporting.
Exposure to AMS support models and SLA-driven environments.
Preferred Skills
Experience working under AMS contracts and support engagements.
Understanding of manufacturing operations and industry best practices.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong customer-focused mindset with proven service delivery experience.
What You'll Gain
Opportunity to work on enterprise MES implementations and support projects.
Exposure to leading automotive and discrete manufacturing clients.
Collaborative work environment with opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
Participation in digital manufacturing transformation initiatives.

Description:
SAP CPI Consultant JD

About the Role

We are looking for experienced SAP CPI Consultants to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting integration solutions using SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) and SAP Integration Suite.
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SAP CPI, SAP Integration Suite, iFlows, Groovy Scripting, OData Services, API integrations, and cloud-based integration scenarios. Experience in implementation, migration, enhancement, and support projects is highly preferred.

Location: Bangalore,Chennai,Mysuru,Noida,Nagpur,Mumbai,Hyderabad,Kolkata,Coimbatore,Thiruvanandhapuram,Mangaluru,etc

Experience: JL4: 2-5 Years | JL5: 5-9 Years

Roles & Responsibilities
Design, develop, and support integration solutions using SAP CPI and SAP Integration Suite.
Develop and maintain iFlows for cloud-to-cloud and cloud-to-on-premise integrations.
Create and enhance integration scenarios using SOAP, REST, IDoc, RFC, and OData services.
Develop custom integration logic using Groovy Scripts.
Configure adapters, mappings, content modifiers, routers, and exception handling mechanisms.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize integration interfaces.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams to understand business requirements and integration needs.
Perform unit testing, SIT, UAT support, defect resolution, and production support activities.
Prepare technical specifications and integration documentation.
Participate in implementation, rollout, migration, upgrade, and support projects.
Support SAP S/4HANA integration initiatives.
Ensure adherence to integration best practices, security standards, and governance processes.
Qualifications
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in SAP CPI/Integration Suite.
B.E./B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc/MBA or any Postgraduate degree.
Mandatory Skills
SAP CPI, SAP Cloud Platform Integration, SAP Integration Suite, iFlows, Groovy Script, OData Services, REST APIs, SOAP APIs, Message Mapping, API Integration, SAP Cloud Platform.
Good to Have Skills
SAP PO/PI, Event Mesh, SAP BTP, SAP S/4HANA Integration, Cloud Foundry, API Management, Open Connectors, GitHub, CI/CD, Java.

Description:
Business Information:
The Hitachi Energy Indian Operations Center (INOPC) is a competence center with around 2300 skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, project Management, functional system testing, installation supervision, documentation and commissioning. However, over the last decade, it has evolved to become the largest Operations hub. The India Operations Centre team at Chennai, Bangalore and Gurugram supports Hitachi Energy's units in more than 40 countries across a wide portfolio of all the four business units in Hitachi Energy To date, the team has executed engineering and commissioning for projects in more than 80 countries.
Mission Statement:
Understand and apply project documentation and execution practices in accordance with internal project control standard procedures/instructions in system.
Your Responsibilities:
Ensure adherence to quality standards, create reports, and provide analysis using project document trackers.
Should have experience in reading customer contracts and understand the project documentation requirements. Working knowledge with EMDS.
Analyze & upload Engineering and Supplier documents (new and revised) for Tender / Project into the DMS or common drive.
Create and control Document Registers and analyze & upload Engineering and Supplier documents (new and revised) for Tender / Project into the DMS or common drive.
Communicate with Project Manager and Departments for Clarifications and Suggestions
Handling Customer commented/approved documents in DMS and informing Project team.
Adding the documents into web-based database, for easy access for the members in different locations
Prepare the publishing documents packages for printing (hard copies), if needed.
After Customer Approval of project's final documents, hand over the Project to After Sales Department.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your background:
Non-Engineering - A diploma or bachelor's/master's degree.
5 to 8 years of experience as a document controller.
Proficiency in MS-Office Applications (Word, PPT and Excel).
Strong communication skills in written and verbal (English).
Capability to work with multi-cultural and multilingual users.
Quick learner, Proactive, Self-Motivated, and Flexible.

Description:
Job Summary
Hitachi Energy India Development Centre (IDC) is a research and development facility with around 500 R&D engineers, specialists, and experts focused on creating and sustaining digital solutions, new products, and technology. The India Development Centre is situated in Chennai and Bangalore. As a Project Manager/Owner to lead and coordinate R&D projects, this role involves managing projects, ensuring compliance with industry standards, and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Foster innovation in Grid control technologies by leading R&D projects with structured gate processes and leveraging tools like MS Project, Primavera, and Azure DevOps. Deliver impactful solutions efficiently through agile practices, strong cross-functional teamwork, and technical excellence within the R&D environment.
How you'll make an impact
You will be responsible for leading R&D projects from concept to validation, applying structured gate process frameworks.
To define project objectives and deliverables in alignment with organizational goals and customer requirements and develop comprehensive project plans, including scope, timelines, resource and budget allocations.
To Communicate project progress, risks, and issues effectively to all relevant stakeholders, executive leadership and facilitate timely decision by presenting facts and figure.
To Coordinate cross-functional teams including engineering, simulation, testing, and product development.
Managing third-party vendors and consultants involved in projects and ensure all project activities comply with industry standards, codes, and safety regulations.
To Identify potential risks and challenges in project execution and develop and implement mitigation strategies to minimize disruptions and ensure project success.
To foster a collaborative and results-driven work environment and inspire and motivate R&D teams and collaborate with resources from functions across the company. Need to work with teams spread across globally.
You will be responsible for ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Living Hitachi Energy's core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your background
Required bachelor's degree in electrical engineering master's or higher degree is a plus, with minimum 8+ years of experience in Power industry.
Knowledge on Project Management experience related to Power system testing, control and Protection in R&D Environment is required.
Experience in Power generation/FACTS/HVDC/ Substation automation or Renewable sources integration is an added advantage.
Proven experience with gate process methodologies and project management tools (MS Project, Primavera, Azure DevOps), with a strong track record of managing Agile workflows and DevOps practices in a technical R&D environment.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Ability to think strategically, understand the big picture and adjust available solutions to diverse audiences.
Experience in working in a multi-cultural team will be valued.
Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required.

Mission Statement:
Service Sales & Tendering Team Manager is responsible for leading the Service Sales and Tendering team to deliver high-quality, timely and competitive offers for service business opportunities. Team Leadership and People Development
Lead, coach and mentor the Service Sales and Tendering team, fostering accountability, collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.
Conduct regular performance and development discussions, define individual goals, identify competency gaps and support career growth.
Build team capability through structured onboarding, training, knowledge sharing and development of behavioral and functional competencies.
Drive recruitment, onboarding and resource readiness to support business expansion and future scope growth.
Promote diversity, inclusion, positive team dynamics and a healthy work environment.
Service Sales and Tendering Operations
Manage end-to-end service sales and tendering activities, ensuring alignment with customer requirements, timelines, quality standards and business expectations.
Oversee RFQ review, scope clarification, technical-commercial alignment, offer preparation, risk assessment, bid submission and post-offer support.
Provide guidance on tendering process flow, commercial governance, risk identification and quality of offer submissions.
Support scope addition, team scaling and long-term capability building to match evolving business needs.
Stakeholder and Business Collaboration

Ensure effective workload planning, prioritization of critical cases and visibility of long-pending offers or execution gaps.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives, process standardization, best-practice deployment and quality management system adherence.
Develop and maintain a roadmap for team growth, productivity improvement, competency development and future technology/tool adoption.
Administrative and Financial Responsibilities
Manage team administration, including resource planning, leave planning, onboarding support, infrastructure coordination and HR-related operational support.
Support business-related financial coordination such as offer submission tracking, purchase order follow-up, invoicing coordination and payment collection follow-up where applicable.
Ensure accurate reporting, timely updates and effective governance of team deliverables and business support activities.

10+ years of experience in Sales, Tendering, Front-End Sales, EPC or related functions.
Prior experience in managing teams, working with global stakeholders and supporting multi-location or global business environments will be preferred.
Experience in HV switchgear, Transformer, substations or service business.
Functional Skills
Strong knowledge of service sales, tendering process flow, commercial review, risk assessment and offer management.
Ability to manage sales processes, stakeholder requirements, timelines, quality standards and business priorities.
Working knowledge of CRM/Salesforce and Power BI will be an added advantage.
Strong analytical, organizational and risk management skills.
Leadership and Behavioral Skills
Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management and team-building abilities.

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Hitachi Energy is a world leader that is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We are advancing the world's energy system to be more sustainable, flexible, and secure, and we collaborate with customers and partners to enable a sustainable energy future - for today's generations and those to come.
The Hitachi Energy Indian Operations Center (INOPC) is a competence center with around 3000+ skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, project management, functional system testing, installation supervision, documentation and commissioning. However, over the last decade, it has evolved to become the largest Operations hub. The India Operations Centre team at Chennai, Bangalore and Gurugram supports Hitachi Energy's units in more than 40 countries across a wide portfolio of all the four business units in Hitachi Energy. To date, the team has executed engineering and commissioning for projects in more than 80 countries.
HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) and HVDC Light are highly efficient alternatives for transmitting bulk power and for special purpose applications. The classic HVDC technology is used to transmit electric power over long distances by overhead transmission lines or submarine cables. It is also used to interconnect separate power systems, where traditional alternating current (AC) connections cannot be used. HVDC Light is a power transmission technology developed by Hitachi Energy that offers additional benefits compared to HVDC Classic. You will work mainly with electrical design of main circuit equipment in projects with medium to high complexity.
Responsibilities
Supporting projects and tenders for HVDC System Design - managing the scope, budget and schedule while ensuring quality requirements are met
Be ready to be proactive and apply your project management and analytical skills.
Interface with other departments in HVDC organization, representing your System Design team in project and tender meetings and discussions, also representing System Design in customer meetings
Participate in technical design reviews and in technical problem solving
Responsible for the technical coordination of System Design deliveries as well as managing the risks and identifying opportunities to reduce time and cost while ensuring quality requirements are met
When you feel comfortable in the role you get the opportunity to manage complex projects on your own. In other words, your ambition is the foundation for your development opportunities!
Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business
Your Background
Educational qualification: Master's or bachelor's degree in Electric Power Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
Candidate should have 7 + years of project management experience from working in engineering and are familiar with managing system delivery projects or tenders.
HVDC system design knowledge is considered an asset.
You enjoy working in diverse and multicultural teams and are interested to share your experiences and knowledge with your colleagues as well as learn from them.
You are a flexible leader that enjoy problem solving and work in a structured way.
Fluency in English, additional languages are considered an asset.

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to build scalable AI systems that drive business value.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models.
Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for data ingestion, model training, validation, and deployment.
Work with large datasets to perform data cleaning, feature engineering, and exploratory analysis.
Deploy AI/ML models into production using cloud platforms and ML Ops practices.
Monitor model performance and retrain models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into AI solutions.
Research and implement the latest advancements in AI, Generative AI, NLP, Computer Vision, and Machine Learning.
Ensure adherence to data security, governance, and ethical AI standards.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Statistical Modeling.
Proficiency in Python and ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas, and NumPy.
Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, and data engineering concepts.
Familiarity with REST APIs and software development best practices.
Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in Machine Learning/AI development (adjust as needed).
Experience delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
Knowledge of NLP, Computer Vision, Recommendation Systems, or Agentic AI.
Familiarity with Spark, Databricks, and big data technologies.

Description:
Key Responsibilities
Act as the primary bilingual liaison between Japanese client stakeholders (HQ and regional teams) and the Oracle Cloud delivery team across requirement workshops, CRP/UAT cycles, and steering committee updates.
Support supply chain process workstreams planning, order management, procurement, inventory, and manufacturing — and, where relevant experience exists, contribute to configuration, testing, and rollout activities on the Oracle Cloud platform.
Translate and localise functional specifications, process flows, test scripts, and training materials between Japanese and English, ensuring technical accuracy is preserved.
Facilitate real-time interpretation during design workshops, CRP demonstrations, and issue-resolution calls with Japanese business and IT stakeholders.
Support fit-gap analysis and solution design for Japan-specific statutory, tax, and reporting requirements within Oracle Cloud (e.g. consumption tax, Japan GAAP nuances, e-invoicing).
Coordinate with onshore Japan-based teams and offshore delivery teams to manage cultural and time-zone alignment, escalations, and status reporting.
Contribute to test scenario validation, data migration reviews, and cutover planning for multi-country, multi-plant Oracle Cloud implementations in the automotive sector.
Support change management and end-user training delivery for Japanese-speaking plant and business teams.

Required Qualifications
Japanese Language Proficiency (Primary requirement): JLPT N3 minimum; N2 or above strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience using Japanese in a professional/business context (client calls, documentation, workshops).
Industry Background (Primary requirement): Prior experience on automotive OEM or Tier-1/Tier-2 supplier programmes — familiarity with JIT/JIS manufacturing, multi-plant/multi-country rollouts, and automotive-specific supply chain processes.
Oracle Cloud Knowledge (Good to have, not mandatory): Exposure to Oracle Cloud Supply Chain modules — Supply Planning, Order Management, Procurement, Inventory Management, Manufacturing, Product Hub/PLM — will be viewed favourably but is not a prerequisite.
Consulting Experience: Prior experience with a Big 4, global systems integrator, or automotive-industry consulting/coordination role; comfortable working in client-facing delivery roles.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Commerce, or a related field; any ERP or Oracle Cloud certification is a bonus, not expected.
Willingness to travel to client sites (India and potentially Japan) as required by programme milestones.

Preferred / Good to Have
Prior experience specifically supporting Japanese automotive clients (e.g. DENSO, Toyota Group, Honda, Nissan, Suzuki, or their Tier-1 supplier ecosystem).
Hands-on knowledge of Oracle Cloud Supply Chain modules from prior implementation, support, or super-user experience.
JETRO or other formal bilingual business-communication certification.
Prior experience as a bridge engineer, IT coordinator, or business analyst in a Japanese-client environment — candidates strong on language and automotive-industry fit will be considered even without direct Oracle exposure, with structured platform training provided on the job.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Growth Associate owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Dear Candidate,

Looking to build something meaningful for Indias MSMEs? Join Tata nexarc, a digital-first B2B platform from the house of Tata, as our Sr. Associate Operations.

About the role:
Own the end-to-end order journey for steel and bitumen raw material orders, from order verification to delivery and proof of delivery. You will be the face of Tata nexarc Operations for customers.

Key Responsibilities:
Manage the full supply chain lifecycle of assigned orders: order verification, documentation checks and seller dispatch coordination.
Monitor deliveries, collect Proof of Delivery (POD), and ensure quality and compliance requirements are met.
Track payments and customer credit limits as per SOPs and payment terms.
Maintain OTIF (On-Time In-Full) delivery performance of 85% or higher, and escalate exceptions early.
Validate documents: customer and seller POs, proforma and tax invoices, e-way bills, Mill Test Certificates (MTC) and delivery proofs.
Coordinate with transporters, fleet owners and drivers, and visit seller locations and transporter hubs when needed.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Graduate or postgraduate in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics or Engineering.
2–6 years in operations, supply chain, logistics or customer operations; steel experience preferred, bitumen or commodity exposure a plus.
Working knowledge of ERP, CRM and AI-enabled productivity tools.
Strong English and Hindi communication, stakeholder management, attention to detail and a bias for action.

Why Join Us:
Join a start-up from the house of Tata. Build the India Stack with a nation-first vision of uplifting SMEs, in a fast-paced culture built on Integrity, Pioneering, Unity, Responsibility and Excellence. You get high autonomy through agile cross-functional teams, and you will work on SME-focused products. Benefits include a hybrid work model, need-based health, wellness and childcare leaves, Tata group employee benefits, and medical, term life and personal accident insurance.


Skills: Order Management, Supply Chain, Logistics, OTIF, E-way Bill, MTC, Steel, Bitumen, ERP, Stakeholder Management .

If this sounds like you, apply now and be part of the Tata nexarc journey.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
The position assists with the soliciting and handling of sales opportunities. Ensures business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery. Assists in leading all day-to-day activities related to sales with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of sales objectives. Achieves personal sales goals.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Building Successful Relationships that Generate Sales Opportunities
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings. Activities include participating on sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc.
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for sales opportunities.
- Assists with managing and developing relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Provides accurate, complete and effective turnover to Event Management.
Managing Sales Activities
- Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
- Supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
Using Knowledge of Market Trends and Target Customer Information to Maximize Revenue
- Identifies new business to achieve personal and location revenue goals.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc. and knows how to sell against them.
- Assists in closing the best opportunities for the location based on market conditions and location needs.
- Gains understanding of the location s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Supports the company s service and relationship strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Services our customers in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes and supports the company s customer service standards.
- Provides excellent customer service consistent with the daily service basics of the company.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

About the Job:
We are looking for a dynamic and entrepreneurial Unit Sales Head to drive business growth and revenue for Manipal Hospitals. The role will focus on building and managing relationships with Corporate Clients, TPAs, Insurance Companies, Referral Networks, and Channel Partners, while identifying new business opportunities and strengthening sales channels. The ideal candidate should have strong healthcare sales experience, excellent relationship-management skills, and a proven track record of achieving business growth.

About Manipal Hospitals:
As a pioneer in healthcare, Manipal Hospitals is among the top healthcare providers in India serving over 8 million patients annually, with a focus on providing affordable, highquality healthcare services. Manipals integrated network today has a pan-India footprint of 49 hospitals across 24 cities with 12,600 licensed beds, and a talented pool of 11,000+ doctors and an employee strength of over 34000.
Manipal Hospitals provides comprehensive curative and preventive care for a multitude of patients from around the globe. Manipal Hospitals is AAHRPP accredited and most of the hospitals in its network are NABH, NABL, ER, Blood Bank accredited and recognized for Nursing Excellence.
AboutCompany: Manipal Hospitals, Bhubaneswar (formerly AMRI Hospitals) is a leading 400-bed multi-specialty tertiary care hospital located in Khandagiri, Odisha. Accredited by NABH, the facility provides round-the-clock emergency, trauma, and critical care services alongside advanced medical treatments across key specialties like cardiology, neurology, oncology, orthopaedics, and nephrology. Equipped with modern diagnostic technology such as PET-CT scanning and minimally invasive surgical setups, it serves as a major healthcare hub for patients across eastern India.

Purpose of the Role
The position will be responsible for driving retail sales of Passenger Electric Vehicles to personal customers in assigned regions to achieve business objectives in terms of volumes, market share and customer experience; the incumbent is to provide focus to EV retail efforts, including market activation, tie-ups, customer & pipeline management
Lack of focus for EV retail in a primarily ICE focused dealership structure; limited EV ecosystem development and activation for personal segment EV buyers
Job Responsibility

Deliver Retail targets for the city/region through dealership as well as alternate channel sales teams
Direct responsibility of managing sales in Store-in-Store/Experience Centres
Micro-market activation: Identify, optimize and conduct micro market activations within the region to optimize lead generation and conversion
Interface with dealerships through PV TSMs to seek dealer support & ensure dealer focus to achieve retail targets
Optimize test drives and conversion through special initiatives executed through dealers and alternate channels
Develop market intelligence on customer preferences, competitor offerings, key opportunities, etc. and share with Head – EV Retail Sales
Develop and manage region specific tie-ups to increase value proposition of EVs
2. Manage Customer Relationships:
Engage frequently with EV customers & serve as first point of escalation for customers (adhering to SLAs)
Share feedback with Charging Solutions & Customer Experience teams
3. Team Management:
Monitor Sales funnel and direct Product Specialists to Manage pool of TML Sales executives deployed in alternate sales channels to take appropriate follow-up actions to ensure retail customer satisfaction.
Onboard and manage product specialists across relevant sales channels
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal:
Regional Customer Care Manager
Specific service campaigns/ communicate service-related issues being faced by retail customers in the region
Sales Planning
Providing inputs on the sales forecast and tracking delivery
Zonal Retail Marketing
Align on EV specific offers
Charging Solutions/
Customer Experience
Communicating product/service feedback received on-ground to charging/customer experience team
PVBU TSM
Interface with TSMs to seek dealer support and ensure dealer focus to achieve retail targets

External:
Channel Partners
Direct Feedback/ daily assistance to them to sort issues.
Financial Institutions
For financial offerings as required by retail customers (along with RCFI, at times directly)
Desired Candidate Profile
Education: B.E/ B. Tech & MBA - Sales & Marketing
Relevant Experience: 5-6 years of Sales & Marketing experience with a focus in EV/PV sales.
Understanding of Competition Product Portfolio and own competitive advantage.
Ability to communicate with learned and environmentally conscious set of Customers.
Experience in Value Selling concept of Sales.
Ability to lead and manage teams and achieve targets; drive product specialists and dealerships to achieve retail targets
Strong Oral & written communication with good fluency in English language and local language of relevant city/region
Ability to guide teams in prioritizing and managing customer pipeline without losing sales
Strong planning & problem solving skills to create city specific market activation plans, tie-ups and customer schemes
Knowledge of EV/PV sales process and sales resource allocation
Ability to influence colleagues/ other BU manpower without direct reporting relationship
Strong sales team leadership experience/ skills, evidenced through track record or references
Strong experience in Retail customer management, handling escalations and working with multiple internal stakeholders etc.
Knowledge of EV/PV sales process and sales resource allocation
Good technical knowledge of EV/PV products along with product features
Skills & Competencies
Effective Communication and Influencing Skills
Ability to drive teams to meet targets
Result Oriented approach
Accountability & Ownership
Ability to change user behaviour
Data Driven

Description:
We are looking for an active and responsible Field Recruiter who can hire frontline employees for retail stores and
delivery operations. The recruiter should be comfortable working in the field, meeting people, building local contacts

Positions to be Hired
• Retail Store Staff / Store Associates
• Cashiers and Billing Staff
• Pickers and Packers
• Delivery Riders / Delivery Executives
Key Responsibilities
• Visit local markets, nearby areas and communities to find suitable candidates.
• Build hiring connections with NGOs, ITIs, training centres, placement groups, community organisations and local
employment networks.
• Take part in job fairs, local hiring drives and community-level recruitment activities.
• Use employee referrals, local contacts, WhatsApp groups and other practical sources to attract candidates.
• Speak with candidates, explain the job, salary, work location and shift timings, and check their interest and suitability.

Description:
Job Summary
The Deputy Relationship Manager for Fast Track Loan within the South Business department at Ujjivan Small Finance Bank plays a pivotal role in driving the growth and management of the bank's fast track loan portfolio. This position requires a strategic and customer-centric professional who can effectively manage client relationships, assess creditworthiness, and ensure timely disbursal of loans while adhering to regulatory and internal compliance standards. The role demands collaboration with cross-functional teams to optimize loan processing, mitigate risks, and enhance customer satisfaction in a competitive banking environment focused on financial inclusion and rapid service delivery.
Job Type: Full-time


Key Duties and Responsibilities
Manage and nurture relationships with existing and prospective clients to promote fast track loan products tailored to their financial needs.
Conduct thorough credit appraisals and risk assessments to ensure the quality and profitability of the loan portfolio.
Coordinate with credit, legal, and compliance teams to ensure all loan disbursals meet regulatory guidelines and internal policies.
Drive the end-to-end loan processing cycle, ensuring timely documentation, verification, and disbursal to meet customer expectations.
Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling additional banking products to enhance customer value and bank revenue.
Monitor loan repayments and proactively manage delinquency by engaging with customers to resolve issues and minimize non-performing assets.
Prepare detailed reports on loan portfolio performance, market trends, and customer feedback for senior management review.
Collaborate with marketing and product teams to develop and implement strategies that increase loan penetration in the South Business region.
Train and mentor junior relationship managers and field staff to improve team effectiveness and customer engagement.
Stay updated with industry developments, regulatory changes, and competitive landscape to adapt strategies accordingly.


Minimum Requirements of Knowledge and Skills

Educational Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred.
Minimum of 4-6 years of experience in retail banking or microfinance, with a focus on loan portfolio management and customer relationship management.


Functional Skills
Credit Risk Assessment
Loan Portfolio Management
Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
Regulatory Compliance in Banking
Financial Analysis and Reporting
Cross-selling and Upselling Techniques
Negotiation and Conflict Resolution
Team Leadership and Mentoring
Documentation and Loan Processing


Behavioural Skills
Market Research and Competitive Analysis

Description:
About the Role : Dainik Bhaskar is looking for a highly driven sales professional to lead and grow advertisement revenue across key business categories. The role requires a blend of sales leadership, client relationship management, category understanding, and revenue generation capabilities. The incumbent will be responsible for managing a sales team, acquiring new advertisers, retaining existing clients, and achieving assigned revenue targets.


Key Responsibilities:
1.Sales Leadership & Team Management
Lead and manage a team of Field Sales Executives (FSEs) and sales professionals.
Set monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets for the team. Conduct regular performance reviews, pipeline reviews, and coaching sessions.
Drive accountability through daily activity tracking and sales monitoring. Develop team capabilities through mentoring and field accompaniment.

2.Revenue Generation & Business Development
Achieve and exceed assigned revenue targets.
Build and manage a robust 90-day sales pipeline.
Identify and acquire new advertisers across categories.
Drive client retention, renewal, upselling, and cross-selling opportunities.
Ensure strong conversion rates from prospecting to closure.


3. Client Relationship Management
Build strong relationships with business owners, CXOs, marketing heads, and decision-makers.
Understand client business objectives and recommend suitable advertising solutions.
Conduct effective sales presentations and proposal discussions. Handle negotiations, pricing discussions, and contract closures professionally.
Maintain long-term advertiser relationships and enhance client satisfaction.


4. Category Development & Market Intelligence
Develop strong understanding of key categories such as: Education / Real Estate / Automobile / Retail / FMCG / BFSI
Track market trends, competitor activities, launches, and promotional opportunities.
Identify category-wise revenue opportunities and develop growth strategies, Prepare category acquisition and retention plans.

5. Media Sales & Advertising Solutions
Promote print advertising solutions and integrated media offerings. Understand ad inventory, pricing structures, packages, and campaign planning.
Guide clients on campaign execution, visibility, reach, and impact. Coordinate with internal stakeholders for seamless campaign delivery.

6. Communication & Presentation
Prepare client-specific proposals and sales presentations.
Conduct effective client meetings, pitches, and business reviews. Communicate professionally in Hindi and English, both written and verbal.
Deliver regular sales updates and business reports.

7. Planning & Business Analytics
Track sales performance using Excel, CRM, and reporting tools.
Analyse category trends, revenue performance, client retention, and market opportunities.
Prepare monthly and quarterly business plans. Develop action plans to improve productivity and revenue realization.

8. Educational Qualification: Graduate in any discipline / MBA in Marketing / Sales / Business Development preferred.

9. Preferred Additional Skills:Exposure to print advertisement sales, Experience handling multiple categories or markets, understanding of digital advertising platforms, Ability to design integrated advertising solutions combining print and digital media.
AboutCompany: DB Corp is the largest print media company of India. It publishes newspapers in 3 Indian languages across 12 Indian States with 65 print Editions with 6.6 cr total readerships. Its flagship brand in Hindi language is Dainik Bhaskar, Divya Bhaskar is Gujarati language and Divya Marathi is Marathi language newspaper.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are currently seeking dedicated and detail-oriented individuals to serve as Off-Role Quality & Process Control Representatives (OPC) for a leading paints manufacturing firm across various locations throughout India. This role offers an excellent opportunity for professionals with a background in quality control, production, or manufacturing operations to contribute to maintaining high standards within a respected industry name. The position is pivotal in ensuring product integrity and operational compliance from raw material sourcing through to final dispatch.

Responsibilities
Oversee the quality of raw and packaging materials at vendor sites to ensure they meet established standards.
Execute quality inspections, sampling procedures, and testing protocols in strict accordance with approved specifications.
Supervise production workflows to guarantee adherence to approved formulations and recipes.
Validate batch charging procedures, premix measurements, and the accuracy of production records.
Manage token systems effectively and reconcile them against finished goods shipments.
Perform final quality assessments on completed goods and maintain comprehensive batch-specific documentation.
Track filling weights, verify laboratory equipment calibration, and monitor critical quality parameters.
Generate and submit daily activity reports via a mobile application equipped with geo-tagging capabilities.
Detect any deviations in quality standards and promptly escalate significant findings to management.
Assist in scheduled quality audits and ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory and internal activities.



Requirements
Possess a Graduate degree or Diploma in Science, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
Have between 0.6 to 3 years of professional experience in quality control, production, manufacturing, or conducting plant and vendor audits.
Demonstrate practical knowledge of quality testing methods, sampling techniques, and documentation processes.
Exhibit strong observational, reporting, and analytical capabilities.
Be willing and able to work at external vendor or plant locations and utilize mobile applications for reporting tasks.

Location: Raipur

0.6 3 years of experience in Quality Control, Production, Manufacturing or Plant/Vendor Audits.

Purpose of the Role
The role is responsible for driving sales of vehicles through sales volumes and market share and ensuring enhancing customer engagement in the assigned territory. It involves actively managing dealer relationships & driving demand, developing new business and achieving the territory sales targets.
Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning:
Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory
Plan and conduct monthly target setting including marketing activations at the dealerships in line with forecast/ estimated TIV and sales volume for the assigned territory
Coordinate with various partners and internal teams to drive customer engagement & sales. Plan and execute monthly activations and provide the necessary support to drive effectiveness while measuring outcomes of activities conducted
Ensure monthly and annual targets to be achieved in terms of retail sales and customer satisfaction levels as per Sales & Marketing plan.
Support state product manager in the conversion of mid-to-big sized deals when needed
Drive the conversion of C4T customers with assigned dealership into Tata Motors fold
Drive sales and share of business with key accounts customers
Drive value added sales in the assigned territory and seek support from sales teams on need basis
2. Review and Execution:
Conduct sales execution meeting on a monthly basis with dealers sales representatives and sales team to monitor performance and to set future action plan
Execute dealer wise and outlet wise performance to monitor sales pipeline and deploy action plan to different territories based on performance and potential
Review and monitor MIS of the following: Volume, Market Share, Activity Report, Retail tracker, C4T list and pipeline DSE
Ensure the execute of distribution of dealership target DSE wise and Micro Market wise
Provide product wise indent to RSMs as per the agreed schedule
Capture and review market intelligence through multiple sources, including voice of customer on product/services and regulatory requirements. Explore potential white spaces due to emerging customer expectations
Review and monitor dealers inventory and ensure that it stays at optimum level through proper forecasting
Provide inputs on existing product improvements/ development of new products and variants to create differentiation in the market
Work closely with state product managers to share market intelligence about the product on regular basis
3. Financial Management:
Monitor liquidation of stock at assigned dealerships to ensure timely payment by financiers and channelling of funds back into the system
4. People Management:
Drive manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships as per TML norms
Execute trainings for dealer sales team on pre-sales & sales processes, new product features / modifications etc.
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal:
State Product Manager (Product Line), State Head
Update and seek support on sales and market share growth
Provide support, if and when necessary, in conversion of mid-to-big sized deals
Regional Sales Managers
Product, targeting setting for self and dealership, ATL activities
Regional Head SNM/ SNM Manager
Drive Manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships
Regional Head RCFI/ RCFI Manager
Ensure finance availability to dealers and customers

Product Knowledge
Analytical Skills
Interpersonal Skills
Communication Skills

Description:
About the company
Treebo Hospitality Ventures is Indias most loved brand and one of the largest chains in the budget segment of hospitality. With a network of 850+ hotels across 120+ cities, Treebo offers travellers the unprecedented value proposition of high-quality stays at affordable prices wherever they go. We are proud of putting dignity back into budget travel where earlier the traveller was forced to contend with poor quality and hygiene. Treebo Hospitality Ventures masterfully combines engineering prowess with deep hospitality expertise. Our operational ethos is clear and focused from Treebo Club, an innovative distribution platform and extremely rewarding loyalty programme to Hotel Superhero, a cutting-edge SaaS solution and a comprehensive hotel management software. With a strong technological foundation and a passion for hospitality, THV aims to deliver exceptional experiences across our diverse portfolio. Our range of brandsItsy Hotels, Treebo,
Treebo Premium and Medalioprovides a symphony of choices that blend quality, comfort and affordability. Treebo is a Great Places to Work certified organisation. We take immense pride in our culture which is built on a strong foundation of 7 values. Some of these values include - Exhibit Owner Mindset and Have the humility and hunger to learn and help learn, amongst others. We strongly believe in offering our people - “Treebs”, as they are called - unmatched opportunities to learn and grow. If you’re looking to work at a place that is built on strong fundamentals of
business and professional conduct, Treebo is the place for you.
About the Role
As an Area General Manager, you will be responsible for executing the company’s strategic vision of democratizing the joy of travel. You will be responsible for a given area and the portfolio there in to ensure highest levels of guest experience, product quality and business & profitability of the assets. While managing the operations and enabling
sales for your portfolio, you will also drive the expansion of our hotel portfolio across your area and beyond through your network. This is a mission critical role that requires a perfect balance of delivering operational excellence, relationship management, and a
business development mindset.
Key Responsibilities -
1) Operational Excellence
Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple hotel properties in your area, ensuring adherence to brand standards and service benchmarks
Drive compliance with Treebo's brand standards and SOPs, health and safety guidelines, and service quality norms
Conduct audits, quality assurance checks, and drive corrective/preventive actions through hotel partners to maintain Treebo standards
Act as the key liaison between the company and hotel partners, ensuring seamless coordination and timely issue resolution
Monitor and enhance overall guest satisfaction by ensuring prompt and effective service recovery mechanisms
2) Business Development & Growth
Identify, evaluate, and onboard new hotel properties to expand the company’s portfolio within the assigned area
Negotiate terms of the agreement and ensure complete alignment with Treebo's operating procedures before onboarding any hotel
Collaborate with the central business development team to oversee launch process of the signed properties
3) Sales & MICE
Drive regional sales performance by collaborating with internal sales teams and property owners to achieve revenue targets for your portfolio
Identify and push sales POCs to close MICE deals for your portfolio properties
Support pricing, promotions, and campaigns to drive business at the property level
Engage with local corporate clients, event organizers, and travel planners to push business to your portfolio if needed
4) Team & Partner Management
Lead, mentor, and develop on-ground portfolio hotel teams to deliver exceptional guest experience in the segment
Train hotel staff in brand values, SOPs, and customer service skills to ensure consistency
Build strong relationships with hotel owners and partners to foster collaboration and long-term association
What Are We Looking For -
Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
4–6 years of experience in hospitality management with demonstrated success in both operations and business development.
Proven experience in property acquisition and/or sales in hospitality.
Knowledge and experience in the MICE segment is highly desirable.
Analytical mindset with problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned geography.
Entrepreneurial approach with a strong focus on execution and accountability.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.

Description:
About the Role
Were building and growing our hyperlocal (on-demand) logistics business within Delhivery, and are for someone who can take ownership from day zero acquiring customers, shaping the GTM motion, and building a repeatable revenue engine.
You will operate as a full-stack sales owner — from identifying opportunities within SMEs and enterprises to closing deals and ensuring long-term account success. The role requires a mix of hunting (acquisition) and farming (growth & retention), with a strong bias toward building from scratch.

What You’ll Do
Own the end-to-end sales cycle: prospecting pitching closing account growth for leads with monthly wallet potential of 5L to 10L
Acquire and onboard SMEs and enterprise customers onto Delhivery’s hyperlocal logistics platform
Build a strong pipeline through outbound efforts, partnerships, and market mapping
Work closely with operations to ensure a seamless fulfillment experience for customers while providing top-notch customer assistance
Drive account expansion and retention, identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities
Develop a deep understanding of customer supply chains and last-mile needs
Contribute to GTM strategy, pricing inputs, and product feedback as an early member of the business
Lay the foundation for scaling this business line and becoming a trusted + reliable logistics partner for our customers
Who We’re Looking For
2–5 years of experience in B2B sales, with a strong focus on acquisition-led roles
Prior experience in logistics, on-demand delivery, or supply chain platforms
Strong exposure to both SME and enterprise sales
Hands-on experience with solution selling (not just transactional sales)
High ownership mindset — comfortable operating in 0-1 environments
Strong understanding of last-mile logistics, fulfillment challenges, and operational nuances

What Makes This Role Different
You’re not inheriting a book of business — you’re building it
Direct impact on shaping a new vertical within Delhivery
Opportunity to scale into a larger role as the business grows
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.

Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.

Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.

About Simplilearn
Simplilearn is the worlds #1 online bootcamp for digital economy skills training, helping professionals and enterprises stay ahead in the fast-changing digital world. We offer world-class programs in Data Science, AI, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Digital Marketing, and more.

Role Summary
We are looking for a highly motivated Inside Sales Specialist to join our B2C Sales team. This is an individual contributor role focused on engaging with prospective learners, understanding their career goals, and recommending appropriate Simplilearn programs to help them succeed.

Key Responsibilities
Proactively connect with potential learners via Outbound calls
Understand individual customer needs and provide customized course recommendations.
Convert leads into paying customers by driving consultative and need-based selling.
Achieve monthly revenue targets through high conversion rates and proactive follow-ups.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all interactions using CRM tools.
Collaborate with marketing and product teams to provide market feedback.

Desired Candidate Profile
Graduate in any discipline (MBA preferred but not mandatory).
0–5 years of experience in B2C inside sales, preferably in EdTech or service-based industries.
Proven ability to meet or exceed sales targets in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and persuasion skills.
Self-driven, goal-oriented, and comfortable working independently.
Familiarity with CRM tool - Salesforce is an added advantage.
Willingness to work in rotational shifts/weekends (as required for B2C audiences).

What We Offer
Competitive fixed pay plus interesting performance incentives.
Rapid career growth in a global EdTech leader.
Learning & development support with access to all Simplilearn programs.
Dynamic, high-energy work culture with strong peer support.

Description:
Company Description

Simplilearn is a leading digital skills training platform that helps individuals and organizations build capabilities needed to succeed in the digital economy. The company offers rigorous online programs in rapidly evolving fields such as Cyber Security, Cloud Computing, Project Management, Digital Marketing, and Data Science. Courses and certifications are designed and continuously updated by more than 2,000 industry and academic experts, and delivered in partnership with world-renowned universities. Simplilearn focuses on practical, applied learning through thousands of live classes each month and real-world projects, enabling millions of professionals to gain work-ready skills and supporting organizations with corporate training and employee upskilling. This learner-centric approach has helped a majority of participants achieve promotions or new roles in their careers.

Role Description:
The Student Advisor (Sales) will support prospective learners through the entire admission and enrollment journey, with a focus on consultative selling and student guidance. Day-to-day responsibilities include engaging with leads via calls, emails, and messages, understanding learners goals, recommending suitable programs, and clearly explaining course features, pricing, and outcomes. The role involves maintaining accurate records in CRM systems, following up on inquiries, meeting enrollment and revenue targets, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve learner experience. Student Advisors will also provide basic counseling on career paths, program selection, and learning formats while ensuring high-quality customer service. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bangalore Urban.

QualificationsCandidates should possess strong interpersonal skills and customer service skills to build trust, handle queries, and manage learner relationships effectively.
Candidates should possess student counseling skills and education-related understanding to guide learners on program selection and career pathways.
Candidates should possess clear and confident communication skills, including spoken and written English, to conduct professional sales and advisory conversations.
Candidates should possess basic sales, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities, with a track record of meeting targets in inside sales or similar roles.
Additional beneficial qualifications include familiarity with CRM tools, comfort with night/US shifts, ability to work in a fast-paced environment, and a bachelor’s degree in any discipline.

Vendor Management & Expediting

Governance & Compliance
