Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Maintenance:

Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks.
Ensure the property is clean, well-maintained, and aesthetically pleasing.
Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities.
Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly.
Financial Management:

Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance.
Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost-effective services.
Security and Safety:

Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants.
Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary.
Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.
Tenant and Guest Relations:

Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner.
Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively.
Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction.
Staff Management:

Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees.
Administrative Tasks:

Maintain accurate records of property-related activities, contracts, and expenses.
Prepare regular reports for property owners or management.
Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management.
Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes.
Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management.
Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation.
Project Management:

Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property.
Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles.
Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Role & responsibilities
We are seeking a Network Implementation Engineer to perform the staging, configuration, migration, and cutover of enterprise and data center network environments. This role is responsible for turning Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and High-Level Designs (HLDs) into production reality across Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and security ecosystems. The ideal candidate has deep Cisco CLI expertise, hands-on experience executing maintenance windows, and familiarity with Cisco's controller-led architectures (Catalyst Center).
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst (9200/9300/9400/9500/9600) and ASR/ISR/Catalyst 8000,4300,1100 series routers.
Provision Cisco Catalyst Wireless infrastructure, including 9800,5520,8500 Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).
Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE / NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.
The skills Required
Routing- Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge on MPLS will be a advantage.
Switching- Deep understanding on switching concept like STP, HSRP, VRRP, Portchannel, Switch Stacking, VTP.
Wireless- Hands on experience on cisco air OS and catalyst controllers (8500,5520,9800), Access point, RF fundamentals, WLAN fundamentals.
Experience & Certifications
Experience: 6 months of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.
Participation in off-hours change windows (nights and weekends) to minimize operational disruption.

Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks & financial instruments. To further enhance merchant & business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm's B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytm Payment PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. India's largest digital lending story is brewing here. It's your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

Description:
Job Summary
The Builder - Logistics is a high-agency, 0-to-1 role embedded within Ca's GS Retail Logistics function in the South. Based out of Bengaluru and working closely with the Regional Head - South, you will build new programs, ship new tools, and run controlled experiments across Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kerala. This is not a steady-state ops role - you'll spend most of your time defining problems, prototyping solutions, and turning what works into repeatable playbooks that city teams can run at scale. You'll operate at the intersection of ops, data, product, and AI.
Key Responsibilities
New Program Design - Identify gaps across pilot supply, CSP adherence, auto-allocation, and fulfilment. Design new programs from scratch, run pilots, and hand off winning plays to city teams.
Ops Diagnostics Deep Dives - Own regional data - cut it by city, cohort, and process step to surface what's broken and where the fastest wins sit. Convert findings into structured action plans.
Product Specs Tool Building - Write clear specs for internal tools and dashboards. Partner with Product and Tech to ship what the region needs; use no-code and AI where full builds are overkill.
Automation of Manual Workflows - Map the region's sheet-heavy workflows and lead their transition to automated systems. Ship quick wins with Apps Script, Zapier, or AI copilots before scoping full products.
City-Level Experimentation - Run controlled A/B tests across cities to validate whether a new process, script, or intervention actually moves the KPI. Kill what doesn't work, scale what does.
Cross-functional Execution - Work directly with city heads, Category Managers, Product, and Tech to unblock progress. Translate ground-team pain-points into shipped fixes fast.
Qualifications Experience
2-4 years in high-agency roles - startup ops, strategy consulting, category management, or founders office.
Track record of shipping something end-to-end - a program, a tool, a dashboard, a new city launch - that survived after you moved on.
Comfortable in ambiguity - can walk into a messy problem and leave with a structured plan.
Strong first-principles thinking; happy to visit yards and talk to pilots before writing a single line of a proposal.
Bengaluru-based or willing to relocate; comfortable travelling across Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kerala.
Data AI Skills
Advanced Excel / Google Sheets - pivots, lookups, and formula-based analysis at scale.
SQL fluency for querying large operational datasets; Python or R for deeper analysis is a strong plus.
Comfort building dashboards (Looker, Data Studio, Tableau) that drive city-level decisions.
Hands-on with AI copilots (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or similar) to accelerate analysis, drafting, and prototyping.
Familiar with no-code automation (Apps Script, Zapier, Retool) to ship quick wins without engineering support.

Job summary
As a Data AI, Manager within the India Market Unit, you will help drive client value creation by combining industry context with Data AI, analytics, and cloud-led delivery. You will partner closely with client stakeholders and internal teams to translate business priorities into well-governed data assets, high-quality insights, and scalable solutions.
In this role, you will own standards and best practices for data analysis, profiling, modeling, mapping, and query governance; ensure data quality and accuracy across delivery initiatives; and support release/change management by understanding end-to-end data flows, dependencies, lineage, and access controls. Define and enforce standards and best practices for data analysis, modeling, and query development.
Develop and maintain an enterprise data dictionary aligned with business glossary and data assets.
Define and manage the organizations data landscape, including overlays with technology architecture, end-to-end data flows, transformations, and lineage.
Partner with the data governance team to ensure adherence to organizational data principles and guidelines.
Delivery experience in industries like Resources, Consumer Goods, Life sciences
Professional Technical Skills:
Proven experience in predictive analytics and data science modeling.
Hands-on expertise with at least one major analytics product/platform.
Strong understanding of big data, data lakes, machine learning, and conversational AI.

Prior consulting experience, preferably with exposure to C-suite stakeholders.

Drive analytics initiatives using platform-/cloud-based approaches.

Corporate Title: Associate

Role Description
Business Banking is the liability business for Deutsche Bank present in 17 locations across India . This carters to a wide variety of population through its distinct channels like Personal banking, Private Banking and Business Banking.

Maintaining and growing business contacts and leads in the lending business
Compliance with internal and credit-related regulations, e. g. , QS audit results, KWG 18 etc.
Implementing regulatory KYC requirements, and maintaining compliance with other applicable regulatory requirements and guidelines


Your skills and experience
Candidate should have excellent communication in English and well groomed.
Minimum qualification required is Graduation.
Minimum Experience should be 8 - 12 Years in relevant field.
This is an individual contributor role. Need a Senior Banker, with good knowledge about investments, Wealth Management, Mutual Funds, PMS, Insurance. Acquisition of New to Bank clients.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Senior Network Test Engineer
Experience: 5 to 10 Years
Work location: Bangalore/ Pune/ Noida

Feature & Protocol Testing: Test network routing features to ensure they work exactly as designed.
Regression Testing: Re test existing features across different software versions to find new bugs or performance drops.
L2 & L3 VPN Testing: Set up and test virtual private networks, ensuring traffic flows correctly and safely between virtual routers.
Lab Setup: Recreate real world customer networks in a lab environment using traffic generators.
Troubleshooting: Find network bugs, analyze packet captures (Wireshark), and work with developers to fix them.
Network automation: Python, Ansible, REST APIs
Technologies:
MPLS Basics: Good understanding of how MPLS works, including LDP and RSVP TE.
VPN Services: Hands on experience testing L3VPNs and L2VPNs (VPLS, VPWS, EVPN).
Routing Protocols: Strong knowledge of how BGP / MP BGP, OSPF, and IS IS build paths and neighbors.
Network Convergence: Experience testing fast failover mechanisms like BFD and FRR (Fast Reroute).
Testing Tools: Experience using hardware traffic tools like Ixia (IxNetwork) or Spirent, along with Wireshark.

Pune / Bangalore / Noida:
5 Days – Work from Office
What does a successful SQL DBA – Azure do at Fiserv?
We are looking for a skilled SQL DBA with hands-on Azure experience to join our team and support the administration, performance, availability and security of critical database environments. In this role, you will manage SQL Server databases across on-premises and cloud environments, support production systems and help ensure reliable, scalable, and high-performing database operations.
A successful candidate brings strong SQL Server database administration experience, practical knowledge of Azure services and the ability to work across infrastructure, application, and development teams. This role is important to maintaining database stability, supporting cloud initiatives and driving operational excellence.
What you will do
Administer, monitor and maintain SQL Server database environments across development, test and production systems
Manage databases in Azure environments, including support for cloud-hosted database services and related platform operations
Perform database installation, configuration, upgrades, patching and migration activities across on-premises and Azure platforms
Monitor database health, performance, storage and availability and take proactive action to prevent issues
Perform backup, recovery, restoration and disaster recovery support for business-critical databases
Troubleshoot database issues and optimize performance through tuning, indexing, query analysis and configuration improvements
Support high availability and disaster recovery solutions for SQL Server environments
Ensure database security, user access management and compliance with operational and security standards
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, cloud and application support teams to resolve issues and support new initiatives
Automate routine database administration tasks where appropriate
Support production releases, environment readiness and operational transitions
Maintain technical documentation, standards, support procedures and runbooks
Participate in incident management, root cause analysis and continuous improvement efforts
What you will need to have
4 to 10 years of experience in SQL Server database administration
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server in production environments
Hands-on experience with Azure, including Azure SQL Database, Azure virtual machines or other Azure data services
Experience in database backup and recovery, performance tuning, security and monitoring
Strong knowledge of SQL Server installation, configuration, patching and upgrade processes
Experience supporting high availability and disaster recovery configurations
Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills
Experience working in cross-functional support and delivery environments
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, work and military experience
What would be great to have
Experience with Snowflake
Familiarity with Azure automation, scripting or infrastructure support
Experience with PowerShell or other scripting tools
Knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps or infrastructure-as-code practices
Experience in financial services, payments or other regulated environments
Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and alerting tools

What does a successful MS Dynamics Developer do at Fiserv?

In this role, you will design, develop and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions that help drive operational efficiency, improve user experience and support business growth. Design, develop, customize and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions based on business and technical requirements
Work with stakeholders to gather, analyze and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications
Configure and customize Dynamics modules, workflows, forms, dashboards and integrations
Develop plugins, custom workflows, reports and enhancements within the Microsoft Dynamics environment
Integrate MS Dynamics with other enterprise applications and third-party platforms
Support data migration, system upgrades, deployments and environment management activities
Troubleshoot application issues, identify root causes and provide timely resolution
Perform unit testing, system testing and support user acceptance testing
Create and maintain technical documentation, process documents and support materials
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, QA and business teams to deliver reliable solutions
Ensure solutions follow security, compliance and coding best practices
Provide ongoing production support and continuous improvement recommendations

4 to 10 years of overall IT experience
Hands-on experience working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Microsoft Dynamics CRM
Strong experience in customization, configuration and development within MS Dynamics
Create and manage copilot agents
Experience with C#, .NET, JavaScript, plugins, workflows and web services
Experience in integrating Dynamics with external systems using APIs or middleware
Good understanding of Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps
Experience with SQL Server and data migration activities

Description:
Salesforce Omnistudio Technical Lead/Architect (FSC) Manager
Key Responsibilities
Technical Design & Solutioning
Own the creation of Technical Design Documents (TDDs) covering data models, OmniStudio components, Apex architecture, integrations, security and deployment approach.
Translate functional requirements and user stories into scalable technical solutions aligned with Salesforce and FSC best practices.
Design the Salesforce data model, including FSC standard objects such as Person Accounts, Business Accounts, Account-Account and Account-Contact Relationships, plus custom extensions.
Make "Configuration vs. Customization" decisions. Favor declarative and OmniStudio capabilities where appropriate.
Take part in solution reviews and Design Authority forums, and contribute to architecture decisions.
Development Leadership
Lead, guide and mentor a team of Salesforce developers.
Allocate work, estimate effort, and track development progress across sprints.
Conduct code reviews and enforce coding standards, design patterns, governor-limit awareness and security best practices.
Do hands-on development on complex components and act as the escalation point for technical blockers.
Define and enforce development standards, naming conventions, and reusable frameworks such as a trigger framework, error-logging framework and Integration Procedure patterns.
Delivery Ownership
Take end-to-end ownership of technical delivery: quality, timelines and scope.
Work with Project Managers on sprint planning, estimation, risk identification and mitigation.
Support SIT, UAT, performance testing, deployment and hypercare phases.
Act as the technical point of contact for client stakeholders and present designs and progress clearly.
Practice & People Development
Contribute to PwC's Salesforce practice through accelerators, reusable assets, knowledge sessions and pre-sales support such as solution estimates and RFP responses.
Coach and develop team members. Contribute to performance feedback and capability building.

Must-Have Skills
1. Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC)
Strong hands-on implementation experience with FSC (Banking, Wealth Management and/or Insurance).
Good understanding of the FSC data model, Household and Relationship management, Action Plans, Rollup-by-Lookup (RBL), Interaction Summaries and Compliant Data Sharing.
2. OmniStudio Implementation
OmniScripts: guided, multi-step user journeys with conditional logic, reusable components and custom LWC overrides.
Integration Procedures: server-side orchestration, caching, chaining, error handling and performance optimization.
Data Mappers (formerly DataRaptors): Extract, Turbo Extract, Transform and Load.
FlexCards: contextual data display and actions (highly preferred).
3. Lightning Web Components (LWC)
Build custom, reusable and performant LWCs.
Embed LWCs within OmniScripts and FlexCards.
Handle component communication, Lightning Data Service and wire adapters.
4. Business Rules Engine (BRE)
Hands-on with Decision Matrices / Lookup Tables and Expression Sets.
Implement eligibility and decisioning logic.
5. Document Generation
Experience with OmniStudio Document Generation (client-side and server-side), including template design, Data Mapper/Integration Procedure data sources, and generating PDF/DOCX outputs.
6. Salesforce Data Modelling
Design scalable data models, including object relationships, record types, and the trade-offs of master-detail vs. lookup.
7. Salesforce Design & Configuration
Strong command of declarative configuration: Flows, Validation Rules, Page Layouts, Lightning App Builder, Dynamic Forms, Approval Processes, Custom Metadata and Custom Settings.
Configure the security model: Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, Roles, Sharing Rules and Field-Level Security.
Declarative Rollup summaries (DLRS)
8. Apex Development
Expert-level Apex: Triggers (framework-based), Classes, Test Classes with strong coverage and meaningful assertions, and Exception Handling.
Real-time processing: synchronous transactions and REST/SOAP callouts.
Asynchronous and batch processing: Batch Apex, Queueable Apex (including chaining), Schedulable Apex, Future Methods and Platform Events.
Strong understanding of governor limits, bulkification and performance tuning.
9. Code Quality & Reviews
Run structured code reviews.
Use static code analysis tools such as PMD, Salesforce Code Analyzer, SonarQube or Clayton.
Enforce secure coding practices: CRUD/FLS enforcement, SOQL injection prevention and with sharing usage.
10. Team Leadership & Technical Design Ownership
Proven experience leading development teams of 515 developers.
Strong track record of authoring Technical Design Documents and owning delivery outcomes.

Job Title: DevOps Engineer (Azure, GCP, Bicep, YAML)
Overview
We are looking for a talented DevOps Engineer with solid experience in Microsoft Azure, strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Bicep, working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and advanced skills in YAML-based configuration. The ideal candidate will help architect, automate, and optimize cloud environments while ensuring secure, scalable, and resilient application delivery.

Key Responsibilities
Cloud Infrastructure & Automation
Design, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure using Bicep, ARM templates, and Azure CLI.
Work with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services for multi-cloud deployments, workload migration, and infrastructure optimization.
Implement IaC best practices using Bicep, YAML, and Git-based workflows.
Develop reusable IaC modules and ensure consistency across environments.
Optimize cost, performance, and scalability across Azure and GCP resources.
CI/CD Pipeline Development
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GCP Cloud Build.
Write YAML pipelines for automated deployments, testing, compliance checks, and multi-stage delivery.
Integrate security scanning, automated testing, and quality gates into CI/CD workflows.
Automate provisioning, configuration management, and environment setups.
Operational Excellence
Monitor cloud workloads using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and GCPs Cloud Monitoring and Logging.
Troubleshoot issues across cloud infrastructure, container platforms, and application services.
Implement DevOps best practices such as automated rollback, immutable infrastructure, and version-controlled deployments.
Security & Compliance
Apply security best practices in Azure and GCP, including IAM, service accounts, RBAC, network security, and key management.
Ensure governance controls, tagging standards, resource organization, and cost monitoring.
Work closely with security teams to align with compliance frameworks and policies.
Collaboration & Support
Collaborate with developers, architects, and QA teams to support cloud-native development and DevOps adoption.
Participate in sprint planning, architecture discussions, and operational reviews.
Prepare documentation including infrastructure diagrams, IaC standards, deployment processes, and troubleshooting runbooks.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
5+ years of experience in DevOps or cloud engineering roles.
Hands-on experience with:
Azure cloud services
GCP services (Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, GKE, Pub/Sub, IAM, etc.)
Bicep for IaC (module creation, deployments)
Writing and managing YAML for pipelines, Kubernetes, and configuration automation
CI/CD platforms (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Cloud Build)
Git for version control
Good understanding of containers (Docker) and Kubernetes (AKS/GKE).

Preferred Skills
Scripting experience in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
Knowledge of configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet).
Familiarity with microservices, service mesh, and cloud-native patterns.
Experience with Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, and YAML templating.
GitHub Actions
Strong experience in building and managing CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions.
Ability to design reusable workflows, composite actions, and workflow templates.
Proficiency in YAML syntax for multi-stage pipelines, environment promotion, and approvals.
Experience integrating GitHub Actions with Azure and GCP services for automated deployments.
Implementation of security best practices such as secrets management, OIDC authentication, and dependency scanning.
Experience with workflow optimization, caching strategies, and parallel job execution.
GitHub Copilot
Hands-on usage of GitHub Copilot for accelerating code development, scripting, and automation tasks.
Ability to leverage Copilot for generating IaC templates (Bicep/ARM), YAML pipelines, and scripts.
Experience reviewing, validating, and refining AI-generated code to meet production standards.
Understanding of responsible AI usage, including security, compliance, and code quality considerations.
Certifications
Professional certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305, GCP Associate Cloud Engineer, or GCP Professional DevOps Engineer.

Soft Skills
Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities.
Effective communication and collaboration with cross-functional teams.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced environments.
Continuous learning mindset with attention to detail.

Description:
Manager - Actuarial - Business Consulting Risk
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it's your career and 'It's yours to build' which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
About Actuarial Services:
The Team advises clients in the terms of:
- Reserving
- Audit
- M&A Support
- Capital modelling
- IFRS Reporting
- Business Planning
- Reinsurance Structure and Optimization
- Regulatory Compliance and more
The opportunity:
General Insurance - Domestic & Global Market - Business Consulting Risk - Actuarial
Your key responsibilities
- The Incumbent will be responsible for executing projects in the Actuarial space
- We are looking for Actuaries with varying experience in the Indian/ Global insurance market. The job grade of the successful candidates for this role will depend on their respective qualities and experience. The typical responsibilities of the role include
- Play a proactive role within a multi-disciplinary EY team in supporting the various client engagements which may span across Reserving,
- Statutory reporting,
- Solvency assessment,
- IFRS17 implementation,
- Statutory Audit, Internal Audit & Review,
- Business planning.
- Build appropriate models for the above-mentioned projects allowing for client requirement and relevant regulations.
- Lend support on strands of research and specialisms work aimed at providing key insights to help our clients / consultants
- Develop cutting edge proposals for winning new and different clients /engagements
- Work closely with the team to develop consistent standards and best practice.
- Sharing knowledge in a timely and effective way by submitting regularly to the knowledge database
- Contribute to wider opportunities within EY and to raising its profile externally e.g. taking an active role in writing articles for The Actuary
- Develop and maintain deep technical knowledge in modelling skills
- Present internally and externally on areas of technical specialist knowledge
- Develop reports and presentations for the client
Skills and attributes for success
In addition to technical competence, what will set you up for success at EY is your ability to:
- Strong communication, documentation, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills
- Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative
- Broad consulting and project management skills, effective written and oral communication skills
- Pursue passions beyond work and invest in your wellbeing
To qualify for the role you must have:
- A qualified graduate or postgraduate in Actuarial Science with minimum of 6 Qualified papers having 5+ years of experience in Actuarial GI domain.
Good technical understanding
- Reserving techniques
- Business planning and capital modeling
- IFRS 17 methodologies
- Audit
People Skills:
- Proven communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to put across complex technical issues and solutions to non-actuaries.
- Good team player and team handling skills
Desirable
- Good working knowledge of the relevant actuarial concepts and methodologies
- Working knowledge of tools like R, Python etc.
- Knowledge of the latest accounting standard - IFRS17 which is being implemented or reported across various geographies across the world.
- Confidence in speaking and expressing views through a variety of platforms like publications (internal/external), seminars etc.
Ideally you'll also have
- Proven ability to balance priorities and manage many competing demands to agreed deadlines and to the required level of quality.
- Ability to give/receive constructive feedback.
- Self-motivated, uses own initiative and is outcome-focused.
- Dealing constructively with uncertainty and ambiguity.
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative way to provide services across multiple client departments while adhering to commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.
What working at EY offers
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.
About EY
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. So that whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
Join us in building a better working world. Apply now.

Description:
Gen AI | Infosys | 2-5yrs | Pan India

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

We are looking for experienced GenAI professionals with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Agent Frameworks, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

If you are an immediate joiner and excited about shaping the future of AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
Build Agentic AI solutions using modern agent frameworks.
Develop and optimize RAG-based architectures for intelligent knowledge retrieval.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems using MCP and related protocols.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy AI models for production environments.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and performance-optimized.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA
AboutCompany:
Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 46 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over three decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. Job Description


Overview


Water Management Consultancy (WMC) is a key part of the Infrastructure division within AtkinsRalis' Water and Environment Business. Serving both UK and international clients, our projects span flood defence, hydraulic structures, ports, and maritime engineering. The WMC team brings together a diverse range of expertise, including river and coastal engineering, hydrology, hydraulics, dam engineering, hydraulic gates, and maritime engineering.
In this role, you'll be instrumental in delivering a variety of projects, with a particular emphasis on integrated water management. This includes hydrodynamic catchment modelling, sustainable drainage, water-sensitive urban design, river restoration, software development, research, and client and stakeholder engagement. This opportunity is ideal for those seeking technical challenges and looking to contribute to advanced, industry-leading projects.




Your role
Be highly motivated, proactive, and possess a "can-do" attitude.
Be skilled in collaborative working, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate strong organizational and time management abilities.
Be flexible and open to new challenges.
International experience.
Chartered Engineer status or actively working towards Chartership.
Proficiency in coding/programming (R, VBA, Python) is a plus.


About you
A strong academic background with a degree in Civil Engineering and/or a master's degree in Water Management/Hydrology, with 8 to 15 years of experience in the water industry.
Experience in 2D modelling using TUFLOW.
Significant experience with 1D-2D modelling using FMP-TUFLOW, ESTRY-TUFLOW, Infoworks ICM, especially with UK clients.
Build, refine and analyse hydraulic models (1D, 2D, and 1D2D) to represent river channels, floodplains, and potentially pipe networks.
Experience in leading flood modelling projects and managing a small team.
Provide modelling inputs and analysis to support the production of Flood Risk Assessments (FRAs) for planning applications.
Perform sensitivity testing to quantify uncertainty in model parameters and components.
Proficiency in GIS, including QGIS, MapInfo, ArcGIS, and open-source GIS tools.
An understanding of the overall fluvial model development process.
Experience in undertaking Flood Risk Assessments and developing drainage strategies.
Familiarity with FEH (Flood Estimation Handbook) methods.
Working towards achieving Chartered status.
Ability to produce clear and concise technical reports in English.
Effective communication skills for collaborating with colleagues and clients via video conferencing.
Adherence to quality procedures and maintaining high standards in your work.
Enthusiasm for learning new skills and work procedures.

Job Title: Circuit Design Engineer
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-I
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM
Job Summary
The Circuit Design Engineer will be responsible for designing and augmenting network circuits to support existing and new voice network connectivity. The role requires a good understanding of telecom network architecture, DS0/DS1/Ethernet circuits, POI connectivity, Network product requirements, and circuit inventory.
Key Responsibilities
Proficient in basic telecom and transmission concepts.
Good understanding of Transmission architecture and Network connectivity.
Design and augment DS0/DS1/Ethernet/IP circuitry for existing and new Customer /Network connectivity.
Translate network and transport requirements into appropriate circuit designs.
Review engineering requirements and validate circuit design information.
Coordinate with Planning, ASR, Implementation, Operations, and vendor teams for circuit provisioning.
Support new circuit installation, augmentation, migration, and disconnect activities.
Maintain accurate circuit and network inventory in Granite/XNG/PRO or applicable inventory systems.
Analyze network design issues and provide timely recommendations or solutions.
Maintain engineering documentation and update order/design status.
Support Customer Sales and network optimization activities when required.
Required Skills
Experience or good understanding of telecom circuit design.(SDH/SONET/WAVE)
Knowledge of DS0, DS1/T1,IP/Ethernet transport circuits, and Network architecture.
Understanding Network connectivity and circuit configurations.
Ability to interpret network diagrams, circuit information, and engineering requirements.
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills.
Good verbal and written communication.
Microsoft Excel knowledge including PivotTables, formulas, and lookups.
Good to Have
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom inventory systems.
Understanding of Access Service Requests (ASR) and carrier provisioning.
Experience supporting network migrations, grooming, optimization, or decommissioning.
Power BI, VBA, Power Automate, Python, or other automation skills.

Job Title: ASR Engineer
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-I
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM
Job Summary
The ASR Engineer will be responsible for creating, submitting, tracking, and completing Access Service Requests with telecom carriers/LECs to support network provisioning requirements. The role requires good knowledge of carrier ordering processes, circuit configurations, and end-to-end ASR lifecycle management.
Key Responsibilities
Create and submit Access Service Requests (ASRs) using carrier/LEC web portals.
Translate engineering and transport requirements into accurate ASR submissions.
Understand ASR ordering requirements for DS0, DS1/T1,Ethernet and Customer Circuits and associated access services.
Validate ASR information before submission to minimize carrier clarifications and rejections.
Track submitted ASRs and follow up with carriers/LECs through completion.
Review and process carrier responses, including FOCs and DLRs.
Coordinate with Design, Planning, Implementation, Operations, and carrier teams to resolve ASR-related issues.
Monitor order milestones, due dates, jeopardies, and exceptions.
Maintain accurate order status and documentation throughout the ASR lifecycle.
Escalate carrier delays and provisioning issues as required.
Support circuit installs, changes, migrations, and disconnect requirements.
Maintain appropriate circuit/order information in Granite/XNG or applicable systems.
Required Skills
Hands-on Access Service Request experience.
Knowledge of ASR ordering requirements and carrier/LEC processes.
Experience using LEC/carrier web ordering tools.(VFO)
Ability to translate network/transport requests into ASR submissions.
Knowledge of TDM and IP network circuit configurations.
Understanding of FOC, DLR, due dates, and carrier provisioning milestones.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good verbal and written communication.
Microsoft Excel knowledge, including PivotTables and formulas.
Good to Have
Experience with PRO/Flightdeck or similar telecom provisioning/inventory tools.
Knowledge of Telecom network architecture and planning.
Experience in carrier/vendor coordination.
Power BI, VBA, Power Automate, Python, or other automation skills.

Job Title: Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-2/P4-1
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM / based on business requirements
Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist will provide operational visibility across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Hot Cut and related provisioning activities. The role will focus on data validation, identifying aging orders and operational risks, analyzing trends and ensuring the right issues are escalated to the right teams at the right time.
The role will work across provisioning teams, Operations, internal stakeholders and external carriers/vendors to drive issues through resolution.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor operational data across network provisioning activities.
Validate order, milestone and provisioning information for accuracy and completeness.
Identify aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies, recurring issues and delivery risks.
Analyze operational trends and highlight areas requiring attention.
Identify data discrepancies and work with the responsible team to correct them.
Determine which issues require escalation based on aging, customer impact, due date and operational risk.
Drive the right escalation to the right team at the right time.
Track escalated issues through closure rather than only raising the escalation.
Coordinate with Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Provisioning, Operations and other internal teams.
Coordinate with carriers/vendors regarding provisioning delays and unresolved dependencies.
Provide clear operational insights and status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
Support root-cause analysis for repeat issues.
Identify process gaps based on data and operational trends.
Recommend improvements to reduce aging, exceptions and repeated escalations.
Support reporting and dashboard automation to improve operational visibility.
Required Skills
Good understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Experience working with operational data, reports or dashboards.
Strong analytical and data-validation capability.
Ability to identify trends, exceptions and operational risks.
Experience managing or coordinating provisioning/order escalations.
Good understanding of aging, due dates, milestones, jeopardies and dependencies.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple teams and vendors.
Strong written and verbal communication.
Confidence to raise risks and communicate issues to stakeholders.
Strong ownership and follow-through.
  Good to Have
Experience across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design or Network Provisioning.
Carrier/LEC/vendor coordination experience.
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom systems.
Advanced Excel skills including PivotTables, lookups and formulas.
 Power BI/dashboard development experience.
SQL knowledge for validation and analysis.
Power Automate, VBA or Python experience.
 Experience automating operational reporting or exception identification.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and critical deliverables.
Strong stakeholder/vendor coordination.
Good communication and confidence in leading operational discussions.
Positive attitude, ownership and adaptability.

Job Title: Semi Technical Customer Support Associate

Locations: Pune / Noida

Job Summary

We are hiring Semi Technical Customer Support Associates for our US Voice Process in Pune and Noida.

The ideal candidate should have excellent English communication skills, strong customer service abilities, and basic technical troubleshooting knowledge. The candidate should be comfortable working in a high-volume customer support environment and willing to work in night shifts.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle inbound and outbound customer interactions through voice support.
* Resolve customer queries, complaints, and basic technical issues effectively.
* Troubleshoot basic to intermediate technical issues using available knowledge bases.
* Provide accurate information and appropriate resolutions to customers.
* Handle approximately 40–50 calls per shift while maintaining service quality.
* Document customer interactions, resolutions, and follow-up actions in CRM/ticketing tools.
* Escalate unresolved issues to the appropriate teams as per process guidelines.
* Coordinate with internal teams for timely issue resolution.
* Maintain professionalism, empathy, and a customer-focused approach.
* Follow company policies, compliance requirements, and operational procedures.
* Maintain required productivity, quality, attendance, and schedule adherence.
* Candidates must be comfortable working on Indian holidays.

Key Performance Metrics

Candidates will be measured on:

* AHT – Average Handle Time
* CSAT / CCR – Customer Satisfaction
* FCR – First Call Resolution
* Quality Score
* Schedule Adherence
* Attendance & Productivity

Salary

* 6–12 Months Experience: Up to 4.5 LPA
* 12–18 Months Experience: Up to 5 LPA
* 18+ Months Experience: Up to 6 LPA

Important: Salary will be offered with a maximum 25% hike on the candidate’s last drawn salary, subject to eligibility and company norms.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong customer service and problem-solving skills.
* Basic technical troubleshooting knowledge.
* Good listening and analytical abilities.
* Basic computer knowledge.
* Experience with CRM/ticketing tools is preferred.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable handling high-volume calls.
* Basic typing skills.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Willingness to work in night shifts.

Eligibility

* Graduate / Undergraduate candidates can apply.
* Minimum 6 months of relevant experience in Customer Care, Customer Support, Contact Center, Voice Process, or Technical Support.
* Overall experience considered: 6 months to 5 years.
* Candidates should have a proven ability to meet productivity and SLA targets.
* Strong customer-centric approach.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates with experience in international voice customer support / technical support.
* Experience handling US customers will be an added advantage.
* Comfortable working in a high-pressure, target-driven environment.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
* Team player with a professional and customer-focused approach.

Important Information

Location: Pune / Noida Sector 62
Work Mode: Work from Office – 100%
Shift: Night Shift – US Process
Working: 5 Days Working | 2 Rotational Offs
Training: No leaves during training
Process: Semi Technical Voice Customer Support

Demonstrate flexibility to work in rotational shifts.
Exhibit innovation and clarity in both written and verbal communication.

Description:
Job Summary
The Role: Lead Software Engineer (Data Engineer)
The Team: We are looking for a junior Data Engineer to join our offshore team in India. This role is focused on supporting data onboarding, pipeline support, and basic platform activities. You will work under the guidance of senior team members to assist with routine tasks related to data pipelines, integrations, and cloud-native data platform operations. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role suitable for someone starting their career in data engineering or looking to develop core skills in a modern data platform environment leveraging AWS.


Responsibilities

Data Onboarding & Support
Assist in onboarding new data assets to the enterprise platform following established procedures.
Support existing data pipelines by monitoring, troubleshooting, and performing routine maintenance.
Help ensure data quality and consistency during onboarding and ongoing operations.
Follow documented processes and checklists to support data ingestion and transformation tasks.
Support data storage and processing using Amazon S3 as the core cloud storage layer, ensuring data is organized, secure, and accessible.
Support metadata management and data cataloging using AWS Glue Data Catalog to facilitate discoverability and governance.
Assist in implementing data validation, quality checks, and lineage documentation.
Write and maintain Python scripts and Big data processing engines transformations for data ingestion, processing, and automation tasks.


Platform & Pipeline Maintenance
Support the team in maintaining data pipelines, fixing issues, and implementing small enhancements.
Assist with data validation, metadata tagging, and basic lineage documentation.
Help monitor pipeline health and escalate issues as needed.
Support operational activities such as deployment, testing, and routine monitoring.
Contribute to automation of deployment and operational workflows using AWS CloudFormation, or similar tools.


Collaboration & Documentation
Work with senior engineers to understand platform standards and best practices.
Document onboarding steps, pipeline configurations, and operational procedures.
Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders about progress and issues.


Operational Support
Participate in production incident response and troubleshooting.
Support routine deployment, testing, and monitoring activities.
Contribute to team knowledge sharing and documentation efforts.


Required Qualifications
5+ years of experience in data engineering, data support, or related roles.
Basic knowledge of SQL, Python, and Big data processing engines.
Hands-on experience with programming in Python or similar languages for data processing and automation.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Databricks or similar.
Understanding of data onboarding, data quality, metadata, and lineage concepts.
Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue Data Catalog, AWS IAM, and AWS CloudWatch.
Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.


Preferred Qualifications
Exposure to data pipelines, data onboarding, or data migration projects.
Knowledge of Delta Lake, Iceberg, or similar storage formats.
Basic understanding of data governance and security principles.
Any relevant certifications or training in data engineering or AWS.

Description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.
Primary Responsibilities:
Take chat messages per day from customers who have questions about their health benefits
Support secure email inquiries
Use personality and our tools to help customers through the health care benefits available to them
Communicate online in a conversational manner that promotes dialogue and establishes rapport. Associate must avoid poor grammar, misstatements, or lengthy explanation. Online writing necessitates that associate have an aptitude for knowing when to apply the "dos and don'ts" of online communication
Type at a reasonable pace, 30-35 words a minute (WPM)
Provide product information, use service engagement skills, and efficiently use service resources
Technology comfort and know-how: Associate must be adept at using the Associate Workspace, other technology, and automation tools
App, Website, and SMS savvy: Consumers who accept an engagement will have high expectations of the associate's knowledge. Associate will need to maintain a high level of familiarity with the digital property the consumer is using
Read between the lines." Visitors don't necessarily have good writing skills and advocates may have to interpret what the visitor is really asking by responding with a clarifying question or statement
Adapt to continual change as the department fine-tunes the messaging program
Maintain a healthy brand-to-consumer relationship that benefits the consumer. Communicate with consumers primarily through messaging. Unlike other forms of communication, messaging grants both you and the consumer time flexibility, and keeps you connected even after the immediate question has been answered. The result is a superior customer service experience for the consumer, and a superior professional experience for you - where you can personalize your interactions and have a meaningful impact on our business
Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements
Required Qualifications:
Any graduate except (Btech/ Medical degree)
18+ months of experience / Freshers
6+ months of international experience Chat process
Preferred Qualifications:
Customer Service experience
Sales or account management experience
Knowledge of social work, behavioral health, disease prevention, health promotion and behavior change (working with vulnerable populations)
Health Care/Insurance environment (familiarity with medical terminology, health plan documents, or benefit plan design)
Soft Skills:
General knowledge of computers and business operations
Proven ability to communicate articulately and credibly
Solid keyboard skills and experience using helpdesk, ordering or CRM software
Demonstrated ability to achieve service goals
Success in highly automated environment
Dynamic and engaging written communication style
Excellent interpersonal and business communications skills - verbal and written
Demonstrated self-motivation
Ability to work in night shifts
At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

Description:
We are now looking for an Alarm Monitoring Engineer to join our Network Operations team at Ericsson. In this role, you will be part of a global operations environment ensuring network stability, performance, and customer satisfaction through proactive alarm monitoring and incident management.
You will play a key role in identifying network faults, performing first-level analysis, and collaborating with technical and field teams to drive timely fault resolution. This position provides an exciting opportunity to work with diverse network technologies while contributing to Ericssons vision of a fully connected, intelligent world.
What you will do
• Perform 24x7 alarm monitoring and first-level fault analysis for network elements across multiple technologies.
• Identify, analyze, and prioritize network faults using Ericsson and multi-vendor NMS/EMS tools.
• Escalate and coordinate with Level 2/Level 3 support teams and field engineers to ensure service restoration within defined SLAs.
• Execute proactive monitoring to detect early warnings and prevent service degradations.
• Track and manage incidents through their lifecycle, ensuring accurate documentation in fault management systems.
• Support incident, problem, and change management processes in compliance with Ericssons Global Service Center (GSC) standards.
• Generate and analyze network performance and health reports, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.
• Participate in shift-based operations to provide round-the-clock network surveillance coverage.

Job Title: Embedded UI Software Engineer
Experience: 4-9 Years
Location: Bangalore / Noida
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Embedded UI Software Engineer to design and develop graphical user interfaces for embedded products. The candidate should have strong expertise in Embedded C/C++, LVGL, TouchGFX, or similar embedded GUI frameworks, along with hands-on experience in ARM-based embedded systems.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop embedded graphical user interfaces using LVGL, TouchGFX, Embedded Wizard, Qt for MCU, or similar frameworks.
Develop UI applications for LCD/TFT touch displays on embedded platforms.
Integrate UI software with embedded platform services and device drivers.
Work on ARM Cortex-M based microcontrollers (STM32, NXP, ESP32, etc.).
Develop and debug embedded firmware using C/C++.
Support display, touch, communication, and peripheral interfaces.
Collaborate with hardware, firmware, validation, and product teams.
Participate in software testing, debugging, and product releases.
Mandatory Skills
4-6 years of Embedded Software Development experience.
Strong programming skills in Embedded C/C++.
Experience with LVGL (mandatory preferred).
Hands-on experience with TouchGFX, GUIX, emWin, Embedded Wizard, Qt/QML, or similar Embedded GUI frameworks.
Experience with ARM Cortex-M platforms (STM32/NXP).
Experience in RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, QNX, VxWorks, or Embedded Linux).
Knowledge of Display Technologies, LCD/TFT Touchscreens, HMI Development.
Experience with UART, SPI, I2C, CAN communication protocols.
Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
AboutCompany:
Perks and Benefits
Opportunity to work on large-scale global SAP transformation programs.
Exposure to the latest SAP S/4HANA Treasury and Payment solutions.
Collaborative work environment with global teams and industry experts.
Continuous learning, certification, and career development opportunities.
Competitive compensation and comprehensive employee benefits.
Opportunity to contribute to strategic finance and treasury transformation initiatives.

At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Role overview
EY- Assurance Senior Associate
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
The opportunity
We're looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on ones own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across ones aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead ones GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.
Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.
Ideally, youll also have
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Assurance - Senior Associate
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
The opportunity
We re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement team s work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.
Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.
Ideally, you ll also have
Proficiency in MS - Excel, MS - Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world


EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.


Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
