Role Type
Associate Analyst/Analyst

Competency
Alliance Ecosystem_ BRIDGE Support
Associate Analyst / Analyst - Independence - Risk Management Services
This role requires the candidate to conduct research and execute global Independence processes aligned with EY Global (EYG) policies. These processes aim to safeguard EYs independence by assisting professionals in complying with the firms personal Independence policies. The candidate will monitor business relationship to identify and report potential conflicts of interest with business teams. Additionally, this role involves providing coordinated support to EY professionals by answering their inquiries and questions on various country and personal Independence-related topics
The opportunity
Risk Management Services (RMS) is an internal function within EY GDS (Global Delivery services), responsible for protecting the organization from the risks that may arise from its professional practice. We work closely with all parts of the organization to identify and manage risks, providing coordinated advice and assistance on suite of services like Independence, Conflicts, Compliance, regulatory, policy and security issues as well as dealing with claims and queries regarding ethics. Formed in 2007, the RMS team is growing rapidly as a Center of Excellence for all standardized quality/compliance related activities.
This role will be part of the largest sub-service function, i.e., Independence within Risk Management Services (RMS) responsible for assisting EY professionals to maintain auditor objectivity by identifying and mitigating any potential conflicts of interest that could compromise an auditors independence. This includes assessing employee financial and personal relationships, conducting investigations, providing guidance on resolving personal independence and monitoring for new independence threats.
RMS Independence team is currently 950+ people strong, operating from 3 countries and 5 centers : India (Gurugram, Kochi, Bengaluru), Poland (Wroclaw), Philippines (Manila). The team is closely integrated with Global Independence and has been involved in the development of key Independence processes.
This role offers the opportunity to contribute to EYs reputation as an independent auditor by supporting niche Independence profiles within a dynamic and growing environment. Youll work closely with EY professionals to mitigate their personal independence-related risks. This will involve collaborating with senior team members and stakeholders to resolve queries and gather information, ultimately positioning you as a subject matter expert in Independence processes.
Key Responsibilities :
Conduct In-depth Secondary Research : Utilize internal and external sources to gather critical information that is required for different compliance requirement review and approvals.
Service Delivery: Process daily inflow of requests, manage administrative activities and communicating process related nuances appropriately to the Business team/audit teams/ Alliance formation & team managers at GDS.
Document Acquisition : Gather and manage essential documents from EY business, Alliance formation and Regional Independence team professionals ensuring all details are accurate and up to date in EY internal systems
Approval Process Management : Oversee the Business relationship Independence approval submission process for various internal approvals, meticulously tracking progress and addressing any issues that arise.
Diligent Follow-ups : Maintain a proactive approach to follow-ups, guaranteeing all approvals are obtained and projects reach successful closure.
Cross-functional Coordination : Seamlessly coordinate with business, regional Independence and Alliance formation teams to ensure that all necessary information and documents are received
Knowledge and Skill requirement
Strong research and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and coordination abilities.
Proficient in using corporate internal tools and software.
Basic understanding of Independence concepts and business relationships from accounting firms perspective
Proactive mindset, adept at managing multiple tasks and deadlines.
Consultation and reporting skills.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Education: Graduate/post-graduate
Experience: 0 to 3 years of relevant experience
Basic understanding of type of company structures, Ownership structures, and basic risk management concepts.
Business relationships & BRIDGE tool knowledge would be added advantage
Ideally, you ll also have
Flexibility to work in rotational shifts
Technologies and Tools
Experience in MS office suites like Microsoft 365, MS excel, PowerPoint
What you can look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
A team which has its foundation in the core values of trust, respect and teaming. The team which focuses on supporting its colleagues to excel in their respective domains and provides avenues to help acquire and demonstrate new skills.
Opportunities to work with Global Executive risk management teams on strengthening and monitoring compliance framework
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you : We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership : We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Overview
A Growth Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.

Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship

Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot  issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side. Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal. Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description:
Job Description
AVEVA PI Engineer / Consultant Pharmaceutical Client
Job Title

AVEVA PI Engineer / Consultant
Industry Domain

Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences (GxP-regulated Manufacturing)
Experience Required

5-10 years
Employment Type

Full-time
Location

Chennai/Bangalore/Kochi/Coimbatore - Hybrid
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced AVEVA PI (OSIsoft PI) Engineer with expertise in the Life Sciences/Pharmaceutical industry to design, implement, and support enterprise historian solutions. The candidate will be responsible for integrating manufacturing, laboratory, utility, and automation systems with the AVEVA PI System to enable real-time monitoring, data integrity, regulatory compliance, process optimization, and digital transformation initiatives.
The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, GMP regulations, data integrity requirements, and industrial automation systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain PI Data Archive, PI AF (Asset Framework), PI Vision, and PI Interfaces/Connectors to collect, contextualize, and deliver real-time process data.
Build and manage AF templates, element hierarchies, event frames, and analyses to model plant assets and business logic.
Configure and troubleshoot PI interfaces (OPC DA/UA, Modbus, custom interfaces) for data acquisition from PLCs, DCS, SCADA, and historians.
Develop PI Vision displays, dashboards, and PI DataLink/Excel reports for operations, engineering, and management stakeholders.
Write and maintain scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Python, PI SDK/AF SDK, PI Web API) to automate data workflows, integrations, and system health checks.
Integrate PI System data with other platforms (MES, ERP, SQL/historian databases, cloud data lakes, Aveva Data Hub/Connect).
Monitor system performance, data quality, and tag counts; perform capacity planning and license management.
Support PI System upgrades, patching, backups, disaster recovery, and high-availability (PI Collective) configurations.
Enforce cybersecurity best practices for OT/IT systems, including PI System security (mappings, identities, firewalls).
Document architecture, standards, naming conventions, and data governance processes.
Collaborate with process/controls engineers to identify new tagging, KPI, and analytics requirements.
provide Tier 2/3 support and root-cause analysis for PI System issues.Required Technical Skillset
Strong hands-on experience with AVEVA System Platform (Application Server / Galaxy, Historian, InTouch, Web Client / Operations Control).
Working knowledge of AVEVA MES / AVEVA Batch Management, or exposure to integrating third-party MES/LIMS/ERP with SCADA layer.
Proficiency in OPC UA/DA, Modbus, and native communication drivers for PLC/DCS integration
Experience with scripting (QuickScript/VBScript) and object-oriented Galaxy template design.
Understanding of network/OT architecture, redundancy, cybersecurity hardening (ISA/IEC 62443 awareness a plus), and virtualization (VMware) for industrial systems.
Familiarity with SQL Server/reporting tools for Historian data extraction and dashboarding (AVEVA Insight / Reports is a plus).
Pharmaceutical / Regulatory Domain Expertise (Preferred)
Sound knowledge of GAMP 5 computerized system validation (CSV/CSA) lifecycle and documentation practices.
Working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and data integrity (ALCOA+) requirements.
Certifications (Preferred)
AVEVA PI certification
GAMP 5 / CSV training certification.
Soft Skills & Other Requirements
Strong client-facing communication skills; ability to work directly with pharma quality, validation, and automation stakeholders.
Ability to prepare and present technical estimations, proposals, and solution walkthroughs to client/hiring stakeholders.
Strong documentation discipline suited to regulated/validated environments.
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills for live plant support scenarios.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Manager-Test Automation with 13-15 years of experience in Software Testing, Test Automation, and Quality Assurance Engineering. This role requires a strong blend of technical leadership, testing practice management, solutioning expertise, and client engagement experience to drive quality transformation across complex technology programs. The ideal candidate will be responsible for shaping QA and automation strategies, leading testing teams, supporting RFP responses, presales and solutioning initiatives, and driving the adoption of modern quality engineering practices, including CI/CD, Continuous Testing, and AI-enabled testing. Experience in Digital Commerce, Retail, or other large-scale customer-facing platforms is highly desirable.
Roles and Responsibilities
Define and lead enterprise and programme-level Quality Assurance strategies aligned with business objectives, technology architecture, delivery models, and risk. Assess existing testing practices and establish QA transformation roadmaps, target operating models, governance frameworks, engineering standards, and measurable quality outcomes.
Design scalable, maintainable, and fit-for-purpose test automation architectures covering UI, API, integration, component, contract, and end-to-end testing. Define automation frameworks, reusable components, test-data strategies, reporting, environment requirements, maintenance approaches, and technology selection based on application architecture, project requirements, scalability, maintainability, and overall QA strategy.
Define and implement CI/CD-integrated Quality Assurance and continuous testing strategies that provide fast, reliable, and actionable feedback throughout the software delivery lifecycle. Establish appropriate test execution strategies across pull requests, builds, deployments, integration and staging environments, regression cycles, and production validation.
Address and optimise the practical engineering challenges associated with continuous testing, including pipeline efficiency, test reliability, execution time, environment readiness, test-data management, dependencies, parallelisation, selective test execution, quality gates, and pipeline stability. Establish practices such as test impact analysis, risk-based test selection, mocking, tagging, and other optimisation techniques to improve feedback time and pipeline reliability.
Define and monitor QA and CI/CD metrics including automation coverage, execution time, test reliability, flakiness, pipeline stability, defect leakage, release confidence, and other relevant engineering and business outcomes.
Define and lead Performance Testing strategies for critical applications, services, and customer journeys, covering workload modelling, test planning, scripting, execution, scalability, capacity assessment, performance monitoring, bottleneck identification, detailed test-result analysis, performance optimisation, and performance regression.

Define test planning and test case design approaches across programmes, ensuring appropriate test scope, scenarios, coverage, traceability, risk-based prioritisation, test data, environment requirements, entry/exit criteria, and execution strategies aligned with business and technical requirements.
Partner with Development, DevOps, Architecture, Product, and Platform Engineering teams within and outside the organisation to embed quality throughout the software development and delivery lifecycle and promote shift-left, continuous testing, and engineering-led quality practices.
Lead or significantly contribute to RFP, RFI, RFQ, presales, and client solutioning engagements from a Quality Assurance perspective. Translate client requirements and technology challenges into differentiated QA solutions, including QA strategies, automation architectures, CI/CD and continuous testing approaches, performance strategies, implementation roadmaps, effort estimates, resource models, timelines, assumptions, dependencies, risks, delivery approaches, and expected outcomes. Participate in client discovery sessions, solution workshops, proposal discussions, technical presentations, and solution defence activities.
Drive the adoption of AI, GenAI, Agentic, and MCP-based testing across Quality Assurance, identifying and implementing high-value use cases such as test generation, automation code generation, test maintenance, test-data generation, failure and defect analysis, intelligent test selection, test optimisation, and test-result analysis. Lead the evaluation and adoption of AI-enabled solutions capable of planning, generating, executing, analysing, and adapting testing activities.
Mentor and develop QA professionals across technical testing, test automation, performance testing, modern testing practices, solutioning, proposals, RFP/RFI/RFQ engagements, and client-facing activities. Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, coaching, and career development support while building strong testing capabilities and technical leadership within the team.

Strong technical leadership in modern Quality Engineering practices, including automation-first approaches, shift-left and shift-right testing, test optimisation, and continuous quality improvement.
Demonstrated success in managing and growing a Testing Practice, including capability development, competency building, resource planning, governance, offshore delivery management, and mentoring of QA and automation teams.

Demonstrated ability to analyse and correlate application, infrastructure, and monitoring metrics to identify bottlenecks, resource constraints, and scalability limitations and provide actionable engineering recommendations.
Strong practical experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and DevOps delivery models, with the ability to design continuous testing strategies and address real-world challenges including test reliability, execution time, environment dependencies, test data, parallelisation, selective execution, pipeline stability, quality gates, and feedback optimisation.
Experience with test execution optimisation practices such as risk-based test selection, test impact analysis, parallel execution, test tagging, mocking, test-data management, environment strategy, and automation maintenance.

Job Summary
We are seeking a senior UX leader who guides delivery, supports pursuits, maintains project-level client relationships mentors teams through selective hands-on design work. The role involves leading end-to-end UX initiatives, defining user-centric design strategies, collaborating with product and engineering teams, and ensuring user-centric design solutions that deliver business value. Roles and Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end UX initiatives, guiding teams through research, discovery, ideation, design, prototyping, testing, and implementation.
Translate customer insights, business requirements, and complex challenges into intuitive, impactful, and user-centered experiences.
Define and drive the UX vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with user needs and organizational objectives.
Establish and govern UX standards, design systems, frameworks, and best practices to ensure consistency, scalability, accessibility, and design excellence.
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Business, and leadership stakeholders to align UX solutions with project and organizational goals.
Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and stakeholder discussions to drive innovation, alignment, and informed decision-making.
Present UX strategies, research findings, design concepts, and recommendations to senior leadership and project stakeholders.
Drive data-informed design decisions through user research, usability testing, analytics, and performance insights.
Guide UX planning, prioritization, and coordination across initiatives to support effective and successful delivery.
Build and maintain trusted working relationships with client and internal stakeholders within assigned projects.
Participate in discovery discussions, solution workshops, and pursuit activities to help define user-centered approaches for prospective engagements.
Provide selective hands-on design leadership for complex user journeys, workshops, prototypes, and critical design challenges, while mentoring teams and maintaining design quality.
Lead, mentor, and develop UX designers, researchers, and design leads, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
Contribute UX expertise to shape compelling experience strategies and delivery approaches for new opportunities.
Lead UX transformation and design maturity initiatives, leveraging emerging trends, tools, and technologies to drive continuous improvement and innovation.
Support digital transformation initiatives through customer-centric and research-driven design approaches.



Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills:
15+ years of experience in UX/UI Design, Product Design, Service Design, or Experience Design, including at least 5 years in a leadership role.
Strong expertise in Human-Centered Design (HCD), Design Thinking, and user-centered design principles.
Proficiency in UX design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, Axure, InVision, or similar platforms.
Proven ability to shape UX solutions for new opportunities by defining approaches, delivery models, resource requirements, and experience strategies.
Extensive experience in user research, usability testing, customer journey mapping, information architecture, interaction design, and data-informed design practices.
Experience leading the creation, implementation, and governance of enterprise design systems.
Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams, including coaching, mentoring, performance development, and capability building.
Strong portfolio showcasing expertise in UX strategy, interaction design, problem-solving, and visual storytelling.
Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Lean UX, and product development environments with cross-functional teams.
Proven ability to collaborate effectively with clients and stakeholders within project engagements, building trusted relationships and driving alignment.
Strong analytical, communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
Ability to leverage user insights, analytics, and UX metrics to drive data-informed design decisions.
Additional Information

UX Practice Development and Design Operations

Working across Agile product and engineering environments

Job Summary
This opportunity is in the global operations teams of EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) which is rapidly growing. As our efforts towards building a better working world, GDS operations need to create an evolving framework of CRM Operational excellence framework control in all processes, decision making and activities for GDS operations to enable our business teams across locations.
As an Associate Risk Management Analyst, you will take on a more advanced role in supporting the risk management department. Building on the foundational skills developed at the Associate level, you will have increased responsibilities in managing risk management tools, performing more complex tasks related to client and engagement acceptance, and contributing to the continuous improvement of risk management processes. You will also mentor junior team members and provide more in-depth analysis and reporting.
Responsibilities
Manage more complex aspects of risk management tools, including advanced troubleshooting and problem resolution.
Lead the implementation of new features or updates in risk management systems, including coordinating with IT and other relevant teams.
Ensure data integrity within risk management tools, performing regular audits and making necessary corrections.
Conduct detailed reviews of client and engagement documentation, identifying and assessing potential risks.
Assist in developing and refining processes for client and engagement acceptance to improve efficiency and compliance.
Liaise with the onshore team and other departments to resolve any issues related to client and engagement acceptance.
Prepare and analyze complex reports on risk management activities, identifying trends and areas for improvement.
Support the development of compliance frameworks and contribute to internal audits by providing necessary documentation and insights.
Act as a point of contact for more complex queries and issues, both from within the team and from other departments.
Contribute to the ongoing improvement of risk management processes, identifying areas for efficiency gains or risk reduction.
Participate in cross-functional projects aimed at enhancing overall risk management capabilities within the organization.
Stay current with industry trends, best practices, and regulatory changes, and share relevant insights with the team.
Qualification, Skills, and attributes for success
Bachelors degree in finance, business, risk management, or a related field.
1-3 years of experience in risk management, finance, or a related area.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Experience with risk management tools and systems is highly desirable.
Excellent communication and leadership skills.
This is a hybrid role.
What we look for
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Proactive approach to identifying and solving problems.
Strong mentoring and leadership capabilities

Job Title: Global Account Financial Advisor Position Summary
The Global Account Financial Advisor (GAFA) is a finance professional with robust knowledge and experience that is dedicated to one or more of the most complex global accounts serviced by EY. The GAFA will provide insight into the accounts global financial performance as well as forward thinking modeling and advice to support financial decisions. Additionally, the GAFA will introduce implementation frameworks for key financial processes in order to optimize global performance while providing a clear view of the account performance to account, regional and finance leadership teams.
Essential Functions of the Job Financial planning and performance
Deliver margin modeling and advise GCSP on the financial aspect of accounts strategic planning process. Continually monitor and measure financial success of strategy.
Model and advise on stretch vs. achievable targets for the accounts annual revenue plan, monitor that effective ownership over revenue plan components is assumed across account leadership team.
Advise on performance and forecast expectations against revenue plan throughout the year, provide GCSP with insights and recommendations to achieve optimal financial performance.
Validate accuracy of accounts reported financial data.
Margin optimization
Model and advise on where and how to improve account margin, agree with GCSP on targets for improvement, continually measure success of improvement strategy.
Establish and promote adherence to improvement frameworks across the account in order to manage and maximize margin performance across all engagements.
Analyze margin performance throughout the year, making ongoing recommendations for optimization.
Provide account team with robust margin modeling in support of developing a sound pricing strategy on the largest and most complex pursuits.
Analyze engagement margin drivers (e.g. leverage model, work location) and collaborate to course correct or maximize results where applicable.
Contract Management
Establish and socialize framework to apply Master Service Agreement (MSA), rate cards and other client procurement requirements on all engagements across the account.
Provide account teams with a clear understanding of the impact / benefit of applying MSA, rate cards and other client procurement requirements on the largest and most complex pursuits to achieve the best margin outcome.
Master Service Agreement/Rate Card Development
Provide robust margin modeling and advice to GCSP in support of pricing decisions and negotiation.
Account revenue planning
Facilitate the development of accounts revenue plan, securing ownership with key stakeholders.
Working Capital Management
Constantly analyze account level billed and unbilled inventory levels, advising on any potential exposure or risk which might impact margin performance.
Abidance to Q&RM
Highlight any potential Q&RM issues that become visible through accounts financial reporting.
Knowledge Share and Development
Work with G360 finance community, share policies, expertise, ideas and successes. Bring leading practices to own accounts.
Client centric business focused reporting :
Leverage global leading practice and support on reporting, and on all other account and engagement processes for the benefit of own accounts.
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities
Strong analytical skills are essential for the GAFA role. Common areas where the Global Account Financial Advisor would apply these skills are:
Analysing large quantities of data in order to form and communicate a crisp view of the global account performance landscape.
Continuously advising the account leadership team on expected financial performance vs. plan based upon analytics such as trend analysis and modelling of forward looking scenarios.
Providing financial modelling and advice to support pricing decisions.
Detailed analysis of financial performance in order to determine cause and effect correlations.
Developing financial forecast scenarios for account performance based on information such as sales pipeline, resourcing, etc.
Assessing the drivers of financial results with constant focus on improvement and rapid course correction where necessary.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements
Fluent in English written and verbal
Able to work in a self-sufficient manner, operating across multiple projects and priorities
Understands the commercial drivers of account performance
Focuses on solutions that drive continuous improvement of account performance
Synthesizes and communicates detailed financial information in support of an effective decision making process
Navigates the full extent of accessible EY resources to deliver effective solutions
Demonstrates the ability to apply a forward thinking customer focused lens to developing business solutions
Utilizes sound financial practices to support operational decisions
Forms and communicates a clear and concise view of financial performance
Drives interactions that build trust and manage expectations with all stakeholders

Description:
Technology Consulting Senior Consultant Microsoft Purview
We are seeking an experienced Security Consultant Microsoft Purview to design, implement, and support enterprise data protection and compliance solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Microsoft Purview Data Security services, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Classification and Sensitivity Labeling, Insider Risk Management, and Data Lifecycle Management. The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders, compliance teams, and technical teams to protect sensitive information, reduce insider risks, and ensure regulatory compliance across the organization's data estate.
Your Key Responsibilities Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
Design, implement, and optimize Microsoft Purview DLP policies across Microsoft 365 services, endpoints, and supported third-party repositories.
Define detection logic using Sensitive Information Types (SITs), trainable classifiers, custom classifiers, and EDM.
Monitor DLP incidents and provide recommendations for policy tuning and risk reduction.
Support deployment of Endpoint DLP controls for data exfiltration prevention.
Data Classification & Labeling
Develop enterprise data classification frameworks aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
Configure and manage Sensitivity Labels, Label Policies, Auto-labeling, and Mandatory Labeling strategies.
Perform data discovery and classification workshops with business stakeholders.
Support protection technologies including encryption, content markings, and access controls.
Insider Risk Management
Configure and manage Insider Risk Management policies and analytics.
Investigate insider risk alerts and collaborate with security, legal, compliance, and HR teams during investigations.
Develop insider risk use cases focused on data theft, data leakage, security policy violations, and privilege misuse.
Produce risk reports and executive dashboards.
Data Lifecycle Management
Implement retention labels, retention policies, disposition reviews, and records management controls.
Support regulatory and compliance requirements through information governance processes.
Assist in defining data retention schedules and defensible data disposal strategies.
Collaborate with stakeholders to automate lifecycle management processes.
Consulting & Delivery
Conduct workshops, assessments, and requirement-gathering sessions.
Develop solution designs, implementation plans, and governance frameworks.
Support Proof of Concepts (PoCs), pilot deployments, and production rollouts.
Create technical documentation, operational runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials.
Provide troubleshooting support and operational guidance for Purview solutions.
Stay current with Microsoft Purview roadmap, emerging data protection trends, and compliance requirements.
Skills and attributes for success Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Purview Data Security and Compliance solutions.
Expertise in:
Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
Sensitivity Labels and Information Protection
Data Classification and Governance
Insider Risk Management
Data Lifecycle Management (desirable)
Records Management (desirable)
Communication Compliance (desirable)
eDiscovery (desirable)
Experience with Microsoft 365 Compliance Centre and Microsoft Purview Portal.
Understanding of regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001.

Job Summary
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Service line - Position Title: TechOps_SDT_AUTOMATION AI_Manager 2
At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.
Well help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
About Global Delivery Services
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda.
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY's global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
The Opportunity
This role provides the opportunity to lead the enhancement, scalability, and support of AI agentic solutions built using Python, FastAPI, and LangGraph. As a Technical Lead, you will guide engineering efforts, identify high-impact automation opportunities, define architectural standards, and drive the technical roadmap for intelligent AI automation systems across the organization.
Your Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, enhancement, and support of backend systems and AI agentic workflows
Architect scalable solutions using Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, and containerized environments
Identify, prioritize, and drive automation opportunities across AI-powered applications
Mentor and guide engineers; perform design/code reviews and uphold engineering best practices
Define patterns for multi-step agent workflows, state management, and agent reliability
Lead troubleshooting and performance optimization across backend services and AI agents
Collaborate with product, data science, and platform teams to align technical execution with business strategy
Oversee schema design and integrations for MongoDB and PostgreSQL
Establish standards for CI/CD, observability, and production readiness of AI automation solutions
Skills and attributes for success
Strong leadership with the ability to guide teams in complex backend and AI workflow development
Deep analytical and debugging capabilities across distributed and agentic systems
Ability to drive architectural decisions and ensure scalability, reliability, and performance
Proactive mindset for identifying automation opportunities and improving existing workflows
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
To qualify for the role, you must have
Degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science
Core Python Expertise
Deep understanding of data structures (Lists, Dictionaries, Tuples, Sets) and OOP principles.
Strong experience designing modular, maintainable, high-performance Python applications.
Expertise in profiling, debugging, dependency management, and unit testing.
Hands-on experience designing schemas and integrating MongoDB and PostgreSQL.
FastAPI & Backend Architecture
Proven track record architecting and delivering production-grade APIs with FastAPI
Strong knowledge of Pydantic models, async/await patterns, authentication frameworks, and API security
Expertise with Docker, Docker Compose, YAML-based configurations, and container networking
LangGraph & AI Agentic Workflows
Experience architecting multi-step agent workflows using nodes, edges, and centralized state management
Ability to define patterns for conversation state handling, context propagation, retries, and fallback logic
Strong skills in debugging failed agent flows and tracing execution paths
Ideally, you'll also
Experience building microservices or distributed backend systems
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) and modern DevOps pipelines
Experience with LLM-based applications or AI automation tooling
Prior experience leading or mentoring engineering teams
What we look for
A strategic technical leader passionate about AI automation and agentic system design
Someone who brings both architectural vision and hands-on engineering excellence

Job Summary
TC - MENA Technology - AIML Developer Senior
As part of the TC- MENA Technology team, Senior role create value by helping clients solve complex business problems through differentiated technological solutions. As an AIML developer, we are looking for skilled developers who have experience in designing & developing Machine learning models, collaborate with business stakeholders and identify AI solutions & mentoring juniors in the team .
The opportunity
We are seeking a self-motivated and highly organized candidate with a passion for innovation and a strong desire to learn and adopt new technologies. You should be comfortable working independently and as part of a team and have a proven track record of delivering successful AI projects.
Your key responsibilities
Design, develop, and train machine learning models using various algorithms and techniques (e.g., neural networks, deep learning, reinforcement learning).
Adapt pre-trained Gen AI models / fine-tune Gen AI models to specific tasks or domains, ensuring optimal performance.
Develop effective prompts and techniques to guide Gen AI models and generate high-quality outputs.
Optimize AI algorithms for performance, efficiency, and scalability.
Stay updated on the latest advancements in AI and explore new techniques and applications.
Work closely with other teams (e.g., data scientists, software engineers) to integrate AI solutions into existing products or services.
Uphold ethical AI practices, ensuring compliance with data privacy laws and addressing bias and fairness in AI applications.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their needs and develop AI solutions that deliver tangible value.
To qualify for the role you must have
B.E/ B.Tech/ MCA/ MS /M.Tech or equivalent degree in Computer Science discipline.
Minimum 4 8 years of experience in IT industry with at least 2+ years of experience in AI.
Proven track record of working in AI projects from inception to successful deployment.
Strong programming skills, preferably in Python, and experience with machine learning frameworks.
Exposure / Experience in cloud services like Azure for deploying machine learning models and leveraging cloud-based machine learning services.
Familiarity with relational databases like SQL Server / My SQL / PostgreSQL.
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or similar tools for containerization and orchestration of machine learning applications.
Knowledge / Experience in AI frameworks and technologies, such as GANs, transformers, and reinforcement learning.
Hands-on experience in developing Generative AI solutions using Large Language models preferably Azure OpenAI.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with team members and stakeholders.

Job Summary
The NG SIEM Senior role leads ingestion engineering, detection creation, and integrated case management and correlation workflows. This role partners with threat, cloud, and IR teams to enhance automation, reduce noise, and strengthen the SIEMSOAR ecosystem.
Key Responsibilities
Lead onboarding of strategic log sources via Cribl, cloud collectors, API pipelines.
Build and optimize parsing, normalization, and enrichment logic.
Create advanced detections mapped to MITRE ATT&CK using SPL/KQL/CQL/CQL-Advanced.
Design and optimize correlation logic using Fusion/ML-based engines.
Lead tuning and noise-reduction activities for Fusion correlation rules.
Oversee case lifecycle management: triage workflows, enrichments, severity logic, and SLA tracking.
Develop and maintain SOAR playbooks for automated enrichment, notifications, containment tasks.
Integrate external systems (EDR, IAM, Email, Firewall) into SOAR workflows.
Conduct root-cause analysis for ingestion and correlation gaps.
Collaborate with Threat Intel and Detection teams for new use cases.
Leverage AI assistants like Charlotte AI and Sentinel Copilot to optimize detection creation, accelerate query building, and reduce investigation time.
Integrate Microsoft Sentinel with Copilot to enable AI-driven incident summarization, RCA assistance, KQL generation, and automated SOC workflows.
Evaluate and implement AIpowered SOAR capabilities, including automated enrichment, clustering of similar alerts, and anomalybased playbook triggers.
Skills & Experience
36 years in SIEM engineering or SOC detection.
Strong hands-on experience with Fusion Correlation Engine (CrowdStrike), Azure Sentinel Analytics, or Splunk ES Correlation Searches.
Experience creating/maintaining SOAR playbooks (Fusion workflows, Sentinel Logic Apps, Splunk SOAR).
Deep knowledge of case management workflows and alert lifecycle governance.
Strong in ingestion engineering using Cribl Stream & Lake.
Expertise in SPL, KQL, CQL query languages.
Understanding of data models, schemas, threat modelling.

Description:
Senior Real Estate Hospitality & Tourism Valuation
We are looking for a Senior-level professional with expertise in Real Estate Hospitality & Tourism (RHT) Valuation to join EY-Ps Valuation Modeling & Economics sub-service line within Transactions Corporate Finance (TCF) team. TCF department is a unique nexus between the corporate finance and the M&A transactions landscape, with a focus on Transaction Diligence, Valuation, Modeling & Economics, M&A Advisory and Real Estate Advisory. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a prominent firm and develop your career through a broad range of engagements, mentoring, and learning & development.
Your key responsibilities
Lead RHT Valuation engagements primarily for financial reporting purposes, ensuring quality and timely delivery and high-quality results for all clients.
Develop and maintain financial and valuation models using tools like MS Excel, while guiding junior staff in model creation and improvement.
Participate in real estate advisory engagements, including financial analyses, cash flow modeling, property/portfolio modeling, analytical model reviews, market due diligence, asset valuations, real estate appraisals, and appraisal reviews.
Conduct fair value assessments for various property types, including multi-family residential, office, retail, hotel, warehouse, industrial, mixed-use, infrastructure, and special-use properties.
Contribute to report preparation, financial modeling, and identification of key issues, proposing solutions where necessary.
Conduct market information research and market studies, analyze real estate documents, and prepare comprehensive reports.
Utilize advanced tools and technologies or software to enhance the valuation process and ensure accuracy.
Stay updated on current business, economic trends and sector outlook, incorporating relevant information into valuation models and client engagements.
Supervise and collaborate with junior team members, mentoring and guiding them in modeling, analysis, and reporting tasks.
Manage relationships with MENA stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and understanding of valuation results.
Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills, presenting findings and recommendations to senior management and clients.
Take an active role in process improvement, suggesting strategies to optimize workflows and increase the efficiency of valuations and reporting.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A post graduate degree in Finance, Economics or CA / ACCA / CFA Charter holder or MBA Finance from a reputed top tier B-School shall also be considered
A minimum of 3 to 5 years direct experience in utilizing Valuation techniques and methodologies such as Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), Income Approach, market comparable etc. in a business valuation firm or practice or in venture capital, investment banking, commercial banking, financial research, national valuation firm or experience working in a corporate finance role for an organization, preferably for M&A activities. Skills and attributes for success
Analytical Ability: Strong analytical skills in supported core technologies, particularly in managing large user bases, to effectively design, test, implement, troubleshoot and optimize mobile solutions.
Creative Problem-Solving: Ability to conceptualize innovative solutions that add value to end users, particularly in the context of mobile applications and services.
Self-Starter Mentality: A proactive and self-motivated approach to work, with the ability to take initiative and drive projects forward independently.
Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proficiency in English is required.
Interpersonal Skills: Strong interpersonal skills, sound judgment, and tact to foster collaboration with colleagues and customers across diverse cultural backgrounds.
Documentation Skills: Clear and concise documentation skills, ensuring that all processes, solutions, and communications are well-documented for future reference.
Vendor Management: Ability to manage strategic vendors, such as Microsoft, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and effective service delivery.
Cross-Cultural Awareness: Awareness of and sensitivity to cross-cultural dynamics, enabling effective collaboration with global teams and clients.
Training and Knowledge Sharing: Willingness to share knowledge and provide training, both virtually and hands-on, to empower team members and enhance overall team capability.
User Experience Focus: Passionate about improving user experience, with an understanding of how to measure, monitor, and enhance user satisfaction through feedback and analytics.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Five or more years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Intune, Entra, Entra conditional access, Mobile Device and Application Management with a thorough understanding of its design and architecture.
Proven experience in mobile platform engineering or a related field.
Solution oriented mindset with the capability to design and implement creative Mobile solutions and the ability to suggest and implement solutions that meet EY's requirements
Strong understanding of mobile technologies and security protocols, particularly within an Intune-based environment.
Experience with iOS and Android operating systems.
Proficient in PowerShell scripting for automation and management tasks.
Ability to operate proactively and independently in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with the latest trends in mobile technology.
Ability to work UK working hours
Ideally, you'll also have
Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with various stakeholders.
A proactive approach to suggesting and implementing new ideas.
Ability to explain very technical topics to non-technical stakeholders
Experience in managing and supporting large mobile environments.
Testing and Quality Assurance ensure our mobile platform meets quality, performance and security standards.
Implementation of new products and/or service offerings.
Experience with working in a large global environment
What we look for
We are looking for people who are skilled in their work, can find solutions to technical challenges, and also love to be creative and do their best. The best candidates are those who work well with others, want to learn new things, and are committed to helping our clients and making a difference.

This role offers first-hand experience of project management on a wide spectrum of services leading to skill enhancement and long-term career growth in consulting. It affords an opportunity to lead and manage as well as develop talent, contributing to success and growth of the organization.
Your key role and responsibilities
Conceptualizing visuals based on consulting business requirements presentation and documentation
Exceptional writing, speaking, proof-reading and organizational skills
Responsible for developing timely, cohesive, high-quality and competitive proposals

Talent Project Manager, Strategic Projects - Assistant Director The opportunity
We are seeking a skilled Project Manager with expertise in SAP SuccessFactors and Data Integration to lead and manage projects related to the implementation, integration, and optimization of EY Talent systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in project management, SAP SuccessFactors, and data integration methodologies, with the ability to ensure successful project delivery while meeting business objectives.
Your key responsibilities
Project Leadership: Lead end-to-end project management for strategic projects. From planning and delivery to deployment ensuring alignment with Talents strategic objectives.
Requirement Analysis: Collaborate with key stakeholders to define project scope, requirements and deliverables
Solution Design: Work with cross-functional teams to design and develop a detailed cross functional project plan, and actively manage project timelines
Resource Management: Manage project resources, including internal teams and external vendors, to ensure adequate staffing and effective utilization of resources
Risk Management: Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies, proactively addressing potential issues to ensure project success.
Budget Oversight: Perform Project Financial Management Develops overall project budget and control costs for the duration of the project, including planned, actual, and forecast for both operational and capital expenditures budget constraints
Stakeholder Communication: Foster strong communication across the project across stakeholders, team members and leadership providing regular communication of project status, updates, and progress, ensuring alignment, transparency, and effective decision-making
Quality Assurance: Ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions by establishing and maintaining project management best practices, quality standards, and testing procedures
Change Management: Facilitate change management activities to ensure successful adoption of new systems and processes by end-users
Documentation: Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, status reports, meeting minutes, and lessons learned
Skills and attributes for success
Strong leadership skills, with the ability to motivate teams and drive project success
Excellent project management skills, including planning, organizing, and managing resources
Effective communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal
Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills, with keen attention to detail.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with changing priorities
Proficiency in project management software tools
Ability to work efficiently and effectively with global teams virtually disbursed around the globe
Ability to use approved AI components at EY to help drive efficiencies
To qualify for this role
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field
Proven experience as a Project Manager in SAP SuccessFactors implementations and data integration projects
As a Project Manager, 5 to 7 years of industry experience preferably in Talent
Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, tools, and best practices
Relevant certifications such as PMP (Project Management Professional) are desirable

Job Summary
The Account Manager in GDS is primarily responsible to work closely with UK Account Manager and account leadership to support the planning and implementation of the account activation strategy. The AM will closely work with the Global Client Service Partner (GCSP) and Client Executive (CE) to drive global account activation; drive account management excellence; sales and program management; and account communications & administration. He / She ensures that all locations and Service Lines (SL) of the firm are actively engaged around our global accounts and that we deliver Exceptional Client Service (ECS) in all internal and external encounters. This role will be aligned to GCSP / CE / account team and will be based in a non-client proximate location
Your key responsibilities Account Management:
Implement global Account Activation strategy, methodology and processes at Account level
Co-develop account strategy working with account leadership and drive global execution of account plan
Support account team in driving service line planning activity and account integration
Responsible to conduct Account Maturity Assessments and supports in preparation of Account Acceleration sessions
Prepare the global account meeting materials and facilitate account team meetings
Responsible for follow-up on account actions by tracking progress against deadlines and driving activity
Understand both the clients business agenda and EY services to enable leveraging the global EY network to connect our clients to the right people
Develop and manage the account onboarding process and appropriate materials
Drive the Assessment of Service Quality (ASQ) process: Collate the ASQ feedbacks in Matrix and drive action after interviews and year-end follow-up
Act as a project manager for Account specific initiatives/projects
Review of account financials to provide awareness to account leadership on drivers of account performance
Monitoring of operational metrics important to team each month and working with account partners or service line leaders on troubleshooting issues
Support special projects as needed that require financial data/analysis
Sales and Program Management:
Manage the annual global revenue planning process with the G360 Business Development Leader (BDL) and GCSP
Own and manage the Client Relationship Management (CRM) process
Co-develop the account relationship strategy, including management of the global relationship map
Manage the account pipeline process and drive discipline across global team
Coordinate the pursuit process for opportunities, working closely with key partners
Execute win/loss debriefs
Identify EY thought leadership and insights to be shared with the client
Creation and maintenance of account marketing materials (i.e. team brochure discussion relationship history, or Value Scorecard or procurement showcase doc)
Develop and maintain relationship of Account Managers, Market Segment Managers, to understand latest market- place, alliance, and solution activity within sector or like accounts
Information and Knowledge Management
Be strategic to collaborate and partner with enabling functions of EY in supporting the account (where applicable):
Offshore Account Enablement team in India pipeline management, financial analysis, sales cycle support, client research, Account plan management
EY Knowledge Account Analysis, Quarterly earnings call summaries, travel packs on clients business, competitive landscape
Finance Any financial needs of the account
Brand, Marketing and Communications Account specific events, targeted thought leadership
Administrative Support Meeting scheduling and any other administrative tasks
Global Sector/Industry Identify market trends and EY insights
Service lines and geographies - Create process flows required for the team to capture information across account
Build and manage a repository of team information (i.e. MSA, Rate Card, SOW templates, onboarding documents, team process documents, qualifications, etc.) and guide team on how to access and use
Develop and maintain relationships with the account teams to understand best practices for team information and knowledge management
Marketing Management
Development and execution of account marketing plan to include
Distribution of thought leadership and/or event invites to relationships targets
Alumni relations
Support creation and distribution of team communications (i.e. team/client newsletter, WIN announcements)
Develop and maintain relationships with account teams to understand best practices for marketing activities
Communications and Administration
Serves as subject matter expert for all information related to the account
Leverage EY resources to support the account
In consultation with account leadership manages Account specific events, identifies and leverages targeted thought leadership
Global Sector/Industry - Identify market trends and EY insights to take to account
Serve as the knowledge steward of the account and with the assistance of EY Knowledge, connect global team to EY tools and client business issues
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:
May be required to make decisions on behalf of Partners to expedite results
Influences without direct authority, frequently providing coaching and input to a high level of firm leadership
Skills and attributes for success
Project Management

Description:
Job Summary
The Engagement Business Partner (EBP) is a finance professional with comprehensive knowledge of systems, processes, and policies. In this internal role, the EBP acts as the Finance single point of contact, collaborating closely with client-serving engagement teams to enable the successful delivery of engagements across the full engagement lifecycle, from opportunity creation to final record archiving. Please note: this is not a technical accounting role.
The opportunity
As a senior Engagement Business Partner, you will play a pivotal role in supporting client-serving teams by ensuring the accurate and timely execution of all engagement lifecycle activities. The main components of this role are:
Serving as the Finance single point of contact for Engagement Partners and Managers, offering guidance and overseeing all aspects of the Opportunity Engagement Lifecycle (OEL).
Overseeing the completion of OEL tasks by delegating to Centres of Excellence (CoEs), and monitoring progress to ensure timely delivery.
Proactively managing financial and quality related risks across your engagement portfolio, intervening where needed to provide strategic advice to uplift the compliance and revenue stability of your portfolio.
Ensure compliance with service line specific policies and parameters.
Supporting the annual external audit process.
This is a dynamic and rewarding role that contributes to profitable growth and high-quality client service.
Your key responsibilities
Manage a portfolio of client opportunities and engagements, acting as the Finance single point of contact for the Engagement Partners with complex portfolios.
Manage the professional development, coaching and upskilling of other EBPs in the team.
Oversee team resourcing, proactively tracking joiners, leavers, and movers, and ensuring coverage of Partner portfolios during periods of leave or absence.
Coordinate with client servers and CoEs to:
Apply knowledge of service line specific OEL policies and guidelines to ensure compliance across the OEL lifecycle.
Monitor and advise on risk assessment and compliance processes.
Advise on pricing models and engagement budgets.
Assess financial implications of engagement structures and budgets.
Support and challenge the Estimate-to-Complete (ETC) processes and related financial updates.
Support the portfolios working capital activity.
Provide challenge and best practice insights to client servers where required such as through optimal margin, pricing plans or engagement structures.
Upskill and share knowledge with client servers on OEL best practice, standards and tools.
Develop a diverse network of relationships across Finance and non-Finance stakeholders to provide holistic Finance support for Engagement Partners and escalate queries beyond remit to other functional experts within Finance (e.g. PFAs).
Review work performed by CoEs for accuracy and take ownership of OEL tasks when urgent needs arise.
Seek to understand client-server needs, demands, and the nuances of the specific Service Line to deepen insights and strategic thinking.
Share best practices across the EBP group to drive consistency and excellence.
Engage with CoE Managers to flag issues, trends or knowledge required for CoE upskilling.
Provide subject matter expertise in delivering training on OEL best practices for CoEs.
Support continuous improvement through identifying opportunities for innovation and automation.
Skills and attributes for success
Deliver with pace ensuring activities are executed accurately in a fast-moving environment.
Ability to engage proactively with Engagement Partners to anticipate upcoming needs and ensure OEL requirements are met on time.
Strong interpersonal skills with a good understanding of the client server perspective and ability to build relationships with them.
Confident communicator who can challenge constructively and influence outcomes.
Excellent analytical and commercial acumen, with high attention to detail.
Take ownership of monthly activities, driving progress and proactively managing business outcomes to meet deadlines and performance targets.
Quick learner with a proactive approach and eager to share knowledge with others.
Ability to translate complex technical system language into business-relevant terms.
Skilled listener with sound judgment and the ability to escalate appropriately.
Ability to lead others and support team development.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A minimum of two to three years experience in a client-facing or finance-related role within a professional services or corporate environment.
Experience managing stakeholders and delivering high-impact client service.
Ability to lead others in hybrid and fast-paced environments.
Used to working in a fast-paced environment with a strong work ethic.
Ability to build relationships with people at all levels within the firm.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, SharePoint).
Adaptability and resilience in fast-paced environments.
What we look for
Highly motivated, good communicators who can establish credibility with client servers and convey financial impacts in business language back to client servers. You will also need to be a team player who is not only looking to enhance their own career but recognises the value in strengthening the team.

Job Summary
Senior Information Security Business Analyst
InfoSec provides reliable, secure, and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 300,000 EY people.
Information Security takes a proactive approach to protecting EY's brand through robust technical security controls, a clearly defined security strategy and ongoing compliance and incident management programs designed to detect and protect against increasingly sophisticated threats against the organization.
You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
The Opportunity
The Senior Security Business Analyst role within the Enterprise Security Program is essential for supporting security initiatives by ensuring that business and security requirements are accurately captured, documented, communicated, and managed. The role partners with project stakeholders and Information Security Services to evaluate needs, propose solutions, and facilitate agreement on implementation. As a subject matter expert, the Senior Security Business Analyst provides actionable insights that enable effective decision-making and risk mitigation.
As a member of the Information Security Service Delivery team, the Senior Security Business Analyst role successfully and efficiently drives business process improvement via the methodical investigation, analysis, review and documentation of all or part of a business in terms of business functions and processes.
Your key responsibilities
Elicita on, analyzing, documen ng, and managing business and security requirements for complex projects within the Enterprise Security Program.
Collabora on with business, security, technical, and project management stakeholders to ensure requirements are clear, feasible, and aligned with organiza onal objec ves.
Partnering with Security Quality Assurance staff to validate and test security solu tions to confirm they meet documented requirements.
Tracing requirements to the corresponding code, policy, confirma tion, or other implementa tion ar facts, as well as to the test cases that validate them.
Contribu ng to con nuous improvement of security business analysis processes and tools as a subject ma er expert both in terms of business analysis and the security domain.
Sharing of knowledge and best prac ces with peers to support team effec veness.
Skills and attributes for success
To be successful in this role, candidates should possess the following core skills:
Identity and Access Management
Elicitation techniques
Stakeholder engagement
Requirements management methodologies and tools
Security technologies (cloud, network, perimeter, messaging, endpoint, and data security)
Process re-engineering
Business analysis
Data modeling
Requirements modeling
Desired qualifications
Preferably 810 years experience in business analysis within the information security domain for large, geographically diverse programs.
Strong expertise in security technologies (cloud, network, perimeter, messaging, endpoint, and data security).
Proficiency in requirements management methodologies and tools.
Advanced communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CBAP) are highly desirable.

Job Summary
The Sales Performance Management Operations Analyst will provide hands-on operational, compliance, audit, and governance support across recurring Sales Performance Management processes. The role will coordinate deal validation, questionnaires, audits, mailbox activity, documentation, data checks, reporting, user administration, and business follow-up to help ensure that critical activities are completed accurately, consistently, and on time. The successful candidate will be organized, detail-oriented, responsive, and comfortable operating across multiple stakeholders and systems. The position will also provide trained backup coverage for selected PowerApps, reporting, and access-administration activities, reducing key-person dependency and supporting continuity as operational demand and audit scope expand.
Role Title
Sales Performance Management Operations Analyst
Key responsibilities Deal Operations and Request Management
Administer and triage the Deal Impact mailbox, categorize requests, maintain action trackers, coordinate responses, and escalate overdue or high-risk items. Support Mega Deal oversight, eligibility validation, evidence collection, and stakeholder follow-up.
Respond to seller and business partner inquiries, ensuring clear ownership, accurate routing, and timely resolution.
Maintain organized records of requests, decisions, approvals, supporting documents, and outcomes.
Questionnaire and Audit Administration
Coordinate distribution, tracking, follow-up, escalation, and status reporting for win validation questionnaires.
Administer T4C audits, origination credit reviews, contingent fee compliance activities, and related evidence-management requirements.
Support credit adjustment reconciliation across relevant systems and investigate discrepancies with process owners.
Provide operational support for renewal and expansion/extension audit programs as they are introduced.
Maintain complete, audit-ready documentation and promptly identify missing, inconsistent, or overdue submissions.
Compliance, Governance, and Controls
Execute recurring controls in line with documented procedures, service expectations, and governance requirements.
Monitor due dates, exceptions, and unresolved actions; provide timely escalation and transparent status updates.
Support segregation of duties by maintaining clear evidence of review, approval, and process ownership.
Identify control gaps, recurring issues, and opportunities for standardization, simplification, or automation.
Assist with preparation of audit responses, compliance reporting, process documentation, and operating procedures.
Data, Reporting, and Systems Support
Perform data validation, reconciliation, quality checks, and operational reporting for SPM activities.
Support data loads, integrations, issue investigation, user acceptance testing, and deployment validation.
Provide trained backup support for the Validation PowerApp, Quota Setting PowerApp, Power BI reporting, SPM Hub, and associated access administration.
Maintain access records and assist with timely provisioning, modification, and removal requests in accordance with approved controls.
Document recurring technical procedures and known issues to strengthen continuity and knowledge transfer.
Stakeholder Coordination and Continuous Improvement
Coordinate with sellers, business leaders, Finance, Compensation, Compliance, Audit, Operations, and technical teams to resolve operational issues.
Communicate progress, risks, exceptions, and dependencies clearly and professionally.
Build and maintain process trackers, work instructions, job aids, handover documentation, and performance metrics.
Crosstrain on critical activities and provide continuity coverage during planned and unplanned absences.
Contribute to enhancements and automation initiatives that improve accuracy, turnaround time, scalability, and stakeholder experience.
Qualifications
A bachelors degree or equivalent relevant experience in business operations, finance, accounting, sales operations, data analysis, or a related field.
Relevant experience in operations coordination, compliance administration, audit support, sales operations, compensation operations, or another transaction-based business process environment.
Demonstrated ability to manage trackers, deadlines, documentation, stakeholder follow-up, and recurring control activities with attention to details
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365 applications.
Experience handling confidential or sensitive business information with appropriate judgment and discretion.
Preferred Experience
Experience supporting Sales Performance Management, sales compensation, deal governance, crediting, or validation processes.
Exposure to PowerApps, Power Automate, Power BI, SharePoint, data integrations, or user-access administration.
Experience working in EY, a Big 4 organization, professional services, or a comparable global matrix environment.
Experience supporting audits, compliance reviews, control testing, reconciliations, or evidence-management processes.
Familiarity with process documentation, user acceptance testing, reporting support, and automation initiatives.

Job purpose
This role focuses on the consolidation, aggregation and analysis of all financial planning, analysis and decision support activities for the Global Information Technology (EY Technology) function within EY. This is a key support role to the Associate Director, EY Technology Finance and is a strategic business partner to the group. This role is expected to support the Associate Director, EY Technology Finance in providing financial direction on IT globalization efforts as well as to help drive the development, implementation and execution of action plans. This role will be global in nature.
This will be a critical role for consolidating the overall EY Technology financials, the running costs of all IT projects, and of the planning, forecasting and budgeting costs
Your client responsibilities
Supporting the consolidation of all planning, budgeting, forecasting, activities for the global EY Technology groups. Specific focus will be placed on tracking meeting action items during these activities and follow up with Finance leads to ensure needed action items are addressed in time for timely and accurate consolidations.
Provides financial input and details to finance leads on decision-making issues and action items impacting IT, focusing specifically on new consolidation activities for accurate reporting.
Identifies significant operational and financial variances across the teams. Provides supporting details to Associate Director, EY Technology Finance to enable working with Business Aligned CFO roles to develop and understand variance analyses and recommends mitigating action plans. Executes against those action plans.
Teams with Associate Director, EY Technology Finance to drive financial operational excellence for IT costs
Works with geography analysts to get in-depth details to bring increased transparency and understanding around IT costs
Participates in Global Finance work stream initiatives at the request of the Associate Director, EY Technology Finance
Participates with broader EY Technology Finance team and supports staff members directly or indirectly in the development, implementation, and support of financial visibility to meet their business requirements
Fosters an environment that promotes the sharing of knowledge and leading practices, and builds on learning to serve the organization
Promotes effective teaming and strong utilization of Shared Services resources
Technical skills requirements
Bachelors degree in Accounting or Finance
MBA or CPA (or equivalent) desirable
Knowledge of Business Objects, GftFR, Hyperion SmartView, Essbase, SQL query and advanced level in Excel
Experience in SAP desirable
Experience in working in a globally deployed accounting organization
At least 5+ years of experience in finance processes and policies
Experience in managing a similar consolidation function with a strong preference for previous experience in a technology environment
Additional skills requirements
Strong understanding of IT Finance demonstrating knowledge of technology finance
Strong listening, consultative, influencing and communication skills
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong time management and multi-tasking skills, and an ability to work well under deadlines, with attention to detail
Outstanding interpersonal skills
English language skills excellent written and oral communication
