Job Title: Learning Deployment Specialist
Job Summary
Talent Services is a core service line within the Global Delivery Services organization, providing multiple HR and learning related support services including Recruitment support, Onboarding support, People Data Administration, Learning Administration, Cross Border Travel, Global Mobility and Performance Management support to EY member firms.
Talent Services supports Europe West (EW) and acts as part of the extended Region Learning team. It is fully integrated with onshore colleagues, participating in meetings, projects and planning activities as part of one team and is aligned with the Learning Global Process Model and initiates learning processes via existing workflow (SNOW intake forms) for execution by CAT and DAT teams.
This role is responsible for the deployment of multiple courses and learning events within one or more curriculum for EY Germany working alongside the Senior Deployment specialist and/or Learning Program Manager. Supports learning administration activities and monitors course feedback and evaluation results.
Applications Used: SuccessFactors (Learning Management System), Service-Now
Responsibilities
Build initial course scheduling offering schedule for review
Submit requests to Schedule Offerings and to publish content in SuccessFactors
Support the operational execution of learning deployment plans, including budget tracking, cost administration and coordination of event-related activities.
Monitor participant nominations in collaboration with DAT teams.
Manage learner cancellations, no-shows and missed sessions, including the coordination of alternative training dates and nominations.
Prepare facilitators for delivery of learning courses (logistics) and coordinate facilitator logistics and communications
Support event administration within learning systems by creating event codes, uploading participant data, agendas, and cost documentation, monitoring administrative completion, and facilitating event closure activities.
Coordinate operational event requirements, including badge production, print requests, participant materials, and other logistical activities required for successful event delivery, where responsibility has been assigned to the Deployment team
Manage and maintain learning-related SharePoint sites and maintain content relevancy for SL, curriculum, program or course including joining instructions (if required), learner, facilitator information
Build and maintain close working relationships with EY Germany learning team
Contribute to other activities or projects across the wider Talent Development function
Ensure appropriate CE credits are awarded to learning participants and instructors, where applicable.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements
Understanding of EY and EY Talent
Experience with learning management systems (preferably SuccessFactors Learning).
Strong organizational skills with a structured and detail-oriented working style and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels
Strong team player with an enthusiastic, can-do approach and the ability to collaborate effectively as part of one team.
Ability to build effective working relationships across global and regional teams.
Drive and deliver quality services and products to Talent
Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly
Knowledge of existing AI tools and capabilities, with the ability to identify, evaluate, and leverage AI-driven solutions to improve processes, efficiency, and user experience
Strong IT skills Microsoft Office 365 suite Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, SharePoint, etc
Proactive problem solver with solutions mindset
Service-oriented mindset with a strong commitment to delivering an excellent learner and stakeholder experience.
Flexibility to support business-critical activities during peak periods in alignment with local labor regulations and business needs.
Professional working proficiency in English; German language skills are advantageous.
Job Requirements Education
Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Experience or specialization in Human Resources is considered an advantage.
Experience
3+ years of relevant experience in Learning Operations
Significant experience of working in HR in professional services or corporate environment
Working in international and diverse environments
Experience with SuccessFactors Learning is considered an asset. A strong willingness to learn and build expertise in learning administration systems and processes is essential.

Job Title: GDS Alliances Operations Lead Analyst
Job Summary
The GDS Alliances Operations Lead Analyst will operate from the GDS Program Operations CoE and provide structured operations, governance, stakeholder coordination, reporting, content management and execution support across multiple alliances within the broader Global Alliances and Ecosystem Relationship Enablement function. The role may support selected alliances on an ongoing basis while providing flexible, needs-based support to others in response to changing business priorities. The incumbent will help alliance leadership teams run effective, insight-led and scalable operating models by tracking priorities, managing operational cadence, improving process discipline and enabling timely execution across sell, build and deliver motions. Working closely with alliance, market, finance, contracts, training, BMC and enablement stakeholders, the role will strengthen delivery consistency, improve data and reporting quality, simplify ways of working and identify automation opportunities, including the responsible use of AI-enabled tools to reduce manual effort, enhance reporting narratives and improve operational outcomes.
Essential Functions of the Job
Serve as the central operations and PMO support point for assigned alliance activities, ensuring priorities, workstreams, owners, timelines, risks, dependencies and follow-ups are clearly captured, tracked and progressed with discipline.
Provide assigned alliance leadership teams with timely business insights through structured reporting, dashboards and executive-ready narratives covering sales, pipeline, opportunity tagging, partner-sourced and co-sell activity, prospect tracking, key GTM wins, book of business movements, partner program measures and other relevant performance indicators.
Support governance cadence for leadership meetings, QBRs, planning forums and operational reviews by developing agendas, storyboarding content, coordinating inputs, preparing meeting materials, capturing actions and tracking closure.
Maintain and continuously refresh alliance reference materials, SharePoint content, leadership-ready presentations, internal updates and other enablement assets to improve findability, consistency, relevance and adoption across stakeholder groups.
Coordinate with Brand, Marketing and Communications teams to develop, review and maintain alliance-related content, ensuring alignment with messaging standards, stakeholder expectations and partner program requirements.
Program manage partner tools, portals and operational processes across assigned alliances, including access request tracking, issue resolution, adoption monitoring, certification and skills currency tracking, training coordination and tool administration support.
Work with alliance investment, finance, legal and enablement teams to support applicable market development fund, co-investment and related funding processes across assigned alliances, including investment tracking, compliance monitoring, periodic reviews, documentation readiness, claims support and process adherence.
Support alliance contract and governance activities, including initiation and tracking of localization of global agreements, program documentation, partner designation, distinction or specialization requirements, and related compliance actions in collaboration with the Ecosystem Contracts team and relevant business stakeholders.
Partner with onshore alliance leaders and enablement contacts across assigned alliances on strategic projects, transformation initiatives, stakeholder mapping, partner offering or marketplace coordination, event or sponsorship coordination, training interventions and other priority initiatives as required.
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and improve alliance operations processes through process mapping, documentation, issue analysis, control strengthening, data quality improvement and adoption of reusable templates and playbooks.
Leverage automation and responsible AI-enabled tools, where appropriate, to reduce repetitive manual activity, improve reporting turnaround time, support content drafting, enhance insight generation, improve follow-up tracking and enable scalable service delivery.
Manage stakeholder expectations, communication plans and delivery commitments with clarity, responsiveness and strong service orientation across global and regional teams.
Knowledge and Skill Requirements
Strong understanding of alliance, ecosystem or partner program operations, preferably in a professional services, technology, consulting, shared services, GCC or global capability center environment; exposure to multiple technology partners, enterprise software, cloud, data, CRM, workflow automation, low-code platforms or digital transformation ecosystems would be advantageous.
Working knowledge of sales, revenue, pipeline, opportunity lifecycle, partner program metrics, GTM motions, co-sell or referral activity, partner distinctions, specialization requirements and performance reporting, with the ability to interpret data and convert it into concise executive-ready insights.
Strong program and project management skills, including planning, tracking, governance cadence management, risk and dependency monitoring, action follow-up and management of multiple priorities with competing deadlines.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, workflow tools or other reporting and collaboration platforms considered an advantage.
Experience with continuous improvement, process simplification and operational excellence, including process mapping, SOP development, control documentation, audit readiness, root cause analysis and issue resolution.
Ability to identify automation opportunities and apply digital tools responsibly to improve productivity, reporting quality, follow-up discipline, knowledge management and stakeholder experience.
Practical exposure to generative AI tools for research, content development, summarization, insight generation, workflow support and productivity enhancement; preferable exposure to Agentic AI concepts, AI-enabled process automation, AI agents or Copilot-style productivity tools.
Strong stakeholder management capability, with the ability to engage senior onshore stakeholders, anticipate needs, manage expectations and build trusted advisor relationships across functions and geographies.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including business writing, executive presentation development, narrative building and the ability to create high-quality content with limited initial guidance.
Strong analytical thinking, problem solving, research capability and attention to detail, with the ability to work across multiple teams to drive practical and timely resolution.
Experience working in virtual, matrixed and multi-geography environments with cultural sensitivity, collaboration discipline and a global mindset.
KNowledge of EY and GDS operations, organization structure, operating model, management information systems and independence concepts for internal candidates; Big 4, consulting, technology or leadership support exposure for external candidates would be preferred.
Job Requirements Academics
MBA, postgraduate qualification, or equivalent professional experience preferred.
Bachelors degree required; degree in business, technology, engineering, commerce, or a related discipline preferred.
Project/program management certification, process improvement certification, or relevant alliance, partner program, technology partner or enterprise software certification would be an added advantage.
Relevant certifications or digital badges in generative AI, responsible AI, AI-enabled productivity, prompt engineering, automation, analytics, or Agentic AI concepts would be highly desirable, particularly where they demonstrate practical application in business operations, reporting, process improvement, knowledge management, or stakeholder enablement.

Job Title: GDS Alliances Systems Integrator (SI) Ops Coordinator Job Summary
The GDS Systems Integrator (SI) Ops Coordinator will function out of the GDS Alliances Delivery Center and will be responsible for providing ongoing operations support for one or more Systems Integrator alliances as part of the broader Ecosystem Relationship Enablement function. The incumbent will help co-develop and thereafter operationalize the operations support delivery model for a single SI relationship or a combination of SI relationships, ensuring seamless service delivery for ongoing initiatives, governance, reporting, stakeholder coordination and special projects assigned from time to time. The role will partner with onshore alliance operations contacts, SI relationship leaders and cross-functional teams on strategic projects and initiatives as required.
Responsibilities
Provide operational support for strategic Systems Integrator alliances and ecosystem programs across planning, governance, reporting and execution activities.
Provide SI alliance leadership with effective dashboard reporting and business insights, including revenue, wins, pipeline, opportunities, investments, benefits utilization and ad-hoc data reporting requests.
Support recurring alliance governance forums, including pre-meeting, in-meeting and post-meeting support such as agenda formation, meeting deck collation, storyboarding, content curation/design, summary notes and action tracking.
Coordinate SI alliance business reviews, leadership meetings, workshops and operating reviews by managing logistics, content development, stakeholder follow-ups and closure of actions.
Support SI alliance annual planning, revenue planning, investment planning and benefits utilization tracking across area/region and global stakeholders.
Coordinate with client-serving teams and global alliance supporting teams on sales, pipeline tagging, reporting hygiene and opportunity tracking.
Maintain SI alliance reference material, playbooks, process documents and SharePoint repositories; facilitate and track access to key materials and tools.
Coordinate with Brand, Marketing and Communications (BMC) teams to develop, review and refresh relevant SI alliance content as required.
Support contracts initiation, tracking, supplier onboarding and operational workflows by coordinating with global alliance teams and relevant enabling teams.
Drive continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities for automation, standardization, simplification and improved operating rhythm across SI alliance operations.
Support executive leadership requests, special projects and strategic operational initiatives as assigned from time to time.
Knowledge and Skill Requirements
Strong understanding of alliance operations, ecosystem relationships, business operations and executive reporting processes.
Exposure to sales and pipeline reporting, opportunity life cycle concepts, revenue planning and alliance performance reporting.
Excellent MS Excel and PowerPoint skills; Power BI skills would be an added advantage.
Ability to create executive-ready dashboards, presentations, meeting materials and leadership summaries with limited guidance.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work with senior onshore stakeholders and build trusted business advisor relationships.
Job Requirements
Academics: MBA, Business Administration, Commerce, Finance or related discipline; equivalent operational management experience may be considered.
Experience: 8-10 years of relevant work experience in alliance operations, business operations, program management, reporting, sales operations or strategic operations.
Working Hours: Flexibility to support global stakeholders and US/APAC business requirements.

Job Summary
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Role
AI Governance Operations & Platform Lead
Role Purpose
The AI Governance Operations & Platform Lead is responsible for operationalizing EY's AI Governance framework across all AI and Generative AI solutions developed, deployed, or consumed within the organization. This role serves as the Product Owner and Operational Lead for the AI Governance platform, built on ServiceNow, ensuring governance requirements, risk assessments, controls, and compliance obligations are consistently implemented, monitored, and evidenced throughout the AI lifecycle.
Role Summary
Lead the operational execution of EY's AI Governance framework by owning the ServiceNow-based governance platform, ensuring AI solutions comply with governance requirements, controls, and risk management standards while enabling scalable, automated, and effective governance
Key Responsibilities AI Governance Operations
Operationalize EY's AI Governance framework across all AI, GenAI, Machine Learning, and intelligent automation solutions.
Ensure governance controls are embedded throughout the AI lifecycle, from ideation and development through deployment, monitoring, and retirement.
Drive onboarding of AI solutions into the governance platform and ensure compliance with mandatory governance requirements.
Facilitate execution of AI risk assessments, control evaluations, approvals, and periodic compliance reviews.
Monitor governance compliance metrics and identify control gaps, policy deviations, and remediation requirements.
Support audits, regulatory reviews, and internal compliance assessments related to AI governance.
AI Governance Platform Ownership
Serve as Product Owner for the ServiceNow-based AI Governance platform.
Define and prioritize platform roadmap, enhancements, user stories, and functional requirements.
Ensure governance workflows, approval processes, and control assessment mechanisms remain aligned to evolving business and regulatory requirements.
Manage platform configuration, testing, release planning, user adoption, and operational support.
Work with ServiceNow development teams to implement new governance capabilities and integrations.
Drive automation of governance activities wherever possible to improve operational efficiency and compliance monitoring.
AI Risk & Controls Management
Support management and execution of the AI Risk and Controls Matrix (RACM).
Ensure governance controls are mapped to applicable AI risks and regulatory obligations.
Monitor control implementation status and effectiveness across AI solutions.
Support implementation of Responsible AI principles, AI control standards, and compliance requirements.
Maintain governance evidence and reporting needed to demonstrate adherence to enterprise AI policies.
Stakeholder Engagement
Partner with AI product owners, engineering teams, architecture teams, across ET, CT and Info Sec, privacy, legal, risk management, and business stakeholders.
Translate governance policies and standards into practical platform workflows and operational processes.
Gather business requirements and convert them into governance platform capabilities.
Facilitate governance review meetings and provide guidance on compliance obligations and control requirements.
Act as the primary point of contact for platform-related governance inquiries.
Reporting & Continuous Improvement
Develop governance dashboards, metrics, and executive reporting.
Track platform adoption, governance coverage, control compliance, and remediation activities.
Drive continuous improvement of governance processes, controls, and platform functionality.
Benchmark governance practices against industry standards and emerging regulations.
Required Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Risk Management, or related discipline.
20+ years of experience in governance, risk management, compliance, IT controls, ServiceNow, or enterprise platform management.
Experience working with enterprise governance, compliance, workflow, or GRC platforms.
Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Experience managing process implementation across large, complex organizations.
Preferred Knowledge
AI Governance and Responsible AI frameworks
AI Risk & Controls Matrix (RACM)
AI Control Frameworks and AI Control Plans (AICP)
AI risk assessment methodologies
AI lifecycle governance processes
Regulatory frameworks such as EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and emerging AI regulations
ServiceNow platform capabilities, workflows, and integrations
Technology risk, cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance management
Key Competencies
Product Ownership
Governance & Controls Management
ServiceNow Platform Expertise
Stakeholder Management
Business Analysis
Risk & Compliance Management
Process Design & Automation
Data-Driven Decision Making
Communication & Influencing Skills

Job Summary
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Cyber Security Infrastructure Security Manager
As part of our EY Cyber Security team, you will manage infrastructure security engagements and support the design, integration and implementation of solutions that enhance service delivery and enable technology-driven transformation for our clients. You will coordinate delivery teams, manage engagement activities, maintain quality standards, and coach junior team members to support their professional development.
The opportunity
Were looking for an Infrastructure Security professional with a solution-oriented mindset, strong security engineering knowledge, and experience managing network security architecture and implementation engagements. The role requires the ability to translate client requirements into practical solutions, coordinate technical delivery, manage risks and stakeholders, and contribute to the rollout of next-generation, market-relevant security services.
Your key responsibilities
Manage the design, architecture, assessment and implementation of network security solutions across on-premises and cloud environments.
Gather business and technical requirements, develop solution approaches, and oversee preparation and review of high-level and low-level design documentation.
Lead workstreams covering next-generation firewalls, IPS/IDS, VPN, NAC, SD-WAN, DDoS protection, wireless security, WAF, secure web gateways and proxy solutions.
Provide technical oversight for solutions involving Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, Fortinet, Zscaler and comparable infrastructure security technologies.
Manage solution deployment, configuration, integration, testing, transition and operational-readiness activities in accordance with agreed scope and quality expectations.
Support Zero Trust architecture and implementation initiatives, including segmentation and micro-segmentation solutions such as Guardicore and Illumio.
Review network and platform security designs to confirm alignment with security principles, client standards, regulatory obligations and leading practices.
Manage engagement plans, delivery milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, budgets and status reporting, escalating material concerns when required.
Coordinate with client stakeholders, architects, engineers, vendors and other delivery teams to resolve technical and operational challenges.
Review network drawings, configuration standards, implementation procedures, test evidence and operational documentation for completeness and quality.
Contribute to proposals, statements of work, solution demonstrations, effort estimates and other business-development activities.
Coach team members, allocate work, review deliverables and promote consistent use of delivery methodologies, reusable assets and automation.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong technical knowledge of infrastructure and network security architecture, engineering and operations.
Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deliver high-quality outcomes within agreed scope, schedule and budget.
Sound understanding of infrastructure security services, governance models, operating models, controls and delivery methodologies.
Ability to build trusted relationships with client managers, technical leads, vendors and internal stakeholders.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, presentation and decision-making skills.
Ability to communicate technical risks, architecture decisions and delivery concerns clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
Experience supervising technical teams, reviewing deliverables, providing constructive feedback and supporting capability development.
Commercial awareness and the ability to support scoping, effort estimation, resource planning and engagement financial management.
A proactive, adaptable and collaborative approach in a fast-paced consulting environment.
Ability to create and deliver domain-specific training and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Understanding of automation opportunities that improve security operations, service quality and delivery efficiency.
Willingness to travel and work flexibly when required by client or engagement needs.
To qualify for the role, you must have
12+ years of Information Technology experience, including significant experience in infrastructure or network security and at least 5 years leading technical workstreams or small delivery teams.
Strong experience in security engineering, architecture assessments, solution design and implementation.
Hands-on knowledge of firewalls, VPN, NAC, SD-WAN, WAF, proxy, IPS/IDS, DDoS protection, EDR/XDR and related controls.
Experience deploying, maintaining or operating one or more enterprise network security platforms.
Working knowledge of Zero Trust principles, segmentation, micro-segmentation and secure access architectures.
Understanding of cloud security architecture and hybrid infrastructure security considerations.
Demonstrated experience managing client expectations, project risks, delivery quality and technical documentation.
A consultative and pragmatic approach to solving security and technology challenges.
Ideally, youll also have
Excellent verbal and written communication, technical documentation and stakeholder-management skills.
Strong project management, negotiation, team leadership and interpersonal capabilities.
Prior experience in advisory, professional services, system integration or technology consulting.
Customer-focused mindset with experience contributing to proposals, estimations and solution presentations.
Relevant professional certification such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, SABSA, TOGAF, PRINCE2 or a leading vendor security certification.
What we look for
A manager with strong technical credibility, commercial awareness and the ability to lead teams in a fast-moving consulting environment.
A collaborative professional who can work effectively with multidisciplinary teams and global EY Consulting practices across industries.
A delivery-focused individual who takes ownership of engagement outcomes, quality, team performance and client satisfaction.
Someone able to contribute to go-to-market activities, RFP responses, solution development and effort estimation.
A confident facilitator who can lead cyber security discussions with subject-matter experts, client managers, senior stakeholders and enterprise architects.

Role Overview
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
Key Responsibilities Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:
Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.
Stakeholder Management:
Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers
Product backlog and Planning:
Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).
Delivery Management:
Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
Manage the demand process
Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
Coordinate UAT and production go-live
Governance and Continuous improvement:
Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.
Innovation and Platform enablement:
Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements
Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
Strong understanding of the Moveworks platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI-driven workflow orchestration.
Knowledge of Moveworks integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification
What are we looking for?
A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence

Job Summary
As a Manager in EY GDS Tech Ops practice, you will manage the development and delivery of tools and platform solutions, blending technical expertise with delivery. The solutions will be focused on improving application performance, engineers productivity and automation. You will oversee the identification, development and operationalization of tools, and automation solutions, and ensuring alignment with EYs quality standards and client expectations. This role requires a manager with experience in implementing platforms and tools in digital engineering engagements, with a balance of hands-on technical capability and management skills.
Your Key Responsibilities
Drive the identification of opportunities, development and management of tools and platform capabilities to serve operations engineers, reducing toil and increasing productivity.
Create self-service platforms that enable operations engineer autonomy and golden paths.
Design, implement, and optimize dashboards, logs, and alerting systems using tools like Splunk, AppDynamics, Datadog etc.,
Manage observability for cloud-native workloads (AWS/Azure) and hybrid environments.
Drive automation using cloud, monitoring, and SDLC tools to integrate observability into CI/CD pipelines and ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
Bring together Cloud, AI/ML platforms, automation technologies, DevSecOps, ITSM, and observability into a coherent, supportable managed services ecosystem. Architect and integrate endtoend tool chains spanning across different tools across layers such as:
Cloud & DevSecOps: Azure (preferred), AWS, GCP; Kubernetes; Terraform; GitHub/Azure DevOps; GitOps
Data & AI: Azure OpenAI, Databricks, Snowflake, vector databases, MLOps pipelines, prompt/version management
Automation: UiPath, Power Automate, Azure Automation, eventdriven workflows
ITSM & AIOps: ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Dynatrace, Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana
Security: Entra ID, Key Vault, Sentinel/Splunk, DLP and data governance tools
Monitor production performance (SLAs/KPIs) and drive incident resolution, including on-call management.
Maintains scalable, secure, and resilient engineering / cloud application architecture while managing day-to-day operations.
Define SLAs, SLOs, OLAs, service catalogs, and automation backlogs.
Guide service onboarding, knowledge transfer (KCS), runbook creation, and CMDB population.
Drive increased automation coverage and reduced MTTR through selfhealing and AIOps patterns.
Mentor and develop junior engineers on site reliability engineering (SRE) principles.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams data engineers, Engineering teams, developers, AI / Automation team, architects, and business stakeholders to identify, and drive transformation.
Ensure compliance with EYs risk management and security standards.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong experience in public cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), DevOps, and automation tools
Strong skills in programming/scripting (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) for custom automation.
Deep understanding of SLIs, SLOs, distributed tracing, and log management.
Experience building and implementing tools, automation and AI solutions in digital engineering.
Strong track record in managing delivery quality, project execution, and cross-functional collaboration.
Strong understanding and management of ITSM, ITIL methodologies, product engineering, and agile methodologies.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelors or Masters degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
10-12+ years of experience in engineering delivery, or managed services, with at least 2-5 years in developing, implementing and managing engineering platforms, and tools.
Expert knowledge of monitoring and observability tools (E.g., Datadog / Splunk / Dynatrace / App dynamics / New Relic etc.,)
What we look for:
Enthusiastic learners with a passion for cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), DevOps, and automation tools and Strong skills in programming/scripting (Python, Bash, or PowerShell).
Problem solvers with a proactive approach to troubleshooting and optimization.
Team players who can collaborate effectively in a remote or hybrid work environment.
Detail-oriented professionals with strong documentation skills.

And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The opportunity
This role offers the opportunity to enhance, support, and scale AI agentic solutions built using Python, FastAPI, and LangGraph. As a Senior AI Automation Engineer, you will play also play a key role in identifying automation opportunities, improving existing agent workflows, and strengthening backend services that power intelligent, automated AI systems.
Your key responsibilities
Enhance, optimize, and maintain backend services supporting AI agentic workflows
Build scalable REST APIs using FastAPI with strong validation and async features
Develop, refine, and troubleshoot multi-step agent workflows using LangGraph
Identify automation opportunities across AI applications and implement scalable solutions
Containerize and deploy services using Docker and Docker Compose
Write clean, maintainable Python code with robust unit tests (pytest/unittest)
Design and manage database schemas and integrations for MongoDB and PostgreSQL
Investigate performance issues across backend and agentic systems

Strong analytical mindset with the ability to spot automation opportunities
Deep debugging capability across backend services and AI agent workflows
Ability to design modular, scalable backend components
Proactive ownership and strong collaboration skills
Comfort working in fast-paced, innovative AI environments
To qualify for the role, you must have
Degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science
Core Python
Strong foundation in Lists, Dictionaries, Tuples, Sets, and OOP (classes, inheritance, composition).
Experience in writing modular, performant code with profiling and debugging skills.
Knowledge of virtual environments, dependency management, and unit testing.
Hands-on experience with MongoDB and PostgreSQL schema design.
FastAPI & Backend Development
Proven experience building production APIs with FastAPI.
Proficiency in async/await, Pydantic models, and token-based authentication.
Working knowledge of Docker, Docker Compose, YAML setups, and container networking.
LangGraph
Experience building multi-step agent workflows (nodes, edges, state management).
Ability to manage conversation state, context propagation, retries, and fallbacks.
Strong debugging capability for agent failures and execution tracing.
Ideally, youll also have
Experience with microservices architectures.
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with LLM-based or AI automation products.
What we look for
A problem-solver passionate about AI-driven automation.
Someone who takes ownership and thrives in innovative environments.
A team player committed to building scalable AI systems with precision and quality.

Description:
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
As part of Enterprise Technology function, we are seeking Senior Program Manager / Associate Director to drive measurable business value through the successful delivery of complex, cross-functional programs and transformation initiatives.
The role is responsible for end-to-end program leadership, governance, financial oversight, risk and dependency management, stakeholder alignment, and delivery assurance across business and technology environments. The position combines strategic thinking with practical execution, while leading teams and strengthening project and program management capability.
The opportunity
We are seeking a Senior Manager / Associate Director - Project & Program Management to lead strategic programs and enterprise transformation initiatives across the enablement services functions.
As a program leader, you will translate business priorities into practical roadmaps, integrated plans, governance structures, and measurable outcomes. You will work with senior stakeholders, clients, delivery teams, and partners to manage complexity, resolve delivery challenges, and maintain focus on value, quality, cost, and timelines.
The ideal candidate brings broad experience in program management, business transformation, service transitions, and managed services, together with strong financial, commercial, people leadership, and executive communication skills.
Your key responsibilities
Lead complex, large-scale, cross-functional programs from initiation through execution, transition, and closure.
Translate strategic objectives into program roadmaps, integrated delivery plans, milestones, governance structures, and measurable outcomes.
Establish and strengthen PMO frameworks, delivery standards, executive reporting, decision forums, and delivery assurance mechanisms.
Oversee program budgets, forecasts, resource plans, cost performance, and progress against approved business cases.
Lead business transformation, operating model changes, process improvement, technology-enabled initiatives, service transitions, automation, and digital modernization.
Establish effective risk, issue, dependency, change, quality, and escalation management practices.
Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, clients, business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and strategic partners.
Lead steering committees and executive reviews, communicate program performance and trade-offs, and resolve complex stakeholder and delivery challenges.
Lead, mentor, and develop project managers, program managers, PMO professionals, workstream leads, and geographically distributed teams.
Drive operational readiness and the effective transition of solutions into managed services or business-as-usual operations where applicable.
Use project and portfolio platforms, analytics, automation, KPIs, and dashboards to improve transparency, decision-making, predictability, and benefits tracking.
Contribute to investment planning, commercial assessments, proposals, solutioning, and continuous improvement of delivery methods and reusable practices.
Skills and attributes for success
To qualify for the role you must have
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Science / Engineering, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
Typically 18+ years of progressive experience in project and program management, PMO leadership, enterprise transformation, managed services, delivery or global operations.
Proven experience leading complex programs with multiple workstreams, dependencies, senior stakeholders, and geographically distributed teams.
Strong capability in program governance, integrated planning, financial management, resource planning, risk mitigation, delivery assurance, and executive reporting.
Experience delivering business transformation, operating model change, service transition, process improvement, automation, or technology modernization initiatives.
Ability to influence senior stakeholders, facilitate decisions, manage ambiguity, and resolve complex delivery challenges.
Experience leading and developing project managers, program managers, PMO professionals, and cross-functional teams.
Strong business acumen, executive communication, negotiation, structured problem-solving, and change leadership skills.
Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches, with the judgment to select and tailor methods to program needs.
Experience using project and portfolio management tools such as Microsoft Project, Planview, Jira
Ideally, you will also have
PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, MSP, or an equivalent project, program, Agile, change, or service management certification.
Experience in professional services, consulting, IT services, global business services, regulated industries, or a large enterprise environment.
Experience contributing to business cases, commercial reviews, proposals, solutioning, or client development activities.
Experience establishing PMO or delivery governance capabilities and improving project management maturity.
What we look for
A strategic and delivery-focused leader who can connect business objectives with practical execution. Someone who combines strong program management discipline with commercial awareness, transformation experience, and sound judgment; builds trusted relationships; develops high-performing teams; and remains accountable for measurable outcomes in complex and changing environments.

Description:
Job Description - Agency Frontline Sales Role
Band- 1
CTC- Up to 3.5 lakh rupees
JOB SUMMARY: To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency to achieve sales productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners. Recruit, Coach, Mentor, Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to onboarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re-activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through company's sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors' offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE:
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills
Competency- Result Orientation Definition- Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)
Skillset required- Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation Definition- Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets
Skillset required- Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services
Skillset required- Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values
Skillset required- Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior
Competency - People and Team Leadership
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required- Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support
Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition- Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.

Description:
Job Summary
Technical Expert, Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational & Research Foundation (YRGMERF) - Project Disha. Experience required: 5 years.
Responsibilities
The Technical Experts will provide mentoring and supportive supervision to DISHA cluster units, ensuring the effective implementation of the National AIDS Control Program (NACP) V.
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.
Provide component-wise inputs and guidance to enhance the overall performance of DISHA units.
Performance Improvement: Responsible for periodical improvement in the 95-95-95 performance targets of the DISHA cluster.
Field Visits: Conduct field visits for a minimum of 20 days per month to provide on-site support and supervision.
Requirements
Desirable Attributes: Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Humanities, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in public health projects, particularly in HIV/AIDS programs.
Strong understanding of NACP V and public health systems.
Excellent mentoring, supervisory, and capacity-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Flexibility to travel extensively within the assigned region.

Description:
Project Name: Project for Establishment of Mizoram State Super-Specialty Cancer and Research Centre, Aizawl - Mizoram, India.
Functional Area: Equipment Management and Support (Specialized in Laboratory, Physiology, and Rehabilitation Equipment)
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu/ Aizawl, Mizoram, India
Duration: 6 months (Intermittent Input)
Qualification:
-Bachelor s degree in Medical Electronic or Electronic or Biomedical Engineering.
-Certifications or training in laboratory or rehabilitation equipment preferred.
Overall Professional Experience:
-Minimum 15 years of professional experience in managing laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation-related equipment, with at least 5 completed projects.
-Experience in medical equipment planning and/or procurement, having contributed to at least 3 projects.
-Hands-on experience in the installation, calibration, and basic maintenance of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Work experience as a Clinical Engineer in healthcare or medical care facilities.
Role Responsibilities:
Equipment Installation Calibration:
-Lead the installation, setup, and calibration of laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment at MSSSCRC.
-Ensure that equipment is installed according to specifications and regulatory standards, meeting safety and performance requirements.
-Conduct initial testing to verify the functionality of newly installed equipment, making adjustments as necessary to optimize performance.
Compliance and Quality Assurance:
-Perform routine checks and inspections to ensure that equipment continues to meet operational standards and regulatory requirements.
-Monitor equipment performance, ensuring it adheres to safety and operational regulations in line with national and international standards.
-Assist in compliance audits and support the creation of reports to document adherence to health regulations.
Troubleshooting Technical Support:
-Provide technical troubleshooting support for any malfunctioning laboratory, physiology, or rehabilitation equipment.
-Offer quick resolutions for minor issues and escalate complex technical problems to senior specialists or vendors for further investigation and resolution.
-Diagnose equipment faults and recommend corrective actions to maintain optimal functionality.
Training MSSSCRC Staff on Equipment Use Maintenance:
-Develop and deliver training programs for MSSSCRC staff (clinical, technical, and administrative) on the correct use, handling, and safety protocols for laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
-Conduct hands-on training sessions to ensure staff are proficient in operating the equipment, including detailed instructions on how to maintain and troubleshoot the equipment.
-Create training materials and user manuals tailored to the equipment, ensuring that staff have clear, accessible guides for reference.
-Assess staff competency in operating the equipment and provide additional guidance or refresher courses as necessary to ensure staff confidence and safety in equipment handling.
-Provide specialized training in equipment calibration, regular maintenance tasks, and how to perform troubleshooting for common issues.
Record Maintenance Reporting:
-Maintain accurate and detailed records of equipment installation, servicing, and performance, ensuring that all equipment data is properly documented and accessible.
-Track service histories, calibration schedules, and any repairs or modifications made to the equipment.
-Assist in preparing periodic reports on equipment status, including any issues identified, actions taken, and overall performance evaluation.
-Coordination with Senior Specialists Vendors:
-Collaborate with senior specialists and vendors to manage upgrades, repairs, and replacements of equipment.
-Coordinate with vendors to procure spare parts and ensure that all equipment remains functional throughout the project duration.
-Ensure timely maintenance schedules are followed to minimize equipment downtime and avoid disruptions in medical services.
Project Support Management:
-Assist in the management of project timelines, ensuring that equipment-related tasks such as installation, calibration, and maintenance are completed on schedule.
-Support project teams in planning and procuring equipment, ensuring that equipment specifications meet the project s healthcare requirements.
-Provide guidance and technical input in the planning phase for procurement of new laboratory, physiology, and rehabilitation equipment.
Safety Operational Efficiency:
-Conduct regular safety checks to ensure that all equipment complies with health and safety regulations and operates efficiently.
-Evaluate the operational efficiency of equipment and recommend improvements or upgrades when necessary.
-Ensure that all equipment is safely decommissioned or disposed of at the end of its useful life.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced MEP Engineer (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) to oversee and manage MEP works for a government building project under the EPC mode. The candidate will be responsible for planning, execution, coordination, quality control, site supervision, and timely completion of all MEP activities in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
Key Responsibilities

Manage day-to-day MEP site activities, including electrical, plumbing, firefighting, HVAC, and other building services.
Review and coordinate MEP drawings, technical specifications, BOQs, and installation layouts.
Supervise site engineers, technicians, subcontractors, and vendors to ensure proper execution of MEP works.
Coordinate with civil, structural, architectural, and other project teams to avoid clashes and ensure smooth execution.
Liaise with government officials, clients, consultants, and contractors for inspections, approvals, and technical clearances.
Monitor material procurement, consumption, manpower, and resource utilization to ensure cost-effective execution.
Ensure proper installation, testing, commissioning, and handover of all MEP systems.
Maintain quality standards and ensure compliance with applicable codes, safety regulations, and approved project specifications.
Prepare progress reports, measurement sheets, billing documents, and material reconciliation reports.
Identify and resolve technical issues and ensure timely completion of MEP works as per the project schedule.

Candidate Requirements
B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in building construction.
Experience in government projects and EPC execution preferred.
Good knowledge of MEP drawings, BOQs, billing, and site execution.
Strong coordination, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in hill-area or sloping terrain projects will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate
A hands-on professional capable of independently managing MEP site operations, coordinating with multiple teams, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring timely project delivery.

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

Description:
(i) To advise the concerned departments in planning and organizing measures necessary for Safe Work Practices for all employees thus prevent personal injuries.
(ii) To implement Work Permit System across the Plant and create awareness on importance adhering to Safe Work Practices.
(iii) To carry our Safety Audit periodically and evaluate the effectiveness of the action taken or proposed to be taken to prevent personal injuries.
(iv) To ensure availability of personal protective equipment and usage appropriately.
(v) To advise on matters relating to carrying out of plant safety inspections.
(vi) To carry out plant safety inspections in order to observe the physical conditions of work and the work practices and procedures followed by workers and to render advise on measures to be adopted for removing the unsafe physical conditions and preventing unsafe actions by workers.
(vii) To render assistance on matters relating to reporting and investigation of industrial accidents and occupational diseases.
(viii) To encourage reporting of Near Miss and Potential hazard and address all those observations to prevent incident/accident.
(ix) To render assistance for the cases of industrial diseases contracted and in respect of dangerous occurrences reportable under rule 106 of the Pondicherry Factories Rules, 1964.
(x) To render assistance on the maintenance of such records as are necessary relating to accidents, dangerous occurrences and industrial diseases.
(xi) To conduct safety committee meeting periodically and address all such observation.
(xii) To organize in association with the concerned departments, campaigns, competitions, contests and other activities which will develop and maintain the interest of the workers in establishing and maintaining safe conditions of work and procedure; and
(xiii) to design and conduct either independently or in collaboration with the training department, suitable training and educational programs for the prevention of personal injuries and for the propagation of safety awareness.
xiv) To work for obtaining the certification of EOHS, ESG and GreenCo.
The Safety Officer will be responsible for ensuring the safety and health of all employees within the organization. This role includes developing, implementing, and overseeing safety programs and policies to maintain compliance with local, state, and federal regulations. The Safety Officer will conduct regular safety inspections, risk assessments, and audits to identify potential hazards in the workplace. This position requires the development and delivery of safety training programs to enhance employee awareness and compliance. The Safety Officer will also investigate accidents and incidents, prepare reports, and recommend corrective actions to prevent future occurrences.

About the Role:
The role involves coordinating activities related to new product introductions within the organization. It emphasizes ensuring that components are ready for production and managing the overall process of product rollouts. The position will require active engagement with cross-functional teams to facilitate smooth transitions from development to manufacturing.

About the Team:
You will be working with a dynamic and collaborative cross-functional team consisting of members from engineering, production, and quality assurance. The team is focused on driving innovation and efficiency in product development, ensuring that all members actively contribute their expertise to achieve common goals.

You are Responsible for:
Coordinating all aspects of new product introduction activities and ensuring that all parts are ready on time. Conducting production tryouts and addressing any manufacturing line issues that arise during the process. Securing necessary approvals at each stage of the product rollout and working in collaboration with the cross-functional team to resolve any challenges encountered.

To succeed in this role - you should have the following:
A strong background in electronics products such as Sensors, ECUs, DC-DC converters, Ignition coil and Rectifier and regulator. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Problem-solving abilities to quickly address manufacturing issues and the capability to adapt to changing project requirements. Experience in coordinating product introduction activities will be highly beneficial.
Job Title: Senior Engineer - NPI

Company Name: India Nippon Electricals


The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating new product introduction activities in the organization. This includes ensuring part readiness for production, conducting production tryouts to validate processes, obtaining necessary approvals, and effectively resolving any manufacturing line issues in collaboration with the cross-functional team (CFT). The role requires a strong focus on detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

Responsibilities:
- Coordinate new product introduction activities to ensure timely and efficient rollout.
- Ensure all parts are ready for production and meet quality standards.
- Conduct production tryouts to assess the manufacturing process and product functionality.
- Obtain necessary approvals from relevant stakeholders at each phase of the product introduction.
- Work closely with the cross-functional team to resolve any issues that arise on the manufacturing line.
- Monitor and report on the progress of new product initiatives and provide updates as required.
- Collaborate with engineering and quality assurance teams to ensure adherence to specifications.

Skills and Tools Required:
- Strong knowledge of electronics products, including Sensors, Electronic Control Units (ECU), DC-DC converters, and regulators (RR).
- Excellent project management skills to oversee multiple product introductions simultaneously.
- Strong problem-solving abilities to address manufacturing line issues effectively.
- Familiarity with manufacturing processes and standards in the electronics industry.
- Proficient in using tools for project tracking, data analysis, and reporting.
- Effective communication skills to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
- Attention to detail and a systematic approach to tasks and responsibilities.

This role is crucial for ensuring that new products are introduced successfully and efficiently into production, maintaining high standards of quality and performance.

Clear all edits which pop up while scrubbing charges.
Follow all client specific updates and billing guidelines published in-order to send clean claim.

Skills
Basic knowledge of computer, Microsoft Office
Communication Skills - English (Verbal/Written)
Experience
No experience required. Associate will undergo RCM training, quick grasping/learning skills are required and expected to clear assessments during training.

Description:
1. Customer Complaint Management
- Receive, analyze, and respond to customer complaints within the agreed timeline.
- Coordinate containment, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions.
- Prepare and submit 8D reports, 5-Why analysis, and other customer-required reports.
- Ensure effectiveness verification and obtain customer closure approval.
2. Customer Quality Assurance
- Ensure products meet customer drawings, specifications, standards, and quality requirements.
- Monitor PPM, rejection rates, warranty claims, and field failure trends.
- Establish containment and corrective actions to prevent defective parts reaching customers.
- Ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements and quality agreements.
3. Customer Audits and Visits
- Plan and coordinate customer audits, assessments, and plant visits.
- Ensure audit readiness, documentation availability, and closure of audit findings.
- Present quality performance, improvement activities, and corrective action status.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams to address customer observations.
4. New Product Development (NPD) and Launch Quality
- Review customer quality requirements during new product development.
- Coordinate APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, and validation activities, as applicable.
- Ensure process readiness, product validation, traceability, and error-proofing before launch.
- Coordinate safe launch and enhanced inspection until the required approval and stability criteria are met.
5. Cross-Functional and Supplier Coordination
- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Materials, Supplier Quality, RD, and Marketing.
- Drive supplier corrective actions for customer-related component issues.
- Ensure defective material segregation, replacement, traceability, and disposition.
- Monitor action owners and timelines until effective closure.
6. Quality Performance and Continuous Improvement
- Track customer PPM, complaints, rejection costs, warranty, and repeat failures.
- Prepare monthly quality performance reports and management reviews.
- Identify recurring issues and implement horizontal deployment across similar products and processes.
- Drive lessons learned, defect prevention, and continual improvement initiatives.
India Nippon Electricals is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in the design, development, and implementation of innovative electrical solutions for automotive applications. The Senior Engineer will be responsible for leading projects from concept through to completion, ensuring that all engineering deliverables meet quality, reliability, and performance standards.

Lead Generation

years work experience only in Vehicle Sales

Analytical Skill
Product Knowledge

Execution Excellence
Customer Centricity

Should be comfortable to move in the market
Should have learning attitude
Should have bike and license
Should have good knowledge of RTO
Should have product knowledge

to achieve sales & productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners.Recruit ,Coach,Mentor,Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity & Renewal Targets.

Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to on boarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals & performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re- activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through companys sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE :
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English & regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred

Competency- Result Orientation
Definition-
Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Skillset required-
Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Skillset required-
Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Definition-
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Skillset required-
Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Definition-
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values

Skillset required-
Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior

Competency - People and Team Leadership
Definition-
Communicates a clear vision and strategy for the team to achieve organizational objectives
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required-
Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support

Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition-
Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.
Develops and delivers a compelling value proposition that clearly articulates the career opportunity, compensation, and support structure, effectively influencing and convincing high-potential advisors and partners to join the team.
Skillfully anticipates and manages advisor objections through clear communication, factual evidence, and motivational techniques.
Effectively leverages existing networks, professional referrals, and natural market opportunities to consistently generate quality leads for distribution expansion.

Ensures a good selection process is followed, and successful recruits are smoothly integrated by providing initial training and necessary resources to facilitate a fast start in the role.
Skillset required-
Lead Generation, Networking, Prospecting, Communication, Interviewing

Roles & Responsibilities
Conduct daily CFT meetings and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
Review and monitor production schedule adherence.
Review and monitor ILR status.
Monitor plant efficiency and identify areas for improvement.
Periodically review and update Control Plans, SOPs, Work Instructions (WI), and related documents.
Coordinate with supporting departments for facility-related requirements.
Coordinate and support IATF, TPS, PMI, OSHAS, VDA, and other system-related activities.
Carry out SAP BOM corrections and ensure accuracy of material-related data.
Carry out SAP Norms corrections and maintain accurate system data.

Coordinate new product introduction / new product activities with the CFT.
Key Technical Responsibilities
The role also requires strong capability in PCBA manufacturing and final assembly, including single-piece flow and batch production, SOP/CP/PFMEA, quality problem-solving tools, line efficiency improvement, assembly rejection/rework control, defect analysis, FPY improvement, 5S/Kaizen, PCB Gerber data, through-hole and selective soldering, and electronic product manufacturing processes.
As a Senior Engineer in the Manufacturing department, you will play a crucial role in the development, optimization, and implementation of manufacturing processes. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance production efficiency, ensure quality compliance, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. The position requires a deep understanding of manufacturing principles, tools, and technologies, as well as strong leadership capabilities to mentor junior engineers and coordinate team efforts.

Department: HCD (Projects & Services Division)

Tasks :
Supervise civil / structural works at project sites, ensuring adherence to drawings, specifications, quality standards and timelines.

Coordinate with contractors, structural consultants, architects and client authorities for smooth execution of projects.

Prepare progress reports and project documentation; support project handing over.
Any other work assigned by the management from time to time.

Requirements

Maximum Age: 37 years (Associate Manager) / 40 years (Operations Manager) for Degree holders; 40 years (Associate Manager) / 45 years (Operations Manager) for Diploma holders, as on 01.11.2026
