Description:
The Marketing and Communications Manager is part of an important team that creates and executes property-level communications to our customers.
Under the leadership of the Director of Marketing and Communication, this role promotes on-brand messaging to customers through traditional, digital, and social media channels all with the goal of enhancing the image of the hotel.
This role helps build direct marketing plans, targeted campaigns, and activated channels to the end of driving consumer awareness and preference, increasing market share, and building broader portfolio and brand awareness.
This role focuses on showcasing Food and Beverage promotions, both to hotel guests and to local patrons.
As part of the Marketing and Communication team, this role is fully connected into resources in their region; Marketing and Communication Managers liaise and build deep partnerships with their regional eCommerce and Marketing teams to verify all local, social, and digital marketing efforts are effectively integrated with the selling efforts for the organization.
This role also gets to do a little bit of everything, from balancing traditional and digital marketing and eCommerce activities to contributing to public relations (PR) activities for the hotel.
Success is measured by how well they help drive the sales and revenue strategy of the property, social media engagement and also by how effectively leveraged the resources around them are to create truly compelling marketing and communications campaigns.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
Required:
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 4 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising agency experience preferred.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Hotel Marketing and Advertising
- Executes annual marketing plan to budget, in consultation with the GM, Food and Beverage leader, Operations leaders, Director of Marketing Communications, and cluster marketing and ecommerce teams.
- Partners with Operations, Food & Beverage and Sales teams to execute promotions and campaigns to target in-house guests with promotions that drive incremental revenue to the hotel.
- Acts as the liaison between the marketing department and advertising agency on the tactical advertising campaigns creative and media plans, particularly for food and beverage promotions.
- Manages F&B media schedules and verifies prompt settlement of accounts.
- Partners with property Revenue Management to verify correct offer loading, verifying advertisement targeting is correctly directed at relevant consumer groups
- Executes email marketing, and display advertising.
- Maintains frequent, active engagement with Cluster eCommerce manager to verify alignment, pull-through, and 2-way communication about the status, performance evaluation, opportunities, and issues related to online programs and initiatives.
- Verifies all advertising for the hotel in digital channels is in alignment with brand voice.
Social Media Content Management
- Facilitates social media engagement and updating content in local digital channels (eg, hotel website, travel sites).
- Develops and executes promotions campaign in F&B, weddings, spa, rooms and conferences through relevant digital and social media channels.
- Engages in proactive online reputation management by surfacing relevant guest comments (positive or negative) in social media channels and responds accordingly.
Public Relations and Visual Asset Management
- Develops a comprehensive PR plan per quarter along with agency and and executes post sign-off from GM.
- Maintains a comprehensive list of local media contracts, with particular emphasis on food critics and bloggers.
- Manages assigned accounts as per the media account management system.
- Writes and distributes all press releases for property events, promotions, and outlets.
- Manages the execution of hotel sponsored events, community/government relations activities, and press promotional activities.
- Supports pull through of impactful PR strategy & activities to drive quality press coverage through media engagement, in alignment with communications objectives.
- Verifies the news clippings and other online, print, and social media mention report is completed on a monthly basis for property distribution.
- Manages external vendors and media agencies; works with agency partners and continent PR leader to identify strategic media buys for their hotel(s).
- Surfaces and vets PR leads from the continent PR Leader regarding which are the best media to promote the hotel.
- Supports the co-ordination of photography for F&B advertising, collateral and public relations purposes between the hotel, advertising agency and the regional field marketing teams.
- Manages photo shoots for seasonal or festive promotions in partnership with the cluster or area marketing team.
- Acts as central point of contact for regionally approved local photographers for food, amenity, and property imagery; coordinates with area or cluster marketing to verify all photography adheres to brand voice.
Direct Marketing and Collateral Development
- Coordinates and executes Hotel and F&B printed materials.
- Controls quantity and inventory of all Hotel marketing collateral and verifies copies are filed in a comprehensive manner.
- Assists in the production of all property, F&B display, and temporary signage in hotel public areas.
- Promotes collection of competitors collateral and publicity on a monthly basis.
- Manages the execution of F&B direct marketing activities.
- Verifies all collateral is as per brand standard guidelines and in compliance with Brand Standard Audit (BSA).
General
- Assists and manages the development, co-ordination and execution of all communications activities with a strong emphasis on property F&B promotions and campaigns.
- Helps with the publication of hotel s newsletter(s).
- Supports communications duties and functions as deemed necessary.
- Assists in the liaison and execution of joint F&B promotions.
- Works with eCommerce to verify the Hotel s website and related websites are updated on a regular basis.
- Partners with Director of Marketing to create marketing plan aligned to hotel sales and revenue strategy.
- Provides training and marketing leadership and act as a marketing subject matter expert for GMs, Sales Leaders and Managers, and Revenue leaders.
- Coordinates with property and above property eCommerce and Revenue Management teams to report success of property marketing and eCommerce performance.
- Keeps abreast of competition and its collateral, advertising, and marketing efforts and constantly evolving digital and marketing trends.

- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 8 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. OR

Job Description Senior Manager Maintenance (Optical Fiber Cable Plant)

Position
Senior Manager Maintenance

Department
Engineering & Maintenance

Location -Verna, South Goa

Qualification
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Electronics Engineering
MBA (Preferred)

Experience
12 -18 years of total experience in Plant Maintenance.
Mandatory: The candidate must have continuous experience in Optical Fiber Cable (OFC) Manufacturing for the previous/latest 10 years.
Experience from Automotive, FMCG, Chemical, Steel, or other manufacturing industries will not be considered.

Job Purpose

To lead the Maintenance function of the Optical Fiber Cable Plant by ensuring maximum machine availability, improving equipment reliability, minimizing downtime, managing utilities, and driving continuous improvement through preventive and predictive maintenance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Utility, and Automation maintenance activities.
Ensure maximum uptime of OFC manufacturing machines through effective preventive and predictive maintenance.
Handle breakdown analysis and implement Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA).
Plan and execute annual shutdowns and major maintenance activities.
Maintain critical utilities including Compressors, Chillers, HVAC, DG Sets, Transformers, HT/LT Systems, Air Dryers, Water Systems, and Power Distribution.
Maintain and troubleshoot OFC manufacturing equipment including:
Fiber Coloring Lines
Ribbonizing Lines
SZ Stranding Machines
Buffering Lines
Sheathing/Jacketing Extrusion Lines
Armouring Lines
Rewinding & Take-up Systems
Spark Testers and Online Testing Equipment
Lead TPM, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, and reliability improvement initiatives.
Monitor machine performance through MTBF, MTTR, OEE, and downtime analysis.
Ensure availability of critical spare parts and optimize maintenance inventory.
Manage maintenance budgets, AMCs, vendor development, and contractor activities.
Ensure statutory compliance, electrical safety, and implementation of EHS standards.
Maintain SAP PM/CMMS records, maintenance history, and technical documentation.
Develop and mentor maintenance engineers, supervisors, and technicians.

Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, PLC, SCADA, Servo Drives, VFDs, and Industrial Automation.
Hands-on experience in OFC manufacturing equipment maintenance.
Expertise in Preventive, Predictive, and Reliability-Centered Maintenance.
Knowledge of SAP PM/CMMS.
Strong leadership, planning, vendor management, and problem-solving skills.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Machine Availability
Team Handling
OEE Improvement
Breakdown Reduction
Preventive Maintenance Compliance
MTBF & MTTR
Utility Availability
Maintenance Cost Control
Spare Inventory Optimization
Safety & Statutory Compliance

Mandatory Screening Criteria

Latest 10 years of experience must be in Optical Fiber Cable Manufacturing only.
Hands-on maintenance experience on OFC production machinery.
Experience in managing maintenance teams in a manufacturing plant.
Willing to work at Urse, Pune.

Interested candidate can also share their CV on Rutuja.Mohite@Finolex.com

Description:
Job Description
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features

80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month

Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales Qualifications
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG food/beverage, or hotel industry)

Roles & Responsibilities:
Responsible for quality of products manufactured in the Unit. Assure 100% quality of products supplied to market conforms to company specification and regulatory norms.

Monitoring of Pest Control activity.
Conduct routine checks on hygiene, sanitation, and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) across the production and packaging areas.

Job Description
Role Objective
The objective of this team is to identify, onboard, and grow premium, high-CFT and trending
outlets on Dineout, with a strong focus on being the first mover in acquiring high-potential
restaurants before competitors such as District.
The team will initially focus on premium outlet acquisition and onboarding, with a long-term
mandate to also own account management, GOV growth, market share, and exclusive
campaigns/events for these strategic accounts.

Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs)
1. Identify Premium High-Potential Outlets
Identify premium restaurants and high-CFT outlets across priority markets.
Track trending, upcoming, and high-demand restaurants that have strong customer pull.
Build a pipeline of strategically important outlets based on brand value, CFT potential, customer demand, and market relevance.
Proactively identify new restaurant launches and emerging premium brands.
2. Close Comp-Gaps for Premium Outlets
Identify premium outlets that are already live on Z but are missing from Dineout.
Prioritize and close these Comp-Gaps to ensure strong outlet coverage.
Develop a systematic approach to track, prioritize, and convert high-value Z-Gap opportunities.
3. First-Mover Advantage
Ensure Dineout is the first mover in onboarding high-value premium outlets, wherever possible.
Track upcoming launches, competitor movements, and market trends to identify opportunities before other competitors.
Build strong relationships with restaurant owners, management teams, and key decision-makers to secure early partnerships.
Create a culture of proactive acquisition rather than reactive competitor-led onboarding.
Long-Term Scope of the Team
The role is expected to evolve beyond acquisition into end-to-end ownership of strategic
premium accounts.
1. Account Management
Build account management capabilities within the team for outlets onboarded by them.
Maintain strong relationships with premium restaurant partners.
Drive partner engagement, retention, and business growth after onboarding.
Identify opportunities to deepen the relationship and increase business contribution.
2. Drive GOV Growth Market Share
Own and drive GOV growth from the premium outlet portfolio.
Increase Dineouts market share within premium restaurant segments.
Identify opportunities to improve outlet performance, customer transactions, and overall business contribution.
3. Exclusive Campaigns Events
Identify premium partners suitable for exclusive campaigns, partnerships, and events.
Work closely with internal teams to conceptualize and execute differentiated campaigns.
Leverage Scenes to create visibility and demand for premium restaurant partners.
Build exclusive restaurant-led experiences and campaigns that strengthen Dineouts proposition for both consumers and restaurant partners.
Key Success Metrics
The performance of the team can be evaluated through:
Number and quality of premium/high-CFT outlets identified.
Premium outlet onboarding rate.
Reduction in Z-Gaps.
First-mover onboarding rate versus competitors.
GOV generated from newly onboarded premium outlets.
GOV growth from managed accounts.
Dineout market share within the premium outlet segment.
Number and quality of exclusive campaigns/events launched. Qualifications
Strong business development and sales orientation.
Ability to identify and pursue high-value opportunities proactively.
Strong understanding of the premium restaurant/FB ecosystem.
Excellent relationship-building and negotiation skills.
Ability to work with data and identify business opportunities.
Ability to transition from pure acquisition into strategic account management

Job Description
Job Description
This role requires > 8 years of experience working in the areas of pesticide/agrochemical formulation development and able to work in the formulation lab.
Lead the development of Crop Protection formulations
To formulate, generate scientific / technical data using established systems, procedures, and protocols in an area of work delegated by the manager.
Define the experimental programme that include the development of new pesticide formulations, procedures/standards.
To interpret data in order to make contributions to decisions in the work programme content, procedures, or problem solution.
Engages directly with other functions to co-ordinate delivery of project outputs (e. g. product biology, regulatory, procurement team, engineering team, packaging etc) with the support of a leader.
Report on work, including recommendations to project team or sub-project team leader.
Participate in regional and global technical / project teams
Will represent the formulation development work/status at every developmental stage to global peer review team and adhere to project timelines.
ACCOUNTABILITIES
To plan, organise and carry out the work programmes at the laboratory, semi-technical, pilot plant or manufacturing scale to design novel pesticide formulation options in order to:
Prove the suitability for progression through Stage C and D Evaluation and Development
Provide Product Chemistry type and or supporting data, and
Provide the formulation design input required to define the process equipment and quality assurance requirements to timescales and specifications agreed with the team or group leader.
Ensure the quality of Evaluation and Development formulations by arranging for biological efficacy, toxicology, and hazard assessment studies to be carried out in other Functions.
Provide advice and recommendations to allow appropriate selection of formulation manufacturing sites for individual products, together with the product design inputs required to define the process equipment and quality assurance requirements.
To interpret and represent to project members external to the function, experimental data and report results and conclusions obtained both orally and in written form to allow cogent and timely Stage C and D project decisions, Regulatory submissions and accurate information archiving and transfer for future commercial manufacturing activities.
To ensure that work by the job holder and subordinate staff comply with Syngenta standard operating procedures and statutory regulations (e. g. GLP or similar).
To ensure that the jobholder and subordinate staff work safely and healthy with due care for others, so that compliance with Syngenta s HSE Policy is achieved.
To invest in personal and professional development and growth, undertaking, where appropriate, training and development activities and ensuring familiarity with new research and literature.
Ensure maintaining complete confidentiality of all Syngenta intellectual property.
Interact with the global formulation community in order to better solve common problems and to define improved processes Qualifications
Qualifications
KNOWLEDGE EXPERIENCE and CAPABILITIES:
Critical knowledge and experience
Master s degree in Pesticide/Agrochemical chemistry must/preferable from reputed universities with strong academic records and good communication skills with > 8 years of industrial experience in field of pesticide formulation development as a formulation development chemist preferred.
Thorough knowledge of pesticides, pesticide formulation types and techniques required in formulation development.
Sound understanding of agrochemical formulations / Coformulations / Fillers is a must
Critical technical, professional, and personal capabilities
Ability to efficiently build up laboratory works and experiments
Ability to effectively participation in- and contribute to regional / global multi-functional teams
Ability to deliver to agreed timelines
Excellent operational, organisational, interpersonal and computer skills
Sensitive to different cultural environments
Self-motivating
Critical leadership capabilities
Communicative
We deliver clear messages to our stakeholders
We are keen to listen and learn
Team Oriented
We model commitment
We support team process improvement
We collaborate effectively across organisational and functional boundaries
Results Oriented
We focus on goal achievement
We stay focused
Customer Focused
We seek to understand our customers
We build collaborative relationships
Trusted
We demonstrate support for others
Critical success factors and key challenges
This role will involve taking a lead role in the development of new formulations by generating potential formulation options through the design of appropriate experimental work programs to thoroughly optimise and test these according to the formulation development process.
This will include the analysis of experimental data in order to make inputs to the decisions on the direction of the work programmes within the project.
The job holder will need to have experience of different formulation types as well as a full range of broader requirements in formulation development such as product application, manufacturing processes, etc.
To deliver highest quality results in optimal time and maintain highest standards of HSE

Description:
Main Responsibilities / Job Summary

1. Product manufacture
Ensure the achievement of department objectives and monitor product cost, quality, and timeliness as per production / delivery plan.
Ensure all production / filling-packing lines have high operational performance and process capability to deliver products as per established standards.
Plan and coordinate all maintenance activities viz. routine, periodic maintenance and CIP / shutdown activities.
Establish and implement a maintenance strategy and schedule supported by all functions thereby ensuring availability of lines / plant (production and infrastructure) to ensure optimum utilisation of assets and resources.

2. Compliance
Ensure product and process compliance in line with Nestl policies, standards and legal requirements.
Ensure work place safety and effective communication of Safety, Health and Environment to all team members.
Conduct inspection / audits and investigate incidents to close gaps.
Ensure good and hygienic engineering practices are applied at all times.

3. Maintenance integration
Coach / train, with related parties, the technicians and operators in preventive / routine maintenance activities and machinery operations.Ensure that CDM is fully integrated with factory operations and all operators / technicians understand and practice CDM.

4. Data management / Systems
Measure, analyse and improve line performance by using available systems / tools (AMM etc.)
Measure, analyse and control maintenance & improvement (M&I) budget and spare parts inventory by using available system / tools (NEE).Contribute to establishing energy and line standards.

5. Continuous Improvement
Review process failures and execute continuous improvement activities by identifying opportunities, accessing proposals and timely implementation.
Support projects (team) by setting up / installation of new equipment, test run and ensuring readiness for mass production. Wherever required, participate in standard audits (HACCP, FSMS, GMP etc.)
Ensure that the equipment history, damage code and root cause analysis are completed correctly.

6. Knowledge management and people development
Coach and mentor, the members of team to increase productivity and efficiency by participating in daily meetings, reviewing actions.
Train the team on safety and environmental requirements and procedures.
Review and feedback to direct reports of their performance against their principal accountabilities and behavioural competencies so as to continually improve individual and team operational and/or technical capability in line with site skills and behavioural requirements.
Communicate information flows from the management to the direct reportees and vice versa.

7. Area of responsibility
a. Maintenance of filling & packing machines as core responsibility along with process machinery.
b. Maintenance budget preparation & day to day management with strong tracking with preventive mindset
c. Spares parts management for the plant, Maintenance planning & scheduling
d. Engineering contractual management including development & Day to day people management of internal & external
e. Problem solving techniques (GSTD, BDA, DMAIC etc,)
f. Project management skills will be an added advantage
g. Exposure to primary packing (horizontal flow wrapper, vertical form fills sealing machine, can/Jar filling machines, product auto feeding system into the flow wrappers), secondary packing (auto case packing, top loading, or front loading, COBOT or Robo based auto pick & place machines into grey boxes or shippers)
h. Knowledge on various type coding: Contact, Inkjet, Laser coders from reputed vendors like DOMINO, IMAJE, VIDEOJET etc.

Description:
The Sales Manager - Logistics Services is responsible for driving new business acquisition through structured lead funnel management while ensuring a high-quality onboarding experience for new SME and B2B clients. Beyond acquisition, this role owns account health during the critical first two months post-onboarding, setting the foundation for long-term retention and growth.

1. Lead Funnel Management & New Client Acquisition
Identify, qualify, and pursue SME and B2B prospects.
Maintain a healthy lead pipeline across stages: Prospect Qualified Proposal Negotiation Closed
Conduct discovery meetings to understand prospect shipping volumes, pain points, and service requirements
Present customized logistics proposals including pricing, SLAs, and VAS offerings
Coordinate with operations and pricing teams to ensure commercially viable deal structures
Achieve monthly targets for new client activations and revenue from new accounts

2. Client Onboarding
Lead end-to-end onboarding for newly signed clients including system setup, account configuration, and first-shipment coordination
Conduct a formal onboarding kick-off call within 48 hours of contract signing
Share onboarding documentation: SOPs, escalation matrices, rate cards, and tracking portals
Coordinate with operations, IT, and customer service teams to ensure smooth Day 1 experience
Monitor first 10 shipments closely flag TAT breaches, address NDR issues, and resolve any documentation gaps
Schedule a Week 2 and Week 4 check-in call to review initial performance data and client satisfaction

3. Account Stabilization & Growth
Conduct a formal Month 1 performance review with each new client covering delivery rates, TAT compliance, and delay metrics
Identify opportunities to improve shipment volumes and client engagement.
Resolve operational issues by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Ensure the account is stabilized and positioned for long-term growth and retention.
Hand over the account to the Account Management team with complete documentation and a smooth transition.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
The Sales Manager - Logistics Services is responsible for driving new business acquisition through structured lead funnel management while ensuring a high-quality onboarding experience for new SME and B2B clients. Beyond acquisition, this role owns account health during the critical first two months post-onboarding, setting the foundation for long-term retention and growth.

1. Lead Funnel Management & New Client Acquisition
Identify, qualify, and pursue SME and B2B prospects.

Coordinate with operations, IT, and customer service teams to ensure smooth Day 1 experience

Schedule a Week 2 and Week 4 check-in call to review initial performance data and client satisfaction

3. Account Stabilization & Growth
Conduct a formal Month 1 performance review with each new client covering delivery rates, TAT compliance, and delay metrics
Identify opportunities to improve shipment volumes and client engagement.
Resolve operational issues by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Ensure the account is stabilized and positioned for long-term growth and retention.
Hand over the account to the Account Management team with complete documentation and a smooth transition.

Description:
The Front Office Associate is responsible for delivering exceptional guest service by ensuring smooth check-in and check-out processes, handling guest requests efficiently, maintaining accurate records, and creating a welcoming experience in line with hotel brand standards.
Key Responsibilities
Welcome guests warmly and provide a professional first impression.
Perform check-in and check-out procedures accurately and efficiently.
Handle room reservations, modifications, and cancellations.
Respond promptly to guest inquiries, requests, and complaints, ensuring timely resolution.
Process payments, maintain guest accounts, and prepare accurate billing.
Coordinate with Housekeeping, Engineering, and other departments to ensure guest satisfaction.
Promote hotel facilities, services, loyalty programmes, and special offers.
Maintain the confidentiality of guest information and adhere to data security policies.
Ensure the front desk, lobby, and reception area remain clean and presentable.
Follow hotel SOPs, brand standards, and safety, security, and emergency procedures.
Prepare daily reports and complete shift handovers accurately.
Qualification Skills
Diploma or bachelors degree in Hotel Management or Hospitality.
0 2 years of experience in Front Office operations (freshers may also apply).
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong customer service orientation with a professional appearance.
Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with PMS (Opera/Fidelio or similar) is preferred.
Ability to work in shifts, including weekends and public holidays.
Good problem-solving, multitasking, and teamwork skills.
This role is responsible for ensuring every guest receives a warm welcome, personalized service, and a memorable stay while maintaining the highest standards of hospitality and operational excellence.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! Provide administrative support: Assist department managers with clerical work such as word processing, data entry, filing, and copying

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
AboutCompany: Swiggy is an Indian online food ordering and delivery company. Founded in 2014, Swiggy is headquartered in Bangalore and operates in more than 580 Indian cities, as of July 2023.[4] Besides food delivery, the platform also provides quick commerce services under the name Swiggy Instamart, and same-day package deliveries with Swiggy Genie.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Position responsible for all the food and beverage operations, which includes all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations. Oversees guest and employee satisfaction, maintaining standards and meeting or exceeding financial goals. Demonstrates knowledge and proficiency of all applicable food and beverage laws and regulations. Develops and implements business plan for food and beverage.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Developing and Maintaining Budgets
- Develops and manages all financial, employee engagement and guest satisfaction plans and actions for Food and Beverage departments.
- Maintains a positive cost management index for kitchen and restaurant operations.
- Utilizes budgets to understand financial objectives.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Manages the Food and Beverage departments (not catering sales).
- Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Oversees all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations.
- Creates and nurtures a property environment that emphasizes motivation, empowerment, teamwork, continuous improvement and a passion for providing service.
- Provides excellent customer service to all employees.
- Responds quickly and proactively to employees concerns.
- Provides a learning atmosphere with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Provides proactive coaching and counseling to team members.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Monitors and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish work.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Sets clear expectations with the employees and team leaders and verifies that appropriate rewards are given if expectations are exceeded.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides excellent customer service.
- Responds quickly and proactively to guests concerns.
- Understands the brands service culture.
- Drives alignment of all employees, team leaders and managers to the brands service culture.
- Sets service expectations for all guests internally and externally.
- Takes ownership of a guest complaint/problem until it is resolved or it has been addressed by the appropriate manager or employee.
- Verifies all banquet functions are up to standard and exceed guests expectations.
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Manages day-to-day operations, drives quality, and verifies standards are meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Conducts performance reviews in a timely manner.
- Promotes both Guarantee of Fair Treatment and Open Door policies.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Develops an action plan to attack need areas and expand on strengths based on employee engagement and guest satisfaction results.
Additional Responsibilities
- Complies with all corporate accounting procedures.
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Drives effective departmental communication and information systems through logs, department meetings and property meetings.

Position: Sales Associate
Department: Sales & Business Development
Industry: Health Insurance / Insurance Distribution
Location: Meghalaya
Employment Type: Full-Time
Reporting To: State Head
1. About the Role
Smart IT Services Pvt. Ltd. is looking for energetic, customer-focused, and target-oriented candidates for the position of Sales Associate - Health Insurance. The selected candidates will be responsible for promoting health insurance products, generating business leads, assisting customers in selecting suitable insurance plans, and achieving assigned sales targets.
The role requires excellent communication, customer relationship management, and sales skills, along with a willingness to work in a target-driven environment.

Identify and generate new business leads through field visits, customer referrals, tele calling, and other sales activities.
Promote and sell health insurance policies to individuals, families, and prospective customers.
Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable health insurance plans.
Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to overall business growth.
Maintain accurate sales records, customer databases, and daily activity reports.

3. Eligibility Criteria
Minimum: 10+2 / Higher Secondary.
Graduate in any discipline preferred.

Experience:
Freshers with good communication and sales aptitude may apply.
Experience in health insurance, life insurance, banking, financial services, or field sales will be an added advantage.

4. Required Skills
Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Basic understanding of health insurance products or willingness to learn.
Willingness to travel locally for field sales.

5. Compensation and Benefits
Salary: As per company norms and candidate experience.
Attractive sales incentives based on performance, as applicable.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Customer satisfaction and retention.
Policy renewal and referral generation.

7. Candidate Requirements
Strong knowledge of the Meghalaya market and local business environment will be preferred.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of district-level business targets.
Good communication skills in English; knowledge of local/regional languages are Mandatory.

Interested candidates may share their updated CV: hr.executive@smartitservices.in

Description:
Job Summary
The Civil Engineer will be responsible for planning, technical assessment, execution monitoring and quality supervision of construction, renovation, repair and infrastructure-development works undertaken by the Organisation. The role will ensure that civil works are completed in accordance with approved designs, specifications, budgets, timelines, safety requirements and organisational procurement and financial procedures. The position will also provide technical documentation and measurement-based verification to support transparent project implementation and payment processing.
Meghalaya


Responsibilities

A. Site Assessment and Technical Planning
Conduct site visits and assess existing infrastructure, site conditions and project requirements.
Prepare technical feasibility reports, layouts, drawings and specifications, as required.
Prepare detailed cost estimates, quantity calculations and Bills of Quantities (BOQs).
Identify material, labour, equipment and resource requirements and highlight technical risks.


B. Project Execution and Site Supervision
Supervise construction, renovation, repair and maintenance works at assigned locations.
Monitor contractors and vendors to ensure work is carried out as per approved drawings, BOQs, specifications and work orders.
Track site progress against approved timelines and budgets and submit periodic updates.
Identify delays, deviations and additional-work requirements and obtain written approval before execution of variations.
Coordinate with project teams, contractors, architects and other technical personnel.


C. Quality Control and Compliance
Inspect construction materials and workmanship at different stages of execution.
Ensure quality of materials and work conforms to approved specifications and applicable engineering standards.
Identify defects and recommend corrective measures within agreed timelines.
Monitor compliance with applicable building regulations, site-safety requirements and relevant standards.


D. Measurement and Contractor Bill Verification
Verify physical measurements and quantities of work completed at site.
Prepare or check Measurement Books (MBs) and item-wise measurement sheets.
Verify running and final contractor bills against actual work completed, approved BOQ and agreed rates.
Provide technical certification of work completed for payment processing, subject to organisational approval.
Document quantity variations, deductions and additional items with supporting justification.


E. Budgeting and Cost Monitoring
Prepare project-wise cost estimates and provide technical inputs for budget preparation.
Monitor expenditure and identify potential cost overruns or savings.
Review technical proposals for additional work and recommend cost-effective alternatives.
Ensure that work is not undertaken beyond the approved scope without prior written authorisation.


F. Procurement and Vendor Coordination
Prepare technical specifications and BOQs for procurement of civil works and materials.
Review vendor quotations for technical compliance and support preparation of technical comparisons.
Participate in technical evaluation of contractors and vendors, as required.
Coordinate with Procurement and Finance teams to ensure complete supporting documentation.


G. Safety, Documentation and Reporting
Monitor site-safety arrangements and report unsafe conditions or incidents promptly.
Maintain site inspection reports, progress records, approved drawings, BOQs and measurement records.
Maintain stage-wise and before-and-after photographs of civil works.
Prepare completion reports and technical completion certificates after verification of work.
Provide technical clarifications and records required for management reviews, audits or donor reporting.


Qualifications and Experience
Graduate degree or diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
Relevant experience in construction, renovation, infrastructure development or civil-work supervision.
Experience in preparing BOQs, cost estimates, technical drawings and measurement books.
Working knowledge of construction materials, quality standards, site supervision and contractor bill verification.
Experience in NGO, development-sector or institutional projects will be an advantage.


Skills and Competencies
Strong technical knowledge of civil construction and renovation works.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, BOQs and technical specifications.
Good measurement, estimation, costing and analytical skills.
Strong coordination, communication and vendor-management skills.
Ability to prepare clear site reports and maintain accurate documentation.
Proficiency in MS Office; knowledge of AutoCAD and relevant estimation tools will be an advantage.
Ability and willingness to travel to project sites, as required.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance Area: Timely completion; Expected Result: Civil works completed within approved timelines.
Performance Area: Budget adherence; Expected Result: Actual cost monitored against approved estimate and budget.
Performance Area: Quality; Expected Result: Compliance with approved specifications and timely closure of defects.
Performance Area: Measurement accuracy; Expected Result: Accurate and complete MBs and quantity verification.
Performance Area: Bill verification; Expected Result: Contractor bills technically checked against actual work and approved rates.
Performance Area: Documentation; Expected Result: Timely submission of site reports, photographs and completion records.
Performance Area: Safety and compliance; Expected Result: Prompt reporting and resolution/escalation of site-safety and compliance issues.


Working Relationships
The Civil Engineer will work closely with Project/Programme teams, Administration, Procurement, Finance, contractors, vendors and other stakeholders to ensure effective planning, execution, monitoring and documentation of civil works.


Authority and Accountability
The Civil Engineer is responsible for technical assessment, site supervision, measurement and technical recommendations. The Engineer shall not independently approve budgets, vendor selection, scope variations or payments unless specifically authorised in writing. All procurement, financial and administrative approvals shall follow the Organisations delegated-authority matrix and policies.

Job Responsibilities VAPT Engineer
Perform Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) for web applications, APIs, networks, and IT infrastructure.
Conduct authenticated and unauthenticated vulnerability assessments to identify security weaknesses.
Execute manual penetration testing to validate vulnerabilities and assess their exploitability.
Use security testing tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nessus/Tenable, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, and Postman.
Identify and validate security vulnerabilities, including OWASP Top 10 risks and common network security weaknesses.
Prepare detailed VAPT reports covering identified vulnerabilities, severity levels, technical evidence, risk impact, and remediation recommendations.
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and security teams to support vulnerability remediation.
Perform retesting after remediation and verify vulnerability closure.
Support secure code review and application security assessments.
Maintain VAPT documentation, testing procedures, and assessment records.
Support security compliance audits and assessments in accordance with applicable security standards and organizational policies.
Ensure all penetration testing activities are conducted within the approved scope and follow established security testing methodologies.
Required Technical Skills
Hands-on experience in VAPT and manual penetration testing.
Knowledge of web application, API, network, and infrastructure security testing.
Experience with Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nessus/Tenable, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, and Postman.
Understanding of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG).
Ability to prepare technical VAPT reports and recommend remediation measures.
Experience with vulnerability validation, remediation tracking, and retesting.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates with practical experience executing penetration tests, validating vulnerabilities, preparing technical reports, and conducting remediation retesting are preferred. Candidates with experience limited to GRC, compliance, or reviewing third-party VAPT reports may not be suitable for this hands-on role.

High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR

Description:
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance
Job Title: Manager - Training

The Manager - Training will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing training programs aimed at enhancing the skills and knowledge of employees within the organization. This role involves conducting training needs assessments, designing training materials, and delivering engaging training sessions. The Manager will work closely with various departments to ensure alignment of training programs with company objectives and employee performance metrics. Additionally, the role requires tracking and reporting on training effectiveness and participating in continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Conduct training needs assessments to identify gaps in employee skills and knowledge.
2. Design and develop training programs and materials tailored to various employee groups.
3. Deliver engaging and effective training sessions using various instructional techniques.
4. Collaborate with department heads to ensure training aligns with business goals.
5. Evaluate training effectiveness through surveys, assessments, and performance metrics.
6. Provide coaching and support to employees to reinforce learning outcomes.
7. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in training and development.
8. Manage training budgets and resources efficiently.

Skills and Tools Required:
1. Strong communication and presentation skills.
2. Ability to design and develop training materials and programs.
3. Knowledge of adult learning principles and training methodologies.
4. Proficiency in using Learning Management Systems (LMS) and training software.
5. Analytical skills to assess training effectiveness and make data-driven decisions.
6. Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
7. Project management skills to oversee training initiatives and meet deadlines.
8. Familiarity with performance management systems and tools.
9. Innovative thinking to create engaging and effective training solutions.

Preferred Qualifications:
1. Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
2. Proven experience in training and development within the insurance or financial services industry.
3. Certification in training or instructional design is a plus.

Description:
Position responsible for all the food and beverage operations, which includes all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations.
Oversees guest and employee satisfaction, maintaining standards and meeting or exceeding ficial goals.
Demonstrates knowledge and proficiency of all applicable food and beverage laws and regulations.
Develops and implements business plan for food and beverage.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Developing and Maintaining Budgets
- Develops and manages all ficial, employee engagement and guest satisfaction plans and actions for Food and Beverage departments.
- Maintains a positive cost management index for kitchen and restaurant operations.
- Utilizes budgets to understand ficial objectives.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Manages the Food and Beverage departments (not catering sales).
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Oversees all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations.
- Creates and nurtures a property environment that emphasizes motivation, empowerment, teamwork, continuous improvement and a passion for providing service.
- Provides excellent customer service to all employees.
- Responds quickly and proactively to employees concerns.
- Provides a learning atmosphere with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Provides proactive coaching and counseling to team members.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Monitors and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish work.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Sets clear expectations with the employees and team leaders and verifies that appropriate rewards are given if expectations are exceeded.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides excellent customer service.
- Responds quickly and proactively to guests concerns.
- Understands the brands service culture.
- Drives alignment of all employees, team leaders and managers to the brands service culture.
- Sets service expectations for all guests internally and externally.
- Takes ownership of a guest complaint/problem until it is resolved or it has been addressed by the appropriate manager or employee.
- Verifies all banquet functions are up to standard and exceed guests expectations.
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Manages day-to-day operations, drives quality, and verifies standards are meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Conducts performance reviews in a timely manner.
- Promotes both Guarantee of Fair Treatment and Open Door policies.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Develops an action plan to attack need areas and expand on strengths based on employee engagement and guest satisfaction results.
Additional Responsibilities
- Complies with all corporate accounting procedures.
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Drives effective departmental communication and information systems through logs, department meetings and property meetings.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Description:
We are looking for a skilled Attendant Operator to join our team at Tagros Chemicals India Ltd., responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of our chemical plant. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in chemical plant operations and be able to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Roles and Responsibility


Operate and maintain chemical plant equipment, including reactors, distillation columns, and centrifuges.

Monitor and control chemical processes to ensure product quality and safety.

Collaborate with other operators and maintenance personnel to troubleshoot issues and optimize performance.

Implement safety procedures and protocols to prevent accidents and injuries.

Conduct regular inspections of equipment and facilities to identify potential hazards or defects.

Develop and implement process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce costs.


Job Requirements


Diploma or degree in Chemical Engineering or related field.

Minimum 2 years of experience as an operator in a chemical plant setting.

Strong knowledge of chemical plant operations, including safety procedures and protocols.

Ability to work effectively in a team environment and communicate clearly with colleagues.

Familiarity with chemical plant software and instrumentation is desirable.

Must pass a pre-employment physical and drug-alcohol screening.

Description:
About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

- Handles guest problems and complaints, seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Meets and greets guests.

- Supervises on-going training initiatives.
- Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Coaches and counsels employees regarding performance on an on-going basis.
Additional Responsibilities

- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Restaurant Manager.

Description:
Position: Community Program & Skill Development Officer
Department: Hospital Administration / Community Outreach
Reporting To: Medical Superintendent
Location: Tura, Meghalaya
Gender: Male or Female (Both can apply)
Position Summary
The Community Program & Skill Development Officer will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing community outreach programs, health awareness campaigns, and skill development initiatives in villages and surrounding areas of Tura, Meghalaya. The role requires building strong relationships with local communities, government agencies, NGOs, schools, and village leaders to improve public health awareness and healthcare accessibility.
Key Responsibilities
Community Outreach & Awareness
Plan and conduct health awareness programs in villages, schools, community centres, and local institutions.
Organize health camps, screening programs, and preventive healthcare awareness drives.
Educate communities on topics such as maternal and child health, nutrition, sanitation, hygiene, communicable and non-communicable diseases.
Develop strategies to increase community participation in hospital-led health initiatives.
Design and implement skill development and capacity-building programs for community members.
Conduct training programs for community volunteers, healthcare workers, and self-help groups.
Identify local skill gaps and create relevant development initiatives.
Coordinate with government departments and development agencies for training support.
Build and maintain relationships with village heads, local authorities, NGOs, schools, and community-based organizations.
Liaise with government departments and healthcare agencies for collaborative programs.
Represent the hospital in community meetings and public events.
Develop IEC (Information, Education, and Communication) materials for awareness campaigns.
Promote hospital services and healthcare initiatives within target communities.
Utilize local languages and culturally appropriate communication methods to maximize outreach impact.
Required Qualifications
Graduate degree in Social Work, Community Development, Public Health, Sociology, Rural Development, Healthcare Management, or related field.
Postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
Experience
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in community development, healthcare outreach, CSR projects, rural development, skill development, or social sector initiatives.
Experience working with rural communities in Meghalaya or the Northeast region is preferred.
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and public speaking abilities.
Ability to conduct community mobilization and awareness programs.
Good networking and stakeholder management skills.
Strong organizational and reporting capabilities.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Ability to travel extensively to villages and remote locations around Tura and Meghalaya.
Knowledge of local languages and cultural practices will be an advantage.
Preferred Attributes
Passion for community service and public health improvement.
Leadership skills and ability to work independently.
Problem-solving and initiative-taking mindset.
Strong interpersonal and team-building abilities.
Those interested can share their cv to hrgen@acarehospitals.com

Role & responsibilities

. Job Purpose
To lead Electrical & Instrumentation maintenance activities of the cement plant, ensuring equipment reliability, operational efficiency, minimum breakdowns, energy optimization, and compliance with safety standards.
2. Key Responsibilities
Oversee electrical and instrumentation maintenance across Crusher, Raw Mill, Coal Mill, Kiln, Cooler, Cement Mill, and Packing Plant.
Manage maintenance of HT/LT systems, transformers, motors, switchgears, MCCs, PCCs, VFDs, and electrical distribution systems.
Ensure smooth functioning of PLC, DCS, SCADA, automation systems, and field instrumentation.
Plan and implement preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance activities.
Monitor equipment performance, analyse breakdowns, and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime.
Lead annual shutdown planning, maintenance budgeting, and spare parts management.
Identify opportunities for energy conservation and electrical cost optimization.
Ensure electrical safety, statutory compliance, LOTO, and permit-to-work procedures.
Lead and develop the E&I team and coordinate with Production, Mechanical, and other departments.
Supervise installation, modification, and commissioning of electrical and instrumentation projects.
3. Educational Qualification
- B.E./B.Tech in Electrical or Electrical & Electronics Engineering.
4. Experience Required
1015 years of experience in Electrical & Instrumentation maintenance, preferably in the cement manufacturing industry.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To carry out chemical analysis and quality control activities for raw materials, intermediate products, clinker and cement to ensure compliance with defined quality standards and specifications. The role will be responsible for XRF analysis, laboratory testing, monitoring chemical parameters and supporting consistent product quality throughout the manufacturing process.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Chemical Analysis & Quality Control
Conduct chemical analysis of limestone, additives, raw mix, kiln feed, clinker, gypsum, fly ash, slag and cement.
Perform routine and non-routine chemical testing as per established laboratory procedures.
Monitor key chemical parameters such as:
CaO, SiO, AlO and FeO
MgO, SO, KO, NaO and other relevant parameters
LOI and other quality indicators
Ensure test results are accurate, reliable and recorded properly.
B. XRF Operations
Operate and perform routine analysis using X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) equipment.
Prepare samples and pellets/beads as required for XRF analysis.
Perform calibration, standardization and routine checks of the XRF equipment.
Monitor instrument performance and identify abnormal readings or deviations.
Maintain XRF-related records, standards and calibration data.
Coordinate with the concerned team for troubleshooting and maintenance of XRF equipment.
C. Cement & Clinker Quality Monitoring
Monitor the chemical quality of clinker and cement at different stages of production.
Analyze and report quality deviations promptly to the concerned departments.
Support production teams in maintaining required chemical parameters.
Ensure final cement quality meets applicable BIS/IS specifications and internal quality standards.
Assist in maintaining consistency in cement quality.
D. Raw Material & Process Control
Analyze incoming raw materials and monitor their chemical characteristics.
Monitor raw mix and kiln feed quality.
Evaluate chemical variations and communicate deviations to the concerned team.
Support optimization of raw mix and process parameters based on laboratory results.
E. Laboratory Management
Ensure proper functioning, cleanliness and housekeeping of the chemical laboratory.
Maintain laboratory equipment, instruments, chemicals, reagents and standards.
Maintain proper records of test results, calibration, analysis and equipment maintenance.
Ensure safe handling, storage and disposal of laboratory chemicals.
Follow laboratory safety procedures and applicable environmental and safety requirements.
F. Documentation & Reporting
Maintain daily laboratory test reports and quality records.
Prepare and communicate test results to the concerned HOD/Manager.
Ensure timely reporting of critical quality deviations.
Maintain documentation as per departmental SOPs and quality systems.
Participate in internal/external quality audits whenever required.

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.

Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Block Functional Specialist Financial Inclusion to drive financial access, literacy, and empowerment initiatives for rural communities and Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
Key Responsibilities
Bank Linkage & Loan Facilitation: Facilitate SHG-bank linkages, streamline loan application processing, and monitor sanctioning, disbursement, and repayment.

Education: Post-graduate degree or diploma in Science, Business Management (Finance), or Commerce from a recognized university or institution.
Age Limit: Below 30 years.
Experience: 1-2 years of experience in Rural Development and Poverty Alleviation programs.
1-2 years of experience working in Banks, Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs), or Microfinance Institutions (MFIs).
Technical Skills: Proficient in computer applications, with strong knowledge of MS Office and Google Sheets.
